body.translated_text: The Holy <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>
First Chapter of the First Night
Oṃ. Salutation to the Blessed <s>Vāsudeva</s>.
Now, the auspicious invocation:

children.text: nārāyaṇaṃ namas kṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam /
children.translated_text: Having paid homage to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, to <s>Nara</s>, the best of men,

children.text: devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayam udīrayet //
children.translated_text: and to the goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s>, one should then proclaim victory.

children.text: gaṇeśa-śeṣa-brahmeśa-dineśa-pramukhāḥ surāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, <s>Śeṣa</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Īśa</s>, <s>Dineśa</s> (the Sun), and the foremost gods,

children.text: kumārādyāś ca munayaḥ siddhāś ca kapilādayaḥ // Jss_1,1.1 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kumāra</s> and other sages, and <s>Siddhas</s> such as <s>Kapila</s> — // Jss_1,1.1 //

children.text: lakṣmī sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā parā /
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the supreme <s>Rādhikā</s> —

children.text: bhaktyā namanti yaṃ śaśvat taṃ namāmi parāt paraṃ // Jss_1,1.2 //
children.translated_text: Him whom they all perpetually bow to with devotion, I salute — the one beyond the beyond. // Jss_1,1.2 //

children.text: dhyāyante satataṃ santo yogino vaiṣṇavās tathā /
children.translated_text: The saints, <s>yogins</s>, and <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> constantly meditate upon

children.text: jyotir-abhyantare rūpam atulaṃ śyāma-sundaram // Jss_1,1.3 //
children.translated_text: the incomparable form within the radiance — dark and beautiful. // Jss_1,1.3 //

children.text: dhyāyet taṃ paramaṃ brahma paramātmānam īśvaram /
children.translated_text: One should meditate upon that Supreme <s>Brahman</s>, the Supreme Self, the Lord,

children.text: nirīham ati-nirliptam nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ // Jss_1,1.4 //
children.translated_text: desireless, utterly detached, beyond the <s>guṇas</s> (qualities), transcending <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature). // Jss_1,1.4 //

children.text: sarveśaṃ sarva-rūpaṃ ca sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam /
children.translated_text: The Lord of all, of universal form, the cause of all causes,

children.text: satyaṃ nityaṃ ca puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ param avyayam // Jss_1,1.5 //
children.translated_text: true, eternal, the <s>Puruṣa</s> (Primordial Person), ancient, supreme, imperishable. // Jss_1,1.5 //

children.text: maṅgalyaṃ maṅgalārhaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ maṅgalālayam /
children.translated_text: Auspicious, worthy of auspiciousness, auspiciousness itself, the abode of all auspiciousness,

children.text: svecchā-mayaṃ paraṃ dhāma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,1.6 //
children.translated_text: of self-willed nature, the supreme abode, the Blessed One, the eternal. // Jss_1,1.6 //

children.text: stuvanti vedā yaṃ śaśvann ānantaṃ jānanti yasya te /
children.translated_text: Him whom the <s>Vedas</s> perpetually praise, yet they cannot know His infinity —

children.text: taṃ staumi paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nanda-nandanam // Jss_1,1.7 //
children.translated_text: I praise that one of supreme bliss, blissful, the son of <s>Nanda</s>. // Jss_1,1.7 //

children.text: bhakta-priyaṃ ca bhakteśaṃ bhaktānugraha-vigrahaṃ /
children.translated_text: Dear to devotees, the Lord of devotees, whose form is the grace bestowed upon devotees,

children.text: śrīdaṃ śrīśaṃ śrī-nivāsaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ rādhikeśvaram // Jss_1,1.8 //
children.translated_text: the giver of <s>Śrī</s> (prosperity), the Lord of <s>Śrī</s>, the abode of <s>Śrī</s> — <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, the Lord of <s>Rādhikā</s>. // Jss_1,1.8 //

children.text: jñānāmṛtaṃ jñāna-sindhoḥ saṃprāpya śaṅkarād guroḥ /
children.translated_text: Having obtained the nectar of knowledge from the ocean of knowledge, from the <s>guru</s> <s>Śaṅkara</s>,

children.text: parāvarāc ca paramād yogīndrāṇāṃ guror guroḥ // Jss_1,1.9 //
children.translated_text: the highest of the high, the <s>guru</s> of <s>gurus</s> of the kings of <s>yogins</s>, // Jss_1,1.9 //

children.text: vedebhyo dadhi-sindhubhyaś caturbhyaḥ sumanoharam /
children.translated_text: from the four <s>Vedas</s>, as from four oceans of milk, most enchanting,

children.text: taj jñāna-mantha-daṇḍena saṃnirmathya navaṃ navam // Jss_1,1.10 //
children.translated_text: having churned [them] with the churning-rod of that knowledge, ever fresh, // Jss_1,1.10 //

children.text: navanītaṃ samuddhṛtya natvā śambhoḥ padāmbujam /
children.translated_text: having extracted the butter [of essence], having bowed to the lotus feet of <s>Śambhu</s>,

children.text: vidhi-putro nārado 'haṃ pañca-rātraṃ samārabhe // Jss_1,1.11 //
children.translated_text: I, <s>Nārada</s>, the son of <s>Vidhi</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>), commence this <s>Pañcarātra</s>. // Jss_1,1.11 //

children.text: oṃ nārāyaṇāśrame puṇye puṇya-kṣetre ca bhārata /
children.translated_text: Oṃ. In the sacred <s>Nārāyaṇāśrama</s>, in the holy land, O <s>Bhārata</s>,

children.text: siddhe nārāyaṇa-kṣetre vaṭa-mūle supuṇyade // Jss_1,1.12 //
children.translated_text: at the accomplished holy site of <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, at the root of a banyan tree, most meritorious, // Jss_1,1.12 //

children.text: kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kṛṣṇa-bhaktaṃ ca palaṃ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇam /
children.translated_text: a portion of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, a devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, whose supreme refuge is <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhoja-dhyānaikatāna-mānasam // Jss_1,1.13 //
children.translated_text: whose mind was wholly absorbed in meditation upon the lotus feet of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, // Jss_1,1.13 //

children.text: japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ity akṣara-dvayam /
children.translated_text: reciting the Supreme <s>Brahman</s> — the two syllables '<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,'

children.text: sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyanaṃ munim // Jss_1,1.14 //
children.translated_text: seated comfortably upon a comfortable seat — the sage <s>Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana</s> (<s>Vyāsa</s>) — // Jss_1,1.14 //

children.text: papraccha śukadevaś ca sarva-jñaṃ pitaraṃ muniḥ /
children.translated_text: him did the sage <s>Śukadeva</s> question — his omniscient father —

children.text: kāraṇaṇ ca purāṇānāṃ purāṇaṃ param avyayam // Jss_1,1.15 //
children.translated_text: the cause of the <s>Purāṇas</s>, the most ancient, supreme, and imperishable: // Jss_1,1.15 //

children.text: śrī-śuka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Śuka</s> said:

children.text: bhagavan sarva-tattva-jña veda-vedāṅga-pāraga /
children.translated_text: 'O Blessed One, knower of all principles, versed in the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Vedāṅgas</s>,

children.text: yad yat prakāraṃ jñānaṃ ca nigūḍhaṃ śruti-sammatam // Jss_1,1.16 //
children.translated_text: whatever kinds of knowledge are hidden and sanctioned by the <s>Śrutis</s>, // Jss_1,1.16 //

children.text: teṣu yat sāra-bhūtaṃ cāpy ajñānāndha-pradīpakam /
children.translated_text: of those, that which is the quintessence, the lamp [that dispels] the blindness of ignorance —

children.text: tat tat sarvaṃ samālocya māṃ bodhayitum arhasi // Jss_1,1.17 //
children.translated_text: having considered all that, please enlighten me.' // Jss_1,1.17 //

body.translated_text: Now, the praise of devotion to <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>:

children.text: sa pitā jñāna-dātā yo jñānaṃ tat kṛṣṇa-bhaktidam /
children.translated_text: He is [truly] a father who gives knowledge — that knowledge which bestows devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: sā bhaktiḥ paramā śuddhā kṛṣṇa-dāsya-pradā ca yā // Jss_1,1.18 //
children.translated_text: that devotion is supreme and pure which grants servitude to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss_1,1.18 //

children.text: tad eva dāsyaṃ śastaṃ yat sākṣāc caraṇa-sevanaṃ /
children.translated_text: That servitude alone is praiseworthy which is the direct service of [His] feet,

children.text: nityaṃ goloka-vāsaṃ ca purataḥ stavanaṃ hareḥ // Jss_1,1.19 //
children.translated_text: eternal dwelling in <s>Goloka</s>, and praising <s>Hari</s> in His presence. // Jss_1,1.19 //

children.text: śaśvan nimeṣa-rahitaṃ tat-pāda-padma-darśanam /
children.translated_text: The unblinking vision of His lotus feet perpetually,

children.text: śaśvat tat-sārdham ālāpa-sevā-karma-niyojanam // Jss_1,1.20 //
children.translated_text: perpetual engagement in conversation, service, and duties with Him, // Jss_1,1.20 //

children.text: tena sārdham aviccheda-sthānaṃ paraṃ śobhanam /
children.translated_text: uninterrupted dwelling with Him — the supreme, beautiful [state] —

children.text: bhaktānāṃ vāñcchitaṃ vastu sāra-bhūtaṃ śrutau śrutam // Jss_1,1.21 //
children.translated_text: this is the desired object of devotees, the quintessence heard in the <s>Śruti</s>. // Jss_1,1.21 //

children.text: putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vyāsadevo jahāsa saḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of his son, <s>Vyāsadeva</s> laughed.

children.text: vijñāya jñāninaṃ putraṃ paramāhlādam āpa ha // Jss_1,1.22 //
children.translated_text: Recognizing his son as a knower, he attained supreme delight. // Jss_1,1.22 //

children.text: putraṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā sarva-jñaḥ sarva-bhāvanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having blessed his son with auspicious benedictions, the omniscient one, the contemplator of all,

children.text: yathāprāptaṃ guru-mukhāt pravaktum upacakrame // Jss_1,1.23 //
children.translated_text: began to speak what he had received from the mouth of his <s>guru</s>: // Jss_1,1.23 //

children.text: śrī-vyāsa uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Vyāsa</s> said:

children.text: śuka dhanyo 'si mānyo 'si puṇya-rūpo 'si bhārate /
children.translated_text: '<s>Śuka</s>, you are blessed, you are honored, you are the embodiment of merit in <s>Bhārata</s>.

children.text: putreṇa bhavatāsmākaṃ kulaṃ muktaṃ ca pāvanam // Jss_1,1.24 //
children.translated_text: By a son like you, our family has been liberated and purified. // Jss_1,1.24 //

children.text: sa putraḥ kṛṣṇa-bhakto yo bhārate suyaśas-karaḥ /
children.translated_text: He is [truly] a son who is a devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, who brings fame in <s>Bhārata</s>;

children.text: punāti puṃsāṃ śatakaṃ janma-mātreṇa līlayā // Jss_1,1.25 //
children.translated_text: by his mere birth, effortlessly, he purifies a hundred generations of ancestors. // Jss_1,1.25 //

children.text: mātā-mahānāṃ śatakaṃ mātaraṃ mātṛ-mātaram /
children.translated_text: A hundred maternal grandfathers, the mother, the mother's mother,

children.text: sodarān bāndhavāṃś caiva bhṛtyān patnīṃ sahātmajām // Jss_1,1.26 //
children.translated_text: brothers, kinsmen, servants, wife, together with children — // Jss_1,1.26 //

children.text: yat-kanyāṃ pratigṛhṇāti tad-ādi-puruṣa-trayam /
children.translated_text: he who accepts his daughter, and three generations of his ancestors —

children.text: kanyā-pradātā śvaśuro jīvan-muktaḥ sabhāryakaḥ // Jss_1,1.27 //
children.translated_text: the giver of the daughter, the father-in-law — [all become] liberated while living, together with their wives. // Jss_1,1.27 //

children.text: svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavān paraṃ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: The creator (<s>Vidhi</s>) himself, the Blessed One, is supremely devoted to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: kṛṣṇa-bhakto vasiṣṭas tu tat suto vaiṣṇavaḥ svayam // Jss_1,1.28 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> is a devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>; his son is himself a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // Jss_1,1.28 //

children.text: vaiṣṇavas tat sutaḥ śaktiḥ kṛṣṇa-dhyānaika-mānasaḥ /
children.translated_text: His son <s>Śakti</s> is a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, with mind wholly absorbed in meditation upon <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: parāśaraś ca tat-putraḥ kṛṣṇa-pādābja-sevayā // Jss_1,1.29 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Parāśara</s>, his son, through service to the lotus feet of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, // Jss_1,1.29 //

children.text: jīvan-mukto mahā-jñānī yogīndrāṇāṃ guror guruḥ /
children.translated_text: is liberated while living, a great knower, the <s>guru</s> of <s>gurus</s> of the kings of <s>yogins</s>.

children.text: ahaṃ veda-vibhaktā ca śrī-kṛṣṇa-pāda-sevayā // Jss_1,1.30 //
children.translated_text: I am the divider of the <s>Vedas</s>, through service to the feet of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss_1,1.30 //

children.text: gurur me bhagavān sākṣād yogīndro nārado muniḥ /
children.translated_text: My <s>guru</s> is the Blessed One himself, the king of <s>yogins</s>, the sage <s>Nārada</s>;

children.text: guror gurur me śambhuś ca yogīndrāṇāṃ guror guruḥ // Jss_1,1.31 //
children.translated_text: the <s>guru</s> of my <s>guru</s> is <s>Śambhu</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), the <s>guru</s> of <s>gurus</s> of the kings of <s>yogins</s>. // Jss_1,1.31 //

children.text: teṣāṃ puṇyena putras tvaṃ puṇya-rāśiś ca mūrtimān /
children.translated_text: By the merit of those [ancestors], you are a son — an embodied mass of merit,

children.text: padmānāṃ mama puṃsāṃ ca prakāśo bhāskaraḥ svayam // Jss_1,1.32 //
children.translated_text: the sun itself, the illuminator of my lotuses and of [all] people. // Jss_1,1.32 //

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhojaṃ pādābjaṃ nāradeśayoḥ /
children.translated_text: Having [bowed to] the lotus feet of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, and the lotus feet of <s>Nārada</s> and <s>Īśa</s>,

children.text: sarasvatīṃ namas kṛtya jñānaṃ vakṣye sanātanam // Jss_1,1.33 //
children.translated_text: having paid homage to <s>Sarasvatī</s>, I shall speak the eternal knowledge. // Jss_1,1.33 //

children.text: śrūyatām pañca-rātraṃ ca veda-sāram abhīpsitam /
children.translated_text: Listen to this <s>Pañcarātra</s>, the desired essence of the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: pañca-saṃvādam iṣṭaṃ ca bhaktānām abhivāñcchitam // Jss_1,1.34 //
children.translated_text: the five dialogues, beloved and longed for by devotees. // Jss_1,1.34 //

children.text: prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ śuddhaṃ paraṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ śubhaṃ /
children.translated_text: Dearer than life, pure, supreme — the auspicious nectar of knowledge.

children.text: atha ṣaṭ-saṃvādāḥ ?what? hi goloke śata-śṛṅge ca parvate // Jss_1,1.35 //
children.translated_text: Now, the six dialogues [took place] in <s>Goloka</s>, on the hundred-peaked mountain, // Jss_1,1.35 //

children.text: supuṇye virajā-tīre vaṭa-mūle manohare /
children.translated_text: on the holy bank of the <s>Virajā</s> river, at the charming root of a banyan tree.

children.text: purato rādhikāyāś ca brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam // Jss_1,1.36 //
children.translated_text: Before <s>Rādhikā</s>, to <s>Brahmā</s> born from the lotus, // Jss_1,1.36 //

children.text: tam uvāca mahā-bhaktaṃ stuvantaṃ praṇataṃ sutam /
children.translated_text: [<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>] spoke to his great devotee, his son, who was praising [Him] and prostrating.

children.text: pañca-rātram idaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutvā ca jagatāṃ vidhiḥ // Jss_1,1.37 //
children.translated_text: The creator of the worlds, having heard this holy <s>Pañcarātra</s>, // Jss_1,1.37 //

children.text: praṇamya rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prayayau śiva-mandiram /
children.translated_text: having bowed to <s>Rādhikā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, went to the abode of <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: bhaktyā tam pūjayām āsa śaṅkaraḥ paramādaram // Jss_1,1.38 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> worshipped him with devotion and the highest reverence. // Jss_1,1.38 //

children.text: sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ svasthaṃ bhaktaṃ ca pūjitam /
children.translated_text: Seated comfortably upon a comfortable seat, at ease, a devotee who had been honored —

children.text: papraccha vārtāṃ vinayī vinayena sukhāvahām // Jss_1,1.39 //
children.translated_text: he questioned him humbly and courteously about the delightful news. // Jss_1,1.39 //

children.text: sarvaṃ taṃ kathayām āsa pañca-rātrādikaṃ śubham /
children.translated_text: [<s>Brahmā</s>] narrated everything to him — the auspicious <s>Pañcarātra</s> and the rest.

children.text: vasantaṃ vaṭa-mūle ca svarge mandākinī-taṭe // Jss_1,1.40 //
children.translated_text: [<s>Śiva</s>], dwelling at the root of a banyan tree, on the bank of the <s>Mandākinī</s> in heaven, // Jss_1,1.40 //

children.text: yogīndrair api siddhendrair munīndraiś ca stutaṃ prabhuṃ /
children.translated_text: the Lord praised by the kings of <s>yogins</s>, <s>Siddhas</s>, and sages —

children.text: jñānāmṛtaṃ tam uktvā sa brahma-lokaṃ jagāma ha // Jss_1,1.41 //
children.translated_text: having imparted the nectar of knowledge, [<s>Brahmā</s>] went to <s>Brahmaloka</s>. // Jss_1,1.41 //

children.text: śambhuś ca kathayām āsa sva-śiṣyaṃ nāradaṃ munim /
children.translated_text: <s>Śambhu</s> narrated it to his disciple, the sage <s>Nārada</s>.

children.text: nāradaḥ kathayām āsa puṣkare sūrya-parvaṇi // Jss_1,1.42 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nārada</s> narrated it at <s>Puṣkara</s> during a solar festival, // Jss_1,1.42 //

children.text: māṃ bhaktam anuraktaṃ ca puṇyāhe muni-saṃsadi /
children.translated_text: to me, his devoted and attached [disciple], on an auspicious day, in the assembly of sages —

children.text: pañca-rātram idaṃ śuddhaṃ bhramāndha-dhvaṃsa-dīpakam // Jss_1,1.43 //
children.translated_text: this pure <s>Pañcarātra</s>, a lamp that destroys the blindness of delusion. // Jss_1,1.43 //

body.translated_text: Now, the explanation of the term '<s>Pañcarātra</s>':

children.text: rātraṃ ca jñāna-vacanaṃ jñānaṃ pañca-vidhaṃ smṛtam /
children.translated_text: '<s>Rātra</s>' is a term for knowledge; knowledge is said to be fivefold.

children.text: tenedaṃ pañca-rātraṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ // Jss_1,1.44 //
children.translated_text: Therefore, the wise call this '<s>Pañcarātra</s>' (Five [forms of] Knowledge). // Jss_1,1.44 //

children.text: jñānaṃ parama-tattvaṃ ca janma-mṛtyu-jarāpaham /
children.translated_text: The first knowledge is the Supreme Principle, which removes birth, death, and old age;

children.text: tato mṛtyuñjayaḥ śambhuḥ saṃprāpa kṛṣṇa-vaktrataḥ // Jss_1,1.45 //
children.translated_text: thereby <s>Śambhu</s>, the conqueror of death, obtained [it] from the mouth of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss_1,1.45 //

children.text: jñānam dvitīyaṃ paramaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ ca vāñcchitam /
children.translated_text: The second knowledge, the supreme, is that desired by those seeking liberation —

children.text: paraṃ mukti-pradaṃ śuddhaṃ yato līnaṃ hareḥ pade // Jss_1,1.46 //
children.translated_text: supreme, granting liberation, pure — by which one merges in the abode of <s>Hari</s>. // Jss_1,1.46 //

children.text: jñānaṃ śuddhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ kṛṣṇa-bhaktidam /
children.translated_text: The third knowledge is pure, auspicious, bestowing devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: tad-dāsyam adhīṣṭaṃ ca yato dāsyaṃ labhed dhareḥ // Jss_1,1.47 //
children.translated_text: servitude to Him is its foundation — by which one obtains servitude to <s>Hari</s>. // Jss_1,1.47 //

children.text: caturthaṃ yaugikaṃ jñānaṃ sarva-siddhi-pradaṃ param /
children.translated_text: The fourth is yogic knowledge, supreme, bestowing all <s>siddhis</s> (supernatural powers) —

children.text: sarvasvaṃ yogināṃ putra siddhānāṃ ca sukha-pradam // Jss_1,1.48 //
children.translated_text: the everything of <s>yogins</s>, O son, and the giver of happiness to the <s>Siddhas</s>. // Jss_1,1.48 //

children.text: aṇimā laghimā vyāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Aṇimā</s> (minuteness), <s>laghimā</s> (lightness), <s>vyāpti</s> (pervasiveness), <s>prākāmya</s> (irresistible will), <s>mahimā</s> (greatness),

children.text: īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca tathākāmāvasāyitā // Jss_1,1.49 //
children.translated_text: <s>īśitva</s> (lordship), <s>vaśitva</s> (mastery), and <s>kāmāvasāyitā</s> (fulfillment of desire), // Jss_1,1.49 //

children.text: sāvajñaṃ dūra-śravaṇaṃ para-kāya-praveśanam /
children.translated_text: supreme cognition, distant hearing, entering another's body,

children.text: kāya-vyūhaṃ jīva-dānaṃ para-jīva-haraṃ param // Jss_1,1.50 //
children.translated_text: multiplication of the body, granting life, and taking away another's life — supreme, // Jss_1,1.50 //

children.text: sarga-kartṛtva-śilpaṃ ca sarga-saṃhāra-kāraṇam /
children.translated_text: the art of creatorship and the cause of creation and dissolution —

children.text: siddhaṃ ca ṣoḍaśa-vidhaṃ jñānināṃ ca yato bhavet // Jss_1,1.51 //
children.translated_text: sixteen kinds of <s>siddhis</s> arise from this for the knowers. // Jss_1,1.51 //

children.text: jñānaṃ ca paramaṃ proktaṃ tad vai vaiṣayikaṃ nṛṇāṃ /
children.translated_text: The fifth knowledge is said to be the supreme — that which pertains to sense-objects for humans,

children.text: yad iṣṭa-devī māyā sā paraṃ saṃmoha-kāraṇaṃ // Jss_1,1.52 //
children.translated_text: whose beloved deity is <s>Māyā</s> herself — the supreme cause of delusion. // Jss_1,1.52 //

children.text: viṣaye baddha-citaṃ ca sarvam indriya-sevanam /
children.translated_text: The mind bound to sense-objects, service to all the senses,

children.text: poṣanaṃ sva-kuṭumbānāṃ svātmanaś ca niranratam // Jss_1,1.53 //
children.translated_text: the ceaseless nourishment of one's family and oneself. // Jss_1,1.53 //

children.text: prathamaṃ sāttvikaṃ jñānaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca tad eva ca /
children.translated_text: The first knowledge is <s>sāttvika</s> (of the nature of purity); the second is likewise.

children.text: nairguṇyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca sarvataḥ param // Jss_1,1.54 //
children.translated_text: The third is <s>nairguṇya</s> (transcending the <s>guṇas</s>) — knowledge supreme above all. // Jss_1,1.54 //

children.text: caturtham ca rājasikaṃ bhaktas tan nābhivāñcchati /
children.translated_text: The fourth is <s>rājasika</s> (of the nature of passion) — a devotee does not desire it.

children.text: pañcamaṃ tāmasaṃ jñānaṃ vidvāṃs tan nābhivāñcchati // Jss_1,1.55 //
children.translated_text: The fifth is <s>tāmasika</s> (of the nature of darkness) — a wise person does not desire it. // Jss_1,1.55 //

children.text: jñānaṃ pañca-vidhaṃ proktaṃ pañca-rātraṃ vidur budhāḥ /
children.translated_text: Knowledge, said to be fivefold — the wise know this as <s>Pañcarātra</s>.

children.text: pañca-rātraṃ sapta-vidhaṃ jñānināṃ jñānadaṃ param // Jss_1,1.56 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Pañcarātra</s> is sevenfold — the supreme bestower of knowledge to knowers. // Jss_1,1.56 //

children.text: brāhmaṃ śaivaṃ ca kaumāraṃ vāsiṣṭaṃ kāpilaṃ param /
children.translated_text: The <s>Brāhma</s>, <s>Śaiva</s>, <s>Kaumāra</s>, <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s>, <s>Kāpila</s> (supreme),

children.text: gautamīyaṃ nāradīyam idaṃ sapta-vidhaṃ smṛtam // Jss_1,1.57 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamīya</s>, and <s>Nāradīya</s> — this is said to be the sevenfold [<s>Pañcarātra</s>]. // Jss_1,1.57 //

body.translated_text: Now, the praise of the text:

children.text: ṣaṭ pañca-rātraṃ vedāś ca purāṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: The six <s>Pañcarātras</s>, the <s>Vedas</s>, the <s>Purāṇas</s> in their entirety,

children.text: itihāsaṃ dharma-śāstraṃ śātraṃ ca siddhi-yoga-jam // Jss_1,1.58 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Itihāsas</s>, the <s>Dharmaśāstras</s>, and the treatises born of <s>Siddhi</s>-<s>Yoga</s> — // Jss_1,1.58 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ samālokya jñānaṃ saṃprāpya śaṅkarāt /
children.translated_text: having examined and surveyed all, having obtained knowledge from <s>Śaṅkara</s>,

children.text: jñānāmṛtaṃ pañca-rātraṃ cakāra nārado muniḥ // Jss_1,1.59 //
children.translated_text: the sage <s>Nārada</s> composed the <s>Pañcarātra</s>, the nectar of knowledge. // Jss_1,1.59 //

children.text: puṇyaṃ ca pāpa-vighnaṃ bhakti-dāsya-pradaṃ hareḥ /
children.translated_text: Meritorious, destroying sins and obstacles, bestowing devotion and servitude to <s>Hari</s>,

children.text: sarvasvaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca priyaṃ prāṇādhikaṃ suta // Jss_1,1.60 //
children.translated_text: the everything of <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, dearer than life, O son. // Jss_1,1.60 //

children.text: sāra-bhūtaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vedānāṃ paramādbhutam /
children.translated_text: The quintessence of all the <s>Vedas</s>, supremely wondrous —

children.text: nāradīyaṃ pañca-rātraṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabham // Jss_1,1.61 //
children.translated_text: this <s>Nāradīya Pañcarātra</s> is exceedingly rare among <s>Purāṇas</s>. // Jss_1,1.61 //

children.text: sarvāntarātmā bhagavān brahma-jyotiḥ sanātanam /
children.translated_text: The inner Self of all, the Blessed One, the eternal <s>Brahma</s>-radiance,

children.text: paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmān yathā kṛṣṇaḥ sureṣu ca // Jss_1,1.62 //
children.translated_text: the most complete, glorious — just as <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> [is supreme] among the gods, // Jss_1,1.62 //

children.text: yathā devīṣu pūjyā sā mūla-prakṛtir īśvarī /
children.translated_text: just as she, the <s>Mūla-Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature), the sovereign, is worshipped among goddesses,

children.text: vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ jñānināṃ yogināṃ śivaḥ // Jss_1,1.63 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Śiva</s> among <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, <s>Siddhas</s>, knowers, and <s>yogins</s>, // Jss_1,1.63 //

children.text: viśvastānāṃ indriyānām manaś ca śīghra-gāminām /
children.translated_text: and the mind among the trustworthy and swift-moving senses,

children.text: brahmā ca veda-viduṣāṃ pūjyānāṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ // Jss_1,1.64 //
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> among knowers of the <s>Vedas</s>, and <s>Gaṇeśvara</s> (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>) among the worshipful, // Jss_1,1.64 //

children.text: sanat-kumāro bhagavān munīnāṃ pravaro yathā /
children.translated_text: the Blessed <s>Sanatkumāra</s> as foremost among sages,

children.text: bṛhaspatir buddhimatāṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā // Jss_1,1.65 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s> among the wise, <s>Kapila</s> among the <s>Siddhas</s>, // Jss_1,1.65 //

children.text: yogīndrānāṃ satāṃ śuddha ṛṣir nārāyaṇo yathā /
children.translated_text: the pure sage <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> among the kings of <s>yogins</s> and the virtuous,

children.text: kavīnāṃ ca yathā śukraḥ paṇḍitānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ // Jss_1,1.66 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śukra</s> among poets, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> among the learned, // Jss_1,1.66 //

children.text: saritām ca yathā gaṅgā samudrāṇāṃ jalārṇavaḥ /
children.translated_text: the <s>Gaṅgā</s> among rivers, the ocean among seas,

children.text: vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣānāṃ bhārataṃ yathā // Jss_1,1.67 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vṛndāvana</s> among forests, <s>Bhārata</s> among countries, // Jss_1,1.67 //

children.text: puṣkaraṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ pūjyānāṃ vaiṣṇavo yathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Puṣkara</s> among holy sites, a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> among the worshipful,

children.text: ātmākāśo yathāptānāṃ yathā kāśī purīṣu ca // Jss_1,1.68 //
children.translated_text: the <s>ātman</s> (Self) as space among the trustworthy, <s>Kāśī</s> among cities, // Jss_1,1.68 //

children.text: vṛkṣāṇāṃ kalpa-vṛkṣaś ca surabhī kāma-dhenuṣu /
children.translated_text: the wish-fulfilling tree (<s>Kalpavṛkṣa</s>) among trees, the wish-granting cow (<s>Surabhī</s>) among <s>Kāmadhenu</s>s —

children.text: puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaś ca patrāṇāṃ tulasī yathā // Jss_1,1.69 //
children.translated_text: as <s>Pārijāta</s> among flowers and <s>Tulasī</s> among leaves, // Jss 1.1.69 //

children.text: mantrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇa-mantraś ca yathā vidyā dhaneṣv api /
children.translated_text: as the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>mantra</s> among <s>mantras</s>, as knowledge (<s>vidyā</s>) among riches,

children.text: yathā tejasvināṃ sūryo miṣṭānām amṛtaṃ yathā // Jss_1,1.70 //
children.translated_text: as the sun among luminous ones, as nectar (<s>amṛta</s>) among sweet things, // Jss 1.1.70 //

children.text: ādhārāṇāṃ ca sthūlānāṃ mahā-viṣṇur yathā suta /
children.translated_text: as <s>Mahāviṣṇu</s> among gross supports, O son,

children.text: sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇuś ca guruṇāṃ mantra-tantra-daḥ // Jss_1,1.71 //
children.translated_text: as the atom (<s>paramāṇu</s>) among subtle ones, and as the <s>mantra</s>-and-<s>tantra</s>-bestower among teachers, // Jss 1.1.71 //

children.text: putraś ca sneha-pātrāṇāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā śaśī /
children.translated_text: as a son among objects of affection, as the moon among stars,

children.text: yathā ghṛtaṃ ca gavyānāṃ śasyānāṃ dhānyam īpsitam // Jss_1,1.72 //
children.translated_text: as ghee among cow-products, as grain among crops is desired, // Jss 1.1.72 //

children.text: śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedāḥ sāśramāṇāṃ yathā dvijaḥ /
children.translated_text: as the <s>Vedas</s> among scriptures, as the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> among those with <s>āśramas</s> (stages of life),

children.text: taijasānāṃ yathā ratnaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakam // Jss_1,1.73 //
children.translated_text: as jewels — pearl, ruby, and diamond — among luminous things, // Jss 1.1.73 //

children.text: yathā chandasi gāyatrī durgā śaktimatīṣv api /
children.translated_text: as <s>Gāyatrī</s> among meters, as <s>Durgā</s> among powerful goddesses,

children.text: pati-vratāsu laksmīś ca kṣamāśīlāsu medinī // Jss_1,1.74 //
children.translated_text: as <s>Lakṣmī</s> among devoted wives, and as the Earth (<s>Medinī</s>) among those of forbearing nature, // Jss 1.1.74 //

children.text: saubhāgyāsu sundarīṣu rādhā kṛṣṇa-priyāsu ca /
children.translated_text: as <s>Rādhā</s> among beautiful and auspicious ones and among those dear to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: hanumān vānarāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā // Jss_1,1.75 //
children.translated_text: as <s>Hanumān</s> among monkeys, and as <s>Garuḍa</s> among birds, // Jss 1.1.75 //

children.text: vāhanānāṃ balavatāṃ śaṅkarasya yathā vṛṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: as the bull of <s>Śaṅkara</s> among powerful mounts,

children.text: śālagrāmaś ca yantrāṇāṃ pūjāsu kṛṣṇa-pūjanam // Jss_1,1.76 //
children.translated_text: as <s>Śālagrāma</s> among sacred objects, and as the worship of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> among forms of worship, // Jss 1.1.76 //

children.text: ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca tapaḥsv anaśanaṃ yathā /
children.translated_text: as <s>Ekādaśī</s> among vows, as fasting among austerities,

children.text: yajñānāṃ japa-yajñaś ca satyaṃ dharmeṣu putraka // Jss_1,1.77 //
children.translated_text: as the <s>japa</s>-sacrifice among sacrifices, and as truth among <s>dharmas</s>, O dear son, // Jss 1.1.77 //

children.text: suśīlaṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca puṇyeṣu kṛṣṇa-kīrtanam /
children.translated_text: as good conduct among virtues, and as the chanting of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s name among meritorious deeds,

children.text: śobhāśu sukha-dṛśyeṣu prabhā tejaḥsu sarvataḥ // Jss_1,1.78 //
children.translated_text: as beauty among lovely sights, and as radiance among all splendors, // Jss 1.1.78 //

children.text: poṣṭrīṇāṃ upakartṛṇāṃ mitrāṇāṃ jananī yathā /
children.translated_text: as a mother among nurturers, benefactors, and friends,

children.text: lokānām api lokeśaḥ śeṣo nāgeṣu pūjitaḥ // Jss_1,1.79 //
children.translated_text: as the Lord of the worlds (<s>Lokeśa</s>) among the worlds, and as <s>Śeṣa</s>, honored among serpents, // Jss 1.1.79 //

children.text: sudarśanaṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ viśvakarmā ca śilpinām /
children.translated_text: as the <s>Sudarśana</s> [disc] among weapons, as <s>Viśvakarman</s> among craftsmen,

children.text: dharmiṣṭheṣu dayāvatsu devarṣisu mahatsu ca // Jss_1,1.80 //
children.translated_text: among the most righteous, the compassionate, and the divine sages among the great ones, // Jss 1.1.80 //

children.text: viṣṇu-bhakteṣu vijñeṣu yathaiva nārado muniḥ /
children.translated_text: as the sage <s>Nārada</s> among <s>Viṣṇu</s>-devotees and among the wise —

children.text: evaṃ ca sarva-śāstreṣu pañca-rātraṃ ca pūjitam // Jss_1,1.81 //
children.translated_text: just so, the <s>Pañcarātra</s> is honored among all scriptures. // Jss 1.1.81 //

children.text: yathā nipīya pīyūṣaṃ na spṛhā cānya-vastuṣu /
children.translated_text: Just as, having drunk the nectar, there is no desire for other substances,

children.text: pañca-rātram abhijñāya nānyeṣu ca spṛhā satām // Jss_1,1.82 //
children.translated_text: so, having understood the <s>Pañcarātra</s>, the virtuous have no desire for other [texts]. // Jss 1.1.82 //

children.text: sarvārtha-jñāna-bījaṃ cāpy ajñānāndha-pradīpam /
children.translated_text: It is the seed of knowledge of all meanings, a lamp for the darkness of ignorance,

children.text: vedasāroddhṛtaṃ tattvaṃ sarveṣāṃ samabhīpsitam // Jss_1,1.83 //
children.translated_text: the truth extracted from the essence of the <s>Vedas</s>, desired by all. // Jss 1.1.83 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the first chapter, entitled 'The Praise of the Text,' in the sacred <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>.
In the first 'night' (<s>ekarātra</s>), the second chapter.

children.text: śuka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śuka</s> said:

children.text: kutra vā pañca-rātraṃ ca nāradasya ca dhīmate /
children.translated_text: Where and by whom was the <s>Pañcarātra</s> given to the wise <s>Nārada</s>

children.text: pradattaṃ śambhunā tāta tan me vyākhyātum arhasi // Jss_1,2.1 //
children.translated_text: by <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva)? Father, please explain this to me. // Jss 1.2.1 //

body.translated_text: Now, the description of <s>Nārada</s>'s austerities.

children.text: vyāsa uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Vyāsa</s> said:

children.text: adhītya sarvān vedāṃś ca vedāṅgāṇ pitur antike /
children.translated_text: Having studied all the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Vedāṅgas</s> in the presence of his father,

children.text: jagāma tītrhaṃ kedāraṃ supraśastaṃ ca bhārate // Jss_1,2.2 //
children.translated_text: he went to the sacred site of <s>Kedāra</s>, most celebrated in <s>Bhārata</s>. // Jss 1.2.2 //

children.text: himālayasya pūrve ya gaṅgā-tīre manohare /
children.translated_text: On the eastern [slope] of the <s>Himālaya</s>, on the enchanting bank of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>,

children.text: siddhe nārāyaṇa-kṣetre sarveṣāṃ abhivāñcchite // Jss_1,2.3 //
children.translated_text: at the accomplished holy site of <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, desired by all, // Jss 1.2.3 //

children.text: tapaś cakāra sa munir divyaṃ varṣa-sahasrakam /
children.translated_text: that sage performed divine austerities for a thousand years,

children.text: pitroktenaiva vidhinā satataṃ saṃyutaḥ śuciḥ // Jss_1,2.4 //
children.translated_text: constantly pure, following the procedure instructed by his father. // Jss 1.2.4 //

children.text: śuśrāvākāśa-vāṇīṃ ca tapaso 'nte mahā-muniḥ /
children.translated_text: At the end of his austerities, the great sage heard a celestial voice from the sky,

children.text: svalpākṣarāṃ ca bahv-arthāṃ pariṇāma-sukhāvahām // Jss_1,2.5 //
children.translated_text: brief in syllables yet abundant in meaning, bringing the happiness of fulfillment. // Jss 1.2.5 //

body.translated_text: Now, the celestial voice addressed to <s>Nārada</s>.

children.text: ādhārito yadi haris tapasā tataḥ kim /
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> is established [in one's heart] through austerity, then what is the use [of further austerity]?

children.text: nādhārito yadi haris tapasā tataḥ kim /
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> is not established through austerity, then what is the use [of such austerity]?

children.text: antar bahir yadi haris tapasā tataḥ kim /
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> is within and without, then what is the use of austerity?

children.text: nāntar bahir yadi haris tapasā tataḥ kim // Jss_1,2.6 //
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> is neither within nor without, then what is the use of austerity? // Jss 1.2.6 //

body.translated_text: The disembodied voice said:

children.text: virama virama brahman kiṃ tapasyāsu vatsa /
children.translated_text: Cease, cease, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, from austerities, O child!

children.text: vraja vraja dvija śīghraṃ śaṅkaraṃ jñāna-sindhum /
children.translated_text: Go, go quickly, O twice-born, to <s>Śaṅkara</s>, the ocean of knowledge!

children.text: labha labha hari-bhaktiṃ vaiṣṇavoktāṃ supakvāṃ /
children.translated_text: Obtain, obtain devotion to <s>Hari</s>, as taught by the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, well-ripened,

children.text: bhava-nigaḍa-nibandha-chedinīṃ kartanīṃ ca // Jss_1,2.7 //
children.translated_text: which severs the fetters of worldly existence, which is to be practiced! // Jss 1.2.7 //

children.text: iti śrutvā ca sa munir vimanāḥ svar-ṇadī-taṭe /
children.translated_text: Having heard this, the sage, dejected on the bank of the celestial river,

children.text: cakārārthānusandhānaṃ na prasannam ca tan manaḥ // Jss_1,2.8 //
children.translated_text: pondered its meaning, but his mind was not at peace. // Jss 1.2.8 //

children.text: ruroda svar-ṇadī-tīre smāraṃ smāraṃ hareḥ padam /
children.translated_text: He wept on the bank of the celestial river, remembering again and again the abode of <s>Hari</s>,

children.text: dadarśa puratas tātaṃ brahmāṇaṃ sakumārakam // Jss_1,2.9 //
children.translated_text: and before him he saw his father <s>Brahmā</s>, accompanied by <s>Kumāra</s> (<s>Sanatkumāra</s>). // Jss 1.2.9 //

children.text: nanāma sahasā mūrdhnā pitaraṃ taṃ sahodaram /
children.translated_text: He quickly bowed his head to his father and brother,

children.text: pādyam arghyaṃ ca pradadau javena sādaraṃ muniḥ // Jss_1,2.10 //
children.translated_text: and the sage swiftly offered foot-water (<s>pādya</s>) and water of honor (<s>arghya</s>) with respect. // Jss 1.2.10 //

children.text: śloka-dvayārthaṃ papraccha kumāraṃ jagatāṃ vidhim /
children.translated_text: He asked the meaning of the two verses to <s>Kumāra</s>, the creator of worlds,

children.text: sukhāsīnaṃ susthiraṃ ca sasmitaṃ ca gata-śramam // Jss_1,2.11 //
children.translated_text: who was comfortably seated, steady, smiling, and free from fatigue, // Jss 1.2.11 //

children.text: svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇa-kāmaṃ jñānināṃ ca guror gurum /
children.translated_text: self-delighting, of fulfilled desires, the teacher of teachers among the wise —

children.text: sāśru-netraḥ pulakito bhaktyā praṇata-kandharam // Jss_1,2.12 //
children.translated_text: with tear-filled eyes, hair standing on end, his neck bowed in devotion. // Jss 1.2.12 //

children.text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā taṃ kātaraṃ vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard <s>Nārada</s>'s words and seeing his distress, <s>Brahmā</s>,

children.text: putreṇa sārddham ālocya vyākhyāṃ kartuṃ samārebhe // Jss_1,2.13 //
children.translated_text: having deliberated with his son, began to give the explanation. // Jss 1.2.13 //

body.translated_text: Now, the meaning of the celestial voice.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: he vatsa pūrva-ślokārthaṃ nigūḍhaṃ śruti-sammatam /
children.translated_text: O dear son, the meaning of the previous verse is secret and approved by the <s>Śruti</s>;

children.text: vedārthaṃ dvi-vidhaṃ śuddhaṃ vyākhyāṃ kurvanti vaidikāḥ // Jss_1,2.14 //
children.translated_text: the Vedic scholars explain the meaning of the <s>Vedas</s> as twofold and pure. // Jss 1.2.14 //

children.text: ārādhito yadi harir yena puṃsā sva-bhaktitaḥ /
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> has been worshipped by a person through his own devotion,

children.text: kiṃ tasya tapasā vyarthaṃ tīrtha-pūtasya nārada // Jss_1,2.15 //
children.translated_text: what use is austerity for him who is purified by the holy place, O <s>Nārada</s>? // Jss 1.2.15 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-mantropāsakasya jīvan-muktasya bhārate /
children.translated_text: For one who worships the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>mantra</s>, for one liberated while living (<s>jīvanmukta</s>) in <s>Bhārata</s>,

children.text: tapaś copahāsa-bījaṃ tathā carvita-carvaṇam // Jss_1,2.16 //
children.translated_text: austerity is a cause for mockery, and like chewing what has already been chewed. // Jss 1.2.16 //

children.text: mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ suta /
children.translated_text: By merely receiving the <s>mantra</s>, a hundred persons, O son,

children.text: punāti sva-sva-bhaktaṃ ca cāndhavaṃś cāvalīlayā // Jss_1,2.17 //
children.translated_text: are purified — including one's own devotee and one's family — effortlessly. // Jss 1.2.17 //

children.text: nahi dharmo nahi tapaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevanāt param /
children.translated_text: There is no <s>dharma</s>, there is no austerity superior to the service of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: pariśramaṃ ca viphalaṃ tapasā vaiṣṇavasya ca // Jss_1,2.18 //
children.translated_text: austerity is fruitless labor for a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>. // Jss 1.2.18 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-mantropāsakasya tīrtha-pūtasya putraka /
children.translated_text: For one who worships the <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>mantra</s>, purified by the sacred site, O dear son,

children.text: tīrtha-snānam anaśanaṃ vedeṣu ca viḍambanam // Jss_1,2.19 //
children.translated_text: bathing at <s>tīrthas</s> and fasting are but mockery compared to the <s>Vedas</s>. // Jss 1.2.19 //

children.text: pūrva-karmānurodhena yat pāpaṃ vaiṣṇavasya ca /
children.translated_text: Whatever sin adheres to a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> due to prior <s>karma</s>,

children.text: mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa naṣṭaṃ vahnau yathā tṛṇam // Jss_1,2.20 //
children.translated_text: by merely receiving the <s>mantra</s>, it is destroyed like grass in fire. // Jss 1.2.20 //

children.text: pavitraḥ paramo vahniḥ pavitraṃ cāmalaṃ jalaṃ /
children.translated_text: Sacred is the supreme fire, sacred is pure water,

children.text: pavitraṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ yat tulasī-dalam // Jss_1,2.21 //
children.translated_text: sacred is the land of <s>Bhārata</s>, sacred is a <s>Tulasī</s> leaf as a <s>tīrtha</s>. // Jss 1.2.21 //

children.text: punāti līlayaitāni śuddhaḥ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: One who is pure and devoted to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> purifies all these effortlessly;

children.text: upasparśa ca bhaktasyāpy ete vāñcchanti sādaram // Jss_1,2.22 //
children.translated_text: these [sacred things] eagerly desire the touch of a devotee. // Jss 1.2.22 //

children.text: bhaktasya pāda-rajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā /
children.translated_text: By the dust of a devotee's feet, the earth is instantly purified;

children.text: nahi pūta-stri-bhuvane śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevakāt paraḥ // Jss_1,2.23 //
children.translated_text: there is none greater in the three worlds than a servant of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss 1.2.23 //

children.text: śāligrāma-śilā-cakre karoti kṛṣṇa-pūjanam /
children.translated_text: He who performs the worship of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> with a <s>Śālagrāma</s> stone and disc,

children.text: tat-pādodaka-naivedyaṃ nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yaḥ pumān // Jss_1,2.24 //
children.translated_text: and daily partakes of His foot-water and food-offerings — // Jss 1.2.24 //

children.text: sa vaiṣṇavo mahā-pūtas tan-mantropāsakaḥ śuciḥ /
children.translated_text: he is a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, supremely pure, a worshipper of His <s>mantra</s>, ritually clean;

children.text: punāti puṃsāṃ śatakaṃ janma-mātrāt sabāndhavam // Jss_1,2.25 //
children.translated_text: from the very fact of his birth, he purifies a hundred persons along with their families. // Jss 1.2.25 //

children.text: vatsa ślokasyaika-pādaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca yathāgamam /
children.translated_text: O child, one quarter of the verse has been explained according to scripture;

children.text: vyākhyātaṃ karomy anya-pādaṃ yathājñānaṃ miśāmaya // Jss_1,2.26 //
children.translated_text: I shall now explain the other quarter according to my understanding — listen. // Jss 1.2.26 //

children.text: nārādhito yadi harir yena puṃsādhamena ca /
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> has not been worshipped by a person, that lowest of beings,

children.text: kiṃ tasya tapasā vyarthaṃ niṣphalaṃ tat-pariśramaḥ // Jss_1,2.27 //
children.translated_text: what use is his austerity? Fruitless is his effort. // Jss 1.2.27 //

children.text: vratāny eva hi dānāni tapāṃsy anaśanāni ca /
children.translated_text: Vows indeed, and gifts, austerities and fasts,

children.text: vedopayuktā yajñāś ca karmāṇi ca śubhāni ca /
children.translated_text: sacrifices employing the <s>Vedas</s>, and auspicious deeds —

children.text: na niṣpunāty abhaktaṃ ca surākumbham ivāpagā // Jss_1,2.28 //
children.translated_text: none of these purify one who lacks devotion, just as a river [cannot purify] a pot of liquor. // Jss 1.2.28 //

children.text: abhakta-sparśa-mātreṇa tīrthāni kampitāni ca /
children.translated_text: By the mere touch of a non-devotee, sacred sites tremble;

children.text: abhakta-bhāra-duḥkhena kampitā sā vasundharā // Jss_1,2.29 //
children.translated_text: the earth trembles under the burden of a non-devotee's weight. // Jss 1.2.29 //

children.text: ślokārdhaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kiṃcid eva yathāgamam /
children.translated_text: Half the verse has been told, O child, briefly according to scripture;

children.text: tasyārdhasyāpi vyākhyānaṃ karomīti niśāmaya // Jss_1,2.30 //
children.translated_text: I shall now explain the other half — listen. // Jss 1.2.30 //

children.text: veda-sāraṃ kṛṣṇa-mataṃ mamāpi nahi kalpanā /
children.translated_text: This is the essence of the <s>Vedas</s>, the doctrine of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — it is not my own invention.

children.text: antar bahir yadi hair yeṣāṃ puṃsāṃ mahātmanāṃ // Jss_1,2.31 //
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> is within and without for those great-souled persons, // Jss 1.2.31 //

children.text: svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvat tapas teṣāṃ ca niṣphalam /
children.translated_text: for them, in dream and in waking, perpetually, austerity is fruitless;

children.text: sa eva viṣṇu-tulyo hi tad-aṃśo bhārate mune // Jss_1,2.32 //
children.translated_text: he is indeed equal to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, a portion of Him in <s>Bhārata</s>, O sage. // Jss 1.2.32 //

children.text: tasya rakṣā-nibandhena tad-abhyāse sudarśanam /
children.translated_text: For his protection, the <s>Sudarśana</s> [disc] is near him for the practice [of devotion];

children.text: dhyāna-mātreṇa niṣ-pāpaḥ punāti bhuvana-trayam // Jss_1,2.33 //
children.translated_text: by meditation alone he is freed from sin and purifies the three worlds. // Jss 1.2.33 //

children.text: datvā cakraṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ na niścinto janārdanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having given the disc for his protection, <s>Janārdana</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>) is not content;

children.text: svayaṃ tan nikaṭaṃ yāti draṣṭuṃ rakṣaṇāya ca // Jss_1,2.34 //
children.translated_text: He Himself goes near him to see and to protect him. // Jss 1.2.34 //

children.text: tat-paro hi priyo nāsti kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: There is no one dearer to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the Supreme Self, than such a devotee;

children.text: nahi bhaktāt paraś cātmā prāṇāś cāvayavādayaḥ /
children.translated_text: dearer than [His own] Self, dearer than [His own] life-breath and limbs,

children.text: na lakṣmī rādhikā vāṇī svayaṃbhuḥ śambhur eva ca // Jss_1,2.35 //
children.translated_text: dearer than <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>Rādhikā</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, or <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva). // Jss 1.2.35 //

children.text: bhakta-prāṇo hi kṛṣṇaś ca kṛṣṇa-prāṇā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ /
children.translated_text: The devotee is the life-breath of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is the life-breath of the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>;

children.text: dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaś ca vaiṣṇavāṃs tathā // Jss_1,2.36 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> meditate on <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> likewise meditates on the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>. // Jss 1.2.36 //

children.text: vyākhyātam ca tri-pādaṃ ca he munīndra yathāgamam /
children.translated_text: Three quarters have been explained, O chief of sages, according to scripture;

children.text: śeṣa-pādasya vyākhyānaṃ karomīti niśāmaya // Jss_1,2.37 //
children.translated_text: I shall now explain the remaining quarter — listen. // Jss 1.2.37 //

children.text: nāntar bahir yadi harir yeṣāṃ puṃsāṃ ca nārada /
children.translated_text: If <s>Hari</s> is neither within nor without for those persons, O <s>Nārada</s>,

children.text: teṣām api tapo vyartham antar-malina-cetasāṃ // Jss_1,2.38 //
children.translated_text: then their austerity too is fruitless, for their minds are defiled within. // Jss 1.2.38 //

children.text: kiṃ taj-jñānena tapasā vratena niyamena ca /
children.translated_text: What use is their knowledge, austerity, vows, or observances?

children.text: tīrtha-snānena puṇyenāpi abhakta-mūḍha-cetasāṃ // Jss_1,2.39 //
children.translated_text: What use is bathing at <s>tīrthas</s> or merit for non-devotees of deluded minds? // Jss 1.2.39 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-bhakti-vihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco mahān /
children.translated_text: Greater than <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> devoid of devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> is an outcaste (<s>śvapaca</s>),

children.text: śūkaro mleccha-nivahaḥ sva-dharmācareṇa ca // Jss_1,2.40 //
children.translated_text: or a pig, or a host of barbarians (<s>mlecchas</s>), who practice their own <s>dharma</s>. // Jss 1.2.40 //

children.text: sva-dharma-hīnā viprāś cāpy abhakṣya-bhakṣaṇena ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> who are devoid of their own <s>dharma</s>, who eat forbidden food,

children.text: nityaṃ nityaṃ vidharmeṇa patitāḥ śvapacādhamāḥ // Jss_1,2.41 //
children.translated_text: who constantly practice <s>adharma</s> — they are fallen, lower than outcastes. // Jss 1.2.41 //

children.text: brahmaṇānāṃ sva-dharmaś ca santataṃ kṛṣṇa-sevanam /
children.translated_text: The <s>dharma</s> of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> is the constant service of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: nityaṃ te bhuñjate santas tan-naivedyaṃ pādodakam // Jss_1,2.42 //
children.translated_text: the virtuous always partake of His food-offerings and foot-water. // Jss 1.2.42 //

children.text: na datvā haraye yas tu yadi bhuṅkte dvijādhamaḥ /
children.translated_text: A lowly <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who eats without first offering to <s>Hari</s> —

children.text: annaṃ viṣṭhā-samaṃ mūtra-samaṃ toyaṃ vidur budhāḥ // Jss_1,2.43 //
children.translated_text: the wise know his food to be like excrement and his water like urine. // Jss 1.2.43 //

children.text: bhuṅkte sva-bhakṣyaṃ kolaś ca mlecchaś ca śvapacādhamaḥ /
children.translated_text: A boar eats its own food, a barbarian and a low outcaste eat their own food,

children.text: vipro nityam abhakṣyaṃ ca bhuṅkte ca patitas tataḥ // Jss_1,2.44 //
children.translated_text: but a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> who constantly eats forbidden food — he is fallen thereby. // Jss 1.2.44 //

children.text: ślokam ekaṃ ca vyākhyātaṃ yathā-jñānaṃ ca nārada /
children.translated_text: One verse has been explained according to my understanding, O <s>Nārada</s>;

children.text: sannibodha parasyārdhaṃ vyākhyānaṃ ca yathocitaṃ // Jss_1,2.45 //
children.translated_text: now understand the explanation of the other half as is fitting. // Jss 1.2.45 //

children.text: tapaso virama brahman vyarthaṃ bhakta-tapo dhruvam /
children.translated_text: Cease from austerity, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>! Austerity is certainly fruitless for a devotee.

children.text: śaṅkaraś ca guruṃ kṛtvā hari-bhaktiṃ labhāciram // Jss_1,2.46 //
children.translated_text: Making <s>Śaṅkara</s> (Śiva) your <s>Guru</s>, quickly obtain devotion to <s>Hari</s>! // Jss 1.2.46 //

children.text: supakvā hari-bhaktiś ca taraṇī bhava-tāraṇe /
children.translated_text: Well-ripened devotion to <s>Hari</s> is the vessel for crossing the ocean of worldly existence;

children.text: gurur eva paraṃ brahma karṇa-dhāra-svarūpakaḥ // Jss_1,2.47 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Guru</s> himself is the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>, in the form of the helmsman. // Jss 1.2.47 //

children.text: ity evam uktvā tvāṃ devī prajagāma sarasvatī /
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus to you, the Goddess <s>Sarasvatī</s> departed;

children.text: vyākhyātas tad-abhiprāyaḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te // Jss_1,2.48 //
children.translated_text: her intended meaning has been explained — what more shall I tell you? // Jss 1.2.48 //

children.text: brahmāṇaś ca vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa yogināṃ guruḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of <s>Brahmā</s>, the teacher of yogins

children.text: sanat-kumāro bhagavān uvāca pitaraṃ śuka // Jss_1,2.49 //
children.translated_text: — the venerable <s>Sanatkumāra</s> — laughed and said to his father, O <s>Śuka</s>: // Jss 1.2.49 //

children.text: sanat-kumāra uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:

children.text: pūrva-ślokasya vyākhyānaṃ na buddhaṃ śiśunā mayā /
children.translated_text: The explanation of the previous verse was not understood by me, a child;

children.text: putraṃ śiṣyam abodhaṃ ca yuktaṃ bodhayitum punaḥ // Jss_1,2.50 //
children.translated_text: but it is fitting to enlighten an ignorant son and disciple once more. // Jss 1.2.50 //

children.text: ārādhito harir yena tasya vyarthaṃ tapo yadi /
children.translated_text: If austerity is fruitless for one by whom <s>Hari</s> has been worshipped,

children.text: nārādhito hair yena tasya vyartaṃ tapo yadi // Jss_1,2.51 //
children.translated_text: and if austerity is also fruitless for one by whom <s>Hari</s> has not been worshipped, // Jss 1.2.51 //

children.text: tasyārahitau tau dvau tapasaś ca sthalaṃ kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: then in both cases of worship and non-worship, where is the place for austerity?

children.text: tapaḥ kurvanti ye tāta tvaṃ māṃ bodhaya bālakam // Jss_1,2.52 //
children.translated_text: Those who perform austerity, father — enlighten me, a child! // Jss 1.2.52 //

children.text: putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sandigdho jagatāṃ guruḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard his son's words, the teacher of the worlds was perplexed;

children.text: dadhyau kṛṣṇa-padāmbhojaṃ paraṃ kalpa-taruṃ śuka // Jss_1,2.53 //
children.translated_text: he meditated on the lotus feet of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the supreme wish-fulfilling tree, O <s>Śuka</s>. // Jss 1.2.53 //

children.text: kṣaṇaṃ saṃcitya pādābjaṃ prāpa rāddhāntam īpsitam /
children.translated_text: Having contemplated the lotus feet for a moment, he arrived at the desired conclusion —

children.text: vyākhyāṃ kartuṃ samārebhe vidhātā jagatām api // Jss_1,2.54 //
children.translated_text: The creator of the worlds began to expound the explanation. // Jss_1,2.54 //

body.translated_text: Now, the praise of <s>naivedya</s> (food offered to the Lord).

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: dhanyo 'haṃ bhavataḥ putrāt jñānināṃ ca guror guroḥ /
children.translated_text: Blessed am I because of your son, who is the teacher of teachers among the wise,

children.text: viṣṇu-bhaktāc ca dharmiṣṭhāt sat-putrāc ca pitā sukhī // Jss_1,2.55 //
children.translated_text: A father is happy through a son who is a devotee of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, most righteous, and virtuous. // Jss_1,2.55 //

children.text: dhanyo 'si paṇḍito 'si tvaṃ hari-bhakto 'si putraka /
children.translated_text: You are blessed, you are learned, you are a devotee of <s>Hari</s>, O child,

children.text: mamāpi saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ ca tvayā budha // Jss_1,2.56 //
children.translated_text: Even my birth and life have become fruitful because of you, O wise one. // Jss_1,2.56 //

children.text: nibodha pūrva-ślokārthaṃ punar vyākhyāṃ karomi ca /
children.translated_text: Understand the meaning of the previous verse; I shall explain it again,

children.text: tathāpi cen na santoṣo bhavān vyākhyāṃ kariṣyati // Jss_1,2.57 //
children.translated_text: And if even then you are not satisfied, you may give the explanation yourself. // Jss_1,2.57 //

children.text: āśabdaḥ samyag-arthe ca rādhitaḥ prāpta-vācakaḥ /
children.translated_text: The prefix 'ā' conveys the sense of 'completely,' and 'rādhitaḥ' means 'attained';

children.text: saṃprāptaś ca harir yena vyarthas tasya tapaḥ-śramaḥ // Jss_1,2.58 //
children.translated_text: For one who has fully attained <s>Hari</s>, the toil of austerities is rendered purposeless. // Jss_1,2.58 //

children.text: yena samyak-prakāreṇa saṃprāpto harir īśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: One who has completely attained <s>Hari</s>, the Lord,

children.text: svapne jñāne ca jñātas teṣāṃ vyarthas tapaḥ-śramaḥ // Jss_1,2.59 //
children.translated_text: And has known Him in dream or in waking knowledge — for such persons the toil of austerities is futile. // Jss_1,2.59 //

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-vimukhaṃ mūḍhaṃ dvijam eva narādhamam /
children.translated_text: A foolish <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who has turned away from <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, the lowest of men —

children.text: tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tāpaḥ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ naiva punāti tam // Jss_1,2.60 //
children.translated_text: Neither pilgrimage, charity, penance, merit, nor vows can purify him. // Jss_1,2.60 //

children.text: yaś ca mūḍhatamo loke yaś ca bhaktiṃ parāṃ gataḥ /
children.translated_text: He who is the most foolish in the world and he who has attained supreme devotion —

children.text: tāv ubhau sukha-sedhete tapaḥ kurvanti madhyamāḥ // Jss_1,2.61 //
children.translated_text: Both these enjoy happiness, while those in the middle perform austerities. // Jss_1,2.61 //

children.text: devān anyāṃś ca bhajate hariṃ jānāti tat-paraḥ /
children.translated_text: One who worships other gods yet knows <s>Hari</s> and is devoted to Him,

children.text: tapaḥ karoti taṃ prāptum ākāṅkṣan madhyamo janaḥ // Jss_1,2.62 //
children.translated_text: And performs austerities desiring to attain Him — such a person is of the middling sort. // Jss_1,2.62 //

children.text: prāktanād anurāgī ca gṛhī saṃsāra-saṃvṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: Due to past <s>karma</s> (destiny), a householder attached to worldly life and enveloped in <s>saṃsāra</s>,

children.text: tapaḥ karoti śrī-kṛṣṇa-pāda-padmārtham īpsitam // Jss_1,2.63 //
children.translated_text: Performs austerities for the desired lotus feet of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss_1,3.63 //

children.text: paraṃ śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajanaṃ dhyānaṃ tan-nāma-kīrtanam /
children.translated_text: Supreme is the worship of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, meditation, the chanting of His name,

children.text: tat-pādodaka-naivedya-bhakṣaṇaṃ sarva-vāñcchitam // Jss_1,2.64 //
children.translated_text: And the partaking of His <s>pādodaka</s> (foot-water) and <s>naivedya</s> (sacred food offering) — this fulfills all desires. // Jss_1,2.64 //

children.text: atīva mūḍho vipraś ca prāktanād guru-doṣataḥ /
children.translated_text: An exceedingly foolish <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, due to past <s>karma</s> and the fault of a bad teacher,

children.text: tāmaso hi na jānāti śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ tri-guṇāt param // Jss_1,2.65 //
children.translated_text: Being of <s>tāmasic</s> (dark, ignorant) nature, does not know <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> who is beyond the three <s>guṇas</s>. // Jss_1,2.65 //

children.text: ajñānād atha vā jñānāt sat-saṅgād eva prāktanāt /
children.translated_text: Whether through ignorance or through knowledge, through the company of the virtuous or through past merit,

children.text: bhuṅkte naivedyaṃ īśasya kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ // Jss_1,2.66 //
children.translated_text: One who partakes of the <s>naivedya</s> of Lord <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self) — // Jss_1,2.66 //

children.text: sa ca mukto bhavet putra mucyate sarva-pātakāt /
children.translated_text: He becomes liberated, O son, and is freed from all sins;

children.text: sa yāti divya-yānena golokaṃ lokam uttamam // Jss_1,2.67 //
children.translated_text: He goes by a divine vehicle to <s>Goloka</s>, the highest abode. // Jss_1,2.67 //

children.text: śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi pūrvākhyānaṃ purātanam /
children.translated_text: Listen, dear child, I shall narrate an ancient tale of old,

children.text: atīva suśravaṃ cāru madhuraṃ muktidaṃ param // Jss_1,2.68 //
children.translated_text: Most excellent to hear, beautiful, sweet, and supremely bestowing liberation. // Jss_1,2.68 //

children.text: kānyakubjaḥ sukṣubdhaś ca brāhmaṇo grāma-yājakaḥ /
children.translated_text: In <s>Kānyakubja</s> there was a wretched <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, a village priest,

children.text: devalo vṛṣa-vāhaś ca mahā-mūḍhaś ca pātakī // Jss_1,2.69 //
children.translated_text: A <s>devala</s> (temple attendant of low standing), one who rode bulls, exceedingly foolish and sinful. // Jss_1,2.69 //

children.text: svapne jñāne na jānāti puṇyaṃ vā kṛṣṇa-pūjanam /
children.translated_text: Neither in dream nor in waking did he know merit or the worship of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: kṛṣṇa-bhakta-sahālāpa-darśana-sparśanaṃ śubhaṃ // Jss_1,2.70 //
children.translated_text: Nor the auspicious conversation with, sight of, or touch of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s devotees. // Jss_1,2.70 //

children.text: babhūva prāktanāt tasya kṣaṇa-mātraṃ sudurlabham /
children.translated_text: Due to his past merit, an extremely rare moment came to him,

children.text: tena puṇyena naivedyaṃ lebhe kṛṣṇasya brāhmaṇaḥ // Jss_1,2.71 //
children.translated_text: And by that merit the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> obtained the <s>naivedya</s> of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss_1,2.71 //

children.text: pituḥ puṇyena putraś ca mārge patitam alpakam /
children.translated_text: By the merit of his father, his son found on the road a small portion,

children.text: svayaṃ bhuktāvaśeṣaṃ ca patitaṃ vaiṣṇavāj janāt // Jss_1,2.72 //
children.translated_text: The remnants of food that had fallen from a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> devotee who had already eaten. // Jss_1,2.72 //

children.text: susnigdhākṣata-jīrṇaṃ ca rajasā miśritaṃ param /
children.translated_text: It was well-oiled, mixed with decayed rice and covered with dust,

children.text: gacchatas tatra viprasya patitaṃ bhakṣya-vastu ca // Jss_1,2.73 //
children.translated_text: The edible morsel that had fallen in the path of that <s>brāhmaṇa</s> as he was walking. // Jss_1,2.73 //

children.text: naivedyopari kṛṣṇasya tvarāyuktasya putraka /
children.translated_text: It had fallen upon the <s>naivedya</s> of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> while being carried in haste, O child;

children.text: tad-vastu bhuktaṃ vipreṇa kṛṣṇa-naivedya-miśritam // Jss_1,2.74 //
children.translated_text: That food, mixed with <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>naivedya</s>, was eaten by the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. // Jss_1,2.74 //

children.text: saputreṇa kṣudhārtena tau yayatur gṛham /
children.translated_text: Together with his son, afflicted by hunger, the two went home;

children.text: viprocchiṣṭaṃ ca bubhuje tasya patnī pati-vratā // Jss_1,2.75 //
children.translated_text: His faithful wife, devoted to her husband, ate the leftovers of the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. // Jss_1,2.75 //

children.text: paramparānusaṃbandhāt pavitrā sā babhūva ha /
children.translated_text: Through this successive connection, she too became purified;

children.text: jīvan-mukto brāhmaṇaś ca babhūva sa saputrakaḥ // Jss_1,2.76 //
children.translated_text: The <s>brāhmaṇa</s> together with his son became liberated while still living. // Jss_1,2.76 //

children.text: kālena tena puṇyena vyāghra-bhuktaś ca kānane /
children.translated_text: In time, by that merit, though devoured by a tiger in the forest,

children.text: sārdhaṃ ca vyāghra-putrābhyāṃ golokaṃ prayayau dvija /
children.translated_text: Together with two tiger cubs, the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> went to <s>Goloka</s>;

children.text: pati-vratā saha-mṛtā bhartā sārdhaṃ jagāma sā // Jss_1,2.77 //
children.translated_text: His faithful wife, dying alongside her husband, went together with him. // Jss_1,2.77 //

body.text: iti śrī-nārada-pañca-rātre jñānāmṛta-sāre prathamaika-rātre brahma-sanat-kumāra-saṃvāde naivedya-praśaṃsanaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the second chapter, called 'The Praise of <s>Naivedya</s>,' in the dialogue between <s>Brahmā</s> and <s>Sanatkumāra</s>, in the <s>Jñānāmṛtasāra</s> of the <s>Śrī Nārada Pañcarātra</s>, in the first night.
Third chapter in the first night.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:

children.text: aho tāta kim āścaryaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Oh father, how wondrous is the glory of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self)!

children.text: paraṃ naivedya-māhātmyaṃ vistarād vada sāmpratam // Jss_1,3.1 //
children.translated_text: Tell me now in detail the supreme greatness of <s>naivedya</s>. // Jss_1,3.1 //

body.translated_text: Now, the description of the glory of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>.

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: ekadā brāhmaṇo hṛṣṭaḥ praphulla-vadanekṣaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Once there was a joyful <s>brāhmaṇa</s> with a beaming face and bright eyes,

children.text: putreṇa sārdhaṃ prayayau bāndhavasya gṛhaṃ mudā // Jss_1,3.2 //
children.translated_text: Who set out happily with his son to the house of a kinsman. // Jss_1,3.2 //

children.text: nimantrito vivāhena mahā-saṃbhāra-saṃbhṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: Invited to a wedding, lavishly provisioned,

children.text: bhuktvā pītvā ca tad-gṛhe sva-gṛhaṃ prayayau mudā // Jss_1,3.3 //
children.translated_text: Having eaten and drunk at that house, he set out happily toward his own home. // Jss_1,3.3 //

children.text: saputro brāhmaṇo mārge kṣut-pipāsārditaḥ sutaḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>brāhmaṇa</s> with his son was on the road; the son, tormented by hunger and thirst,

children.text: dadarśa candra-bhāgāṃ tāṃ nadīm ati-manoharām // Jss_1,3.4 //
children.translated_text: Beheld the <s>Candrabhāgā</s> river, most enchanting. // Jss_1,3.4 //

children.text: uvāca putraḥ pitraṃ snātvā bhokṣyāmi ceti bhoḥ /
children.translated_text: The son said: 'Father, I shall bathe and then eat!

children.text: kṣut-pipāsā balavatī vardhate tāta vartmani // Jss_1,3.5 //
children.translated_text: My hunger and thirst grow powerful on the road, O father.' // Jss_1,3.5 //

children.text: putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tam uvāca dvijaḥ svayam /
children.translated_text: Hearing his son's words, the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> himself replied:

children.text: bhayaṃkaraṃ vanam idaṃ samīpe saritaḥ sutaḥ // Jss_1,3.6 //
children.translated_text: 'This fearsome forest is near the river, son. // Jss_1,3.6 //

children.text: suśīghraṃ gaccha grāmāntaṃ puro ramya-sarovaram /
children.translated_text: Go quickly to the edge of the village; ahead is a lovely lake.

children.text: tatra snātvā ca bhokṣyāvo gaccha vatsa yathāsukham // Jss_1,3.7 //
children.translated_text: We shall bathe and eat there. Go, child, at your ease.' // Jss_1,3.7 //

children.text: tātasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa ca cukopa ha /
children.translated_text: Hearing his father's words, the boy laughed and grew angry,

children.text: pitaraṃ vaktum ārebhe rakta-paṇgkaja-locanaḥ // Jss_1,3.8 //
children.translated_text: And the lotus-red-eyed one began to speak to his father. // Jss_1,3.8 //

children.text: śiśur uvāca
children.translated_text: The child said:

children.text: bālo 'haṃ daśa-varṣīyas tvaṃ ca vṛddhaś ca jñānadaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'I am a boy of ten years, and you are old and a giver of knowledge;

children.text: pitā dadāti putrāya jñānaṃ sarvatra bhū-tale // Jss_1,3.9 //
children.translated_text: A father imparts knowledge to his son everywhere on this earth. // Jss_1,3.9 //

children.text: aho duratyayaḥ kālo vṛdhho vadati bālavat /
children.translated_text: Alas, insurmountable is fate — the old man speaks like a child!

children.text: kathaṃ prāktanam ullaṅghya brūhi tāta duratyayam // Jss_1,3.10 //
children.translated_text: How can one transgress what is destined? Tell me, father, about the insurmountable. // Jss_1,3.10 //

children.text: prāktanāt sukha-duḥkhaṃ ca rogaṃ śokaṃ bhayaṃ pitaḥ /
children.translated_text: From past <s>karma</s> come happiness and sorrow, disease, grief, and fear, O father,

children.text: sumṛtyur apamṛtyur vā cirāyur alpa-jīvanaḥ // Jss_1,3.11 //
children.translated_text: A good death or an untimely death, long life or short life. // Jss_1,3.11 //

children.text: yatra kāle ca yan-mṛtyur bhavanaṃ śubha-karma ca /
children.translated_text: At whatever time and by whatever means death comes, or auspicious deeds occur,

children.text: nyūnādhikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ nāsti niṣekaḥ kena vāryate // Jss_1,3.12 //
children.translated_text: Not a moment more or less is there — who can obstruct what is destined? // Jss_1,3.12 //

children.text: yasya haste ca yan-mṛtyur vidhātrā likhitaḥ purā /
children.translated_text: By whose hand death has been written by the Creator long ago,

children.text: na ca taṃ khaṇḍituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇuś ca śaṅkaraḥ // Jss_1,3.13 //
children.translated_text: Even <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Śaṅkara</s> themselves are unable to alter it. // Jss_1,3.13 //

children.text: tāta vyartham adhītaṃ te durbuddher janma niṣphalam /
children.translated_text: Father, your learning has been in vain; the birth of the dull-witted is fruitless.

children.text: subuddheḥ saphalaṃ janma tat-kṣaṇam jīvanaṃ sukham // Jss_1,3.14 //
children.translated_text: The birth of the wise-minded is fruitful; even a moment of their life is blissful. // Jss_1,3.14 //

children.text: yena śuklī-kṛtā haṃsāḥ śukāś ca haritī-kṛtāḥ /
children.translated_text: He by whom swans were made white, parrots were made green,

children.text: mayūrāś citritā yena sa me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati // Jss_1,3.15 //
children.translated_text: And peacocks were painted with colors — He shall protect me. // Jss_1,3.15 //

children.text: yena kṛṣṇena viśvāni cāsaṃkhyāni kṛtāni ca /
children.translated_text: He, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, by whom innumerable worlds were created,

children.text: carācaraṃ ca yo rakṣet sa me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati // Jss_1,3.16 //
children.translated_text: He who protects all that is moving and unmoving — He shall protect me. // Jss_1,3.16 //

children.text: ghorāraṇye sukhaṃ śete yo hi kṛṣṇena rakṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: One who is protected by <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> sleeps peacefully in a dreadful forest,

children.text: nirbandho 'pi yasya maraṇaṃ tasya mandire // Jss_1,3.17 //
children.translated_text: While one whose death is certain perishes even in his own home. // Jss_1,3.17 //

children.text: yaḥ śete nāga-śayyāsu prāktanān maṅgalāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: He who sleeps on serpent-beds, blessed with auspiciousness due to past merit,

children.text: yo nāga-bhakṣito bhogāt sa bhṛto garuḍāntike // Jss_1,3.18 //
children.translated_text: And he who is devoured by a serpent despite his enjoyments — he is sustained near <s>Garuḍa</s>. // Jss_1,3.18 //

children.text: na samudre ca mriyate nāgni-rāśau viṣānale /
children.translated_text: One does not die in the ocean, nor in a mass of fire or poisonous flames,

children.text: na śastreṇa na cāstreṇāyur-marmāṇi rakṣati // Jss_1,3.19 //
children.translated_text: Nor by weapon, nor by missile — one's vital points are protected as long as one's lifespan endures. // Jss_1,3.19 //

children.text: nāprāpta-kālo mriyate viddhaḥ śara-śatair api /
children.translated_text: One whose time has not come does not die even when pierced by hundreds of arrows,

children.text: tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāpta-kālo na jīvati // Jss_1,3.20 //
children.translated_text: But one whose time has come does not survive even when touched by the tip of a blade of grass. // Jss_1,3.20 //

children.text: kaścid garbhe ca mriyate kaścid bhūmiṣṭa-mātrataḥ /
children.translated_text: Someone dies in the womb, someone at the very moment of birth,

children.text: kaścid yauvana-kāle ca kaścid eva hi vārddhake // Jss_1,3.21 //
children.translated_text: Someone in the prime of youth, and someone indeed in old age. // Jss_1,3.21 //

children.text: kaścid cirāyu rogī cāpy arogī cāpi kaścana /
children.translated_text: Someone lives long yet is diseased, while another is free from illness;

children.text: kaścid dhanī daridraś ca kaścid eva hi karmaṇā // Jss_1,3.22 //
children.translated_text: Someone is wealthy and someone poor — all indeed by <s>karma</s>. // Jss_1,3.22 //

children.text: kaścit kalpānta-jīvī ca cira-jīvī ca kaścana /
children.translated_text: Someone lives until the end of a <s>kalpa</s> (cosmic age), someone lives long;

children.text: prāktanād amaraḥ kaścin niṣeko balavattaraḥ // Jss_1,3.23 //
children.translated_text: Due to past <s>karma</s>, someone becomes immortal — destiny is most powerful. // Jss_1,3.23 //

children.text: kaścid yāti ca rājendro divya-yānena karmaṇā /
children.translated_text: Someone goes as a great king by a divine vehicle through his <s>karma</s>,

children.text: kaścit kīṭa-pataṅgeṣu kaścit paśvādi-yoniṣu // Jss_1,3.24 //
children.translated_text: Someone is born among insects and moths, someone in animal wombs. // Jss_1,3.24 //

children.text: kaścid eva hi sannyāsī kaścic ca nara-ghātakaḥ /
children.translated_text: Someone becomes a <s>sannyāsī</s> (renunciant), and someone a killer of men;

children.text: kaścid gajendra-gāmī ca paśu-yāyī ca kaścana // Jss_1,3.25 //
children.translated_text: Someone rides on a lordly elephant, and someone travels with beasts. // Jss_1,3.25 //

body.text: kaścid sūkṣmāṃśukā-dhārī kaścij jīrṇa-paṭī janaḥ // Jss_1,3.26 //
body.translated_text: Someone wears fine garments, while someone wears tattered rags. // Jss_1,3.26 //

children.text: kaścin nagno 'apy anāhārī sudhā-bhojī ca ca kaścana /
children.translated_text: Someone is naked and without food, while someone feasts on <s>sudhā</s> (ambrosia);

children.text: kaścic ca sundaraḥ śrīmān galat-kuṣṭī ca kaścana // Jss_1,3.27 //
children.translated_text: Someone is handsome and prosperous, while someone suffers from leprosy. // Jss_1,3.27 //

children.text: kaścit kubjaś cāṅga-hīno badhiraḥ kāṇa eva ca /
children.translated_text: Someone is hunchbacked, missing limbs, deaf, or one-eyed;

children.text: kaścid dīrgho madhyamaś ca kaścit khañjaś ca vāmanaḥ // Jss_1,3.28 //
children.translated_text: Someone is tall, someone of medium stature, someone lame and dwarfish. // Jss_1,3.28 //

children.text: kaścit kṛṣṇaś ca gauraś ca śyāmalaś ca sva-karmaṇā /
children.translated_text: Someone is dark, someone fair, someone dusky — each by their own <s>karma</s>;

children.text: kaścid bhaktyā ca prāpnoti kṛṣṇa-dāsyaṃ sudurlabham // Jss_1,3.29 //
children.translated_text: Someone through devotion attains the exceedingly rare servitude of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // Jss_1,3.29 //

children.text: brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ janma-mṛtyu-jarā-haram /
children.translated_text: The supreme abode of <s>Brahman</s>, which destroys birth, death, and old age —

children.text: kaścit prāpnoti paramaṃ brahma-lokaṃ nirāmayam // Jss_1,3.30 //
children.translated_text: Someone attains that supreme <s>Brahmaloka</s>, free from affliction. // Jss_1,3.30 //

children.text: kaścit svargam indra-padaṃ śiva-lokaṃ svakarmaṇā /
children.translated_text: Someone attains heaven, the seat of <s>Indra</s>, or <s>Śivaloka</s>, by their own <s>karma</s>;

children.text: kaścit vargam indra-lokaṃ yama-lokaṃ ca kaścana // Jss_1,3.31 //
children.translated_text: Someone attains <s>Indraloka</s>, someone <s>Yamaloka</s>. // Jss_1,3.31 //

children.text: kaścic ca narake ghore prāpnoti kleśam ulvaṇam /
children.translated_text: Someone in terrible hell endures excruciating torment,

children.text: tādito yama-dūtena kṣudhitas tṛṣitaḥ sadā // Jss_1,3.32 //
children.translated_text: Beaten by the messengers of <s>Yama</s>, perpetually hungry and thirsty. // Jss_1,3.32 //

children.text: bhuṅkte viṇ-mūtra-kīṭaṃ tan-malaṃ śleṣmaṃ garaṃ vasām /
children.translated_text: One eats excrement, urine, worms, filth, phlegm, poison, and fat,

children.text: kṣura-dhāre tapta-taile vahnau śite jale sthale // Jss_1,3.33 //
children.translated_text: On razor-edges, in boiling oil, in fire, in cold, in water, on land. // Jss_1,3.33 //

children.text: prāpnoti dāruṇaṃ duḥkham ākalpaṃ pātakī pitaḥ /
children.translated_text: The sinner endures terrible suffering until the end of a <s>kalpa</s>, O father,

children.text: tathā bhogāvaśeṣe ca labdhā janma sva-karmaṇā // Jss_1,3.34 //
children.translated_text: And then, when the remainder of the fruits of action is exhausted, obtains a new birth by one's own <s>karma</s>. // Jss_1,3.34 //

children.text: vyādhi-yuktaḥ pramucyeta tayā ced īśvarecchayā /
children.translated_text: One afflicted with disease may be freed if it be the will of the Lord;

children.text: yad-bhayād vāti vāto 'yaṃ sūryas tapati yad-bhayāt // Jss_1,3.35 //
children.translated_text: From fear of whom the wind blows, from fear of whom the sun gives heat, // Jss_1,3.35 //

children.text: varṣatīndro dahaty agnir mṛtyuś carati jantuṣu /
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> pours rain, fire burns, and death moves among creatures.

children.text: yasyājñayā sṛṣṭi-vidhau mūrmo 'nantaṃ dadhāti ca // Jss_1,3.36 //
children.translated_text: By whose command, at the time of creation, the tortoise bears <s>Ananta</s> (the infinite serpent), // Jss_1,3.36 //

children.text: sa ca sarvaṃ ca brahmāṇḍaṃ līlayā ceśvarecchayā /
children.translated_text: And He sustains the entire universe effortlessly, by the Lord's will;

children.text: yasyājñayā mahā-bhītā sarvādhārā vasundharā // Jss_1,3.37 //
children.translated_text: By whose command the greatly fearful earth, the support of all, // Jss_1,3.37 //

children.text: dharā sā sarvasyādyā ratnavāṃś ca himālayaḥ /
children.translated_text: That earth, the primordial support of all, and the jewel-bearing <s>Himālaya</s> —

children.text: svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavān dhyāyate yam ahar-niśam // Jss_1,3.38 //
children.translated_text: The Creator, the Blessed Lord Himself, meditates upon Him day and night. // Jss_1,3.38 //

children.text: yaṃ dhyāyate ca bhajate svayaṃ mṛtuñjayaḥ śivaḥ /
children.translated_text: Upon whom <s>Mṛtyuñjaya Śiva</s> (the conqueror of death) Himself meditates and worships,

children.text: sahasra-vaktro 'yaṃ stauti dhyāyate bhajate sadā // Jss_1,3.39 //
children.translated_text: Whom the thousand-headed <s>Śeṣa</s> praises, meditates upon, and worships constantly. // Jss_1,3.39 //

children.text: svayṃ sarasvatī stauti yam īśvaram abhīpsitam /
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s> herself praises that desired Lord,

children.text: sevate pāda-padmaṃ ca svayaṃ padmālayā pitaḥ // Jss_1,3.40 //
children.translated_text: And <s>Padmālayā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>, she who dwells in the lotus) herself serves His lotus feet, O father. // Jss_1,3.40 //

children.text: māyā bhītā ca yaṃ stauti durgā durgati-nāśinī /
children.translated_text: <s>Māyā</s>, the fearful one, praises Him — <s>Durgā</s>, the destroyer of misfortune;

children.text: stuvanti vedāḥ satataṃ sāvitrī veda-mātṛkā // Jss_1,3.41 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Vedas</s> praise Him constantly, and <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the mother of the <s>Vedas</s>. // Jss_1,3.41 //

children.text: siddhendrāś ca munīndrāś ca yogīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ /
children.translated_text: The lords of <s>Siddhas</s>, the lords of sages, the lords of <s>yogīs</s>, <s>Sanaka</s> and the others,

children.text: rājendrāś cāsurendrāś ca surendrā manavas tathā // Jss_1,3.42 //
children.translated_text: The lords of kings, the lords of <s>asuras</s>, the lords of gods, and the <s>Manus</s> likewise — // Jss_1,3.42 //

children.text: dhyāyante ca bhajante ca bhaktāḥ santo hi santatam /
children.translated_text: They meditate upon Him and worship Him, the devotees and saints, ever and always.

children.text: kecid vidanti yaṃ brahmāṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,3.43 //
children.translated_text: Some know Him as <s>Brahman</s>, the Blessed Lord, the eternal one; // Jss_1,3.43 //

children.text: kecit pradhānaṃ sarvādyaṃ kecic ca jyotir īśvaram /
children.translated_text: Some know Him as <s>Pradhāna</s> (primal matter), the source of all; some as the luminous Lord;

children.text: kecic ca sarva-rūpaṃ ca sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam // Jss_1,3.44 //
children.translated_text: Some as the one of all forms, the cause of all causes. // Jss_1,3.44 //

children.text: kecit svecchābhayaṃ rūpaṃ bhaktānugraha-vigraham /
children.translated_text: Some know His form as freely willed and fearless, an embodiment of grace toward devotees;

children.text: kecit suruciraṃ śyāma-sundaraṃ manoharam // Jss_1,3.45 //
children.translated_text: Some know Him as most beautiful, dark and charming, captivating the mind, // Jss_1,3.45 //

children.text: sānandaṃ paramānandaṃ govindaṃ nanda-nandanam /
children.translated_text: Full of bliss, supremely blissful, <s>Govinda</s>, the son of <s>Nanda</s>.

children.text: bhaja tāta paraṃ brahma smara śaśvat sureśvaram // Jss_1,3.46 //
children.translated_text: Worship, dear father, the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>; remember always the Lord of the gods. (Jss 1.3.46)
