children.text: pitā prayāti kāryārthaṃ viṣṇunā mohitas tathā // Jss_1,10.17 //
children.translated_text: the father departs for his purpose — deluded thus by <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // Jss_1,10.17 //

children.text: saṃsāra-kūpa-patito viṣṇunā prerito bhavān /
children.translated_text: You have fallen into the well of <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence), impelled by <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: na yuktaṃ patanaṃ tatra tad uddhāram abhīpsitam // Jss_1,10.18 //
children.translated_text: falling there is not fitting — upliftment from it is what is desired. // Jss_1,10.18 //

children.text: jñānī guruś ca balavān bhavābdheḥ śiṣyam uddharet /
children.translated_text: A knowledgeable and powerful <s>guru</s> should rescue the disciple from the ocean of existence;

children.text: guruḥ svayam asiddhaś ca durbalaḥ katham uddharet // Jss_1,10.19 //
children.translated_text: how can a <s>guru</s> who is himself unaccomplished and weak rescue [another]? // Jss_1,10.19 //

children.text: guror aty-avaliptasya kāryākāryam ajānataḥ /
children.translated_text: A <s>guru</s> who is excessively proud, who does not know what should and should not be done,

children.text: utpatha-pratipannasya parityāgo vidhīyate // Jss_1,10.20 //
children.translated_text: who has gone astray — abandoning him is prescribed. // Jss_1,10.20 //

children.text: sa guruḥ paramo vairī yo dadāti hy asan-matim /
children.translated_text: That <s>guru</s> is a supreme enemy who imparts false doctrine.

children.text: taṃ namas-kṛtya sat-śiṣyaḥ prayāti jñānadaṃ gurum // Jss_1,10.21 //
children.translated_text: Having bowed to him, a true disciple should go to a <s>guru</s> who gives knowledge. // Jss_1,10.21 //

children.text: saṃsāra-viṣayonmatto guru-rārtaḥ sva-karmaṇi /
children.translated_text: A <s>guru</s> maddened by worldly sense-objects, afflicted by his own <s>karma</s>,

children.text: durbalo durvahaṃ bhāraṃ dadāti janakāya ca // Jss_1,10.22 //
children.translated_text: weak — he places an unbearable burden on the father. // Jss_1,10.22 //

children.text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kruddhaḥ putram uvāca saḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of <s>Nārada</s>, he (<s>Brahmā</s>) became enraged and said to his son,

children.text: kampitas tamasā dhātā kopa-raktāsya-locanaḥ // Jss_1,10.23 //
children.translated_text: shaking with <s>tamas</s> (darkness), the Creator, his eyes reddened with anger: // Jss_1,10.23 //

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: jñānaṃ te bhavatu bhraṣṭaṃ strī-jito bhava pāmara /
children.translated_text: 'May your knowledge be destroyed! Be conquered by women, O wretch!

children.text: sarva-jātiṣu gandharvaḥ kāmī so 'pi bhavān bhava // Jss_1,10.24 //
children.translated_text: In all births, be a <s>Gandharva</s>, and be lustful! // Jss_1,10.24 //

children.text: pañcāśat-kāminīnāṃ ca svayaṃ bhartā bhavācirāt /
children.translated_text: Become forthwith the husband of fifty women,

children.text: tāsāṃ vaśaś ca satataṃ strīṇāṃ krīḍā mṛgo yathā // Jss_1,10.25 //
children.translated_text: perpetually under their control, like a plaything-deer of women. // Jss_1,10.25 //

children.text: śṛṅgāra-śūro bhava re śaśvat-susthira-yauvanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Be a hero in love, O one of ever-firm youth!

children.text: tāsāṃ nityaṃ yauvanānāṃ sundarīṇāṃ priyo bhava // Jss_1,10.26 //
children.translated_text: Be the beloved of those ever-youthful, beautiful women! // Jss_1,10.26 //

children.text: kāma-bādhyo bhava ciraṃ divya-varṣa-sahasrakam /
children.translated_text: Be afflicted by desire for a long time — for a thousand celestial years.

children.text: nirjane nirjane ramye vane krīḍāṃ kariṣyasi // Jss_1,10.27 //
children.translated_text: In solitary, in solitary, lovely forests you shall sport! // Jss_1,10.27 //

children.text: tato varṣa-sahasrānte mayā śaptaḥ sva-karmaṇā /
children.translated_text: Then, at the end of a thousand years, cursed by me through your own <s>karma</s>,

children.text: vipra-dāsyāṃ tu śūdrāyāṃ janiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ // Jss_1,10.28 //
children.translated_text: you shall be born from a <s>Śūdra</s> woman, a maidservant of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> — there is no doubt. // Jss_1,10.28 //

children.text: tato vaiṣṇava-saṃsargāt viṣṇor ucchiṣṭa-bhojanāt /
children.translated_text: Then, through association with <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, through eating the remnants of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s offerings,

children.text: viṣṇu-mantra-prasādena viṣṇu-māyā-vimohitaḥ // Jss_1,10.29 //
children.translated_text: by the grace of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s <s>mantra</s>, freed from the delusion of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s <s>Māyā</s>.' // Jss_1,10.29 //

children.text: tātasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa nārado muniḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of his father, the sage <s>Nārada</s> became furious,

children.text: śaśāpa pitaraṃ śighraṃ dāruṇaṃ ca yathocitam // Jss_1,10.30 //
children.translated_text: and quickly cursed his father — a terrible [curse], as was fitting: // Jss_1,10.30 //

children.text: apūjyo bhava duṣṭaṃ tvaṃ tvan-mantropāsakaḥ kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Be unworthy of worship, O wicked one! Where shall worshippers of your <s>mantra</s> be found?

children.text: agamyāgamanecchā te bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ // Jss_1,10.31 //
children.translated_text: The desire for approaching the forbidden shall be yours — there is no doubt! // Jss_1,10.31 //

children.text: nāradasya tu śāpena so 'pūjyo jagatāṃ vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: By <s>Nārada</s>'s curse, <s>Vidhī</s> (the Creator) became unworthy of worship in the world.

children.text: dṛṣṭvā sva-kanyā-rūpaṃ ca paścād dhāvitavān purā // Jss_1,10.32 //
children.translated_text: Having seen the beauty of his own daughter, he formerly ran after her. // Jss_1,10.32 //

children.text: punaḥ sva-dehaṃ tatyāja bhartsitaḥ sanakādibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: He then abandoned his own body, rebuked by <s>Sanaka</s> and the others.

children.text: lajjitaḥ kāma-yuktaś ca punar brahmā babhūva saḥ // Jss_1,10.33 //
children.translated_text: Ashamed and filled with desire, he became <s>Brahmā</s> again. // Jss_1,10.33 //

children.text: nāradas tu namas-kṛtya pitaraṃ kamalodbhavam /
children.translated_text: <s>Nārada</s>, having bowed to his father, the lotus-born,

children.text: vipra-dehaṃ parityajya gandharvaś ca babhūva saḥ // Jss_1,10.34 //
children.translated_text: abandoned his <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> body and became a <s>Gandharva</s>. // Jss_1,10.34 //

children.text: nava-yauvana-kālena balavān madanoddhataḥ /
children.translated_text: In the vigor of fresh youth, empowered, intoxicated by desire,

children.text: jahāra kanyāḥ pañcāśat balāc citra-rathasya tu // Jss_1,10.35 //
children.translated_text: he abducted fifty maidens by force from <s>Citraratha</s>. // Jss_1,10.35 //

children.text: gāndharvena vivāhena tā uvāha ca nirjane /
children.translated_text: By the <s>Gāndharva</s> form of marriage he wedded them in a secluded place.

children.text: mūrcchāṃ prāpuś ca tāḥ kanyā dṛṣṭvā sundaram īśvaram // Jss_1,10.36 //
children.translated_text: Those maidens swooned upon seeing the beautiful lord. // Jss_1,10.36 //

children.text: visaspuruś ca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: They forgot their father, mother, and brothers,

children.text: remire tena sārdhaṃ ca kāmukyaḥ kāmukena ca // Jss_1,10.37 //
children.translated_text: and sported with him — desirous women with a desirous man. // Jss_1,10.37 //

children.text: kandarer kandare ramye ramye sundara-mandire /
children.translated_text: In cave after lovely cave, in beautiful, beautiful palaces,

children.text: śaile śaile surahasi kānane kānane tathā // Jss_1,10.38 //
children.translated_text: on mountain after mountain, in secluded place after secluded place, in forest after forest, // Jss_1,10.38 //

children.text: puṣpodyane taru-dyāne nadyāṃ nadyāṃ nade nade /
children.translated_text: in flower-garden after flower-garden, by tree-garden after tree-garden, at river after river, at stream after stream,

children.text: saraḥśreṣṭhe saraḥśreṣṭhe vare candra-sarovare // Jss_1,10.39 //
children.translated_text: at the finest of lakes, at the finest of lakes, at the excellent <s>Candrasarovara</s>, // Jss_1,10.39 //

children.text: sureśasyāpi nikaṭe subhadrasya taṭe taṭe /
children.translated_text: near the lord of the gods, on the banks and shores of the <s>Subhadrā</s> river,

children.text: agamye ca mahā-ghore gandha-mādana-gahvare // Jss_1,10.40 //
children.translated_text: in the inaccessible, most fearsome depths of <s>Gandhamādana</s>, // Jss_1,10.40 //

children.text: parijāta-taruṇāṃ ca puṣpitānāṃ manohare /
children.translated_text: among blooming <s>Pārijāta</s> trees, enchanting,

children.text: tad-antare sundare cāmodite puṣpa-vāyunā // Jss_1,10.41 //
children.translated_text: in the beautiful intervals between them, perfumed by the flower-laden breeze, // Jss_1,10.41 //

children.text: malaye nilaye ramye sugandhe candanānvite /
children.translated_text: on <s>Malaya</s> mountain, that delightful abode, fragrant, full of sandalwood,

children.text: candanokṣita-sarvāṅgaś candanāktena kāminā // Jss_1,10.42 //
children.translated_text: with all limbs anointed with sandalwood, the lover anointed with sandalwood, // Jss_1,10.42 //

children.text: ramya-campaka-śayyāsu candanāktāsu sasmitāḥ /
children.translated_text: upon lovely beds of <s>campaka</s> flowers, anointed with sandalwood, smiling,

children.text: divāniśaṃ na jānanti kāminā sasmitena ca // Jss_1,10.43 //
children.translated_text: not knowing day from night — with the smiling lover. // Jss_1,10.43 //

children.text: visyandake śūrasene nandane puṣpa-bhadrake /
children.translated_text: In <s>Visyandaka</s>, <s>Śūrasena</s>, <s>Nandana</s>, <s>Puṣpabhadraka</s>,

children.text: svāhā-vane kāmyake ca ramyake pāribhadrake // Jss_1,10.44 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Svāhāvana</s>, <s>Kāmyaka</s>, <s>Ramyaka</s>, <s>Pāribhadraka</s>, // Jss_1,10.44 //

children.text: surandhake gandhake ca suraṅhre puṇḍrake 'pi ca /
children.translated_text: in <s>Surandhaka</s>, <s>Gandhaka</s>, <s>Suraṅhra</s>, and <s>Puṇḍraka</s>,

children.text: kālañjare pañjare ca kāñcī-kāñcana-kānane // Jss_1,10.45 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Kālañjara</s>, <s>Pañjara</s>, and in the golden forest of <s>Kāñcī</s>, // Jss_1,10.45 //

children.text: madhu-mādhava-māse ca madhūre madhu-kānane /
children.translated_text: in the months of <s>Madhu</s> and <s>Mādhava</s> (spring), in the sweet honey-forest,

children.text: vane kalpa-tarūṇāṃ ca viśva-kāru-kṛta-sthale // Jss_1,10.46 //
children.translated_text: in the forest of wish-fulfilling trees, in the place fashioned by <s>Viśvakāru</s> (<s>Viśvakarman</s>), // Jss_1,10.46 //

children.text: ratnākarāṇāṃ nikare sundare sundarāntare /
children.translated_text: among clusters of jewel-mines, in beautiful, innermost recesses,

children.text: suvele ca supārśve ca pravālāṃkura-kānane // Jss_1,10.47 //
children.translated_text: on <s>Suvela</s> and <s>Supārśva</s> mountains, in forests of coral-sprouts, // Jss_1,10.47 //

children.text: mandāre mandire pūre gāndhāre ca yugandhare /
children.translated_text: in <s>Mandāra</s>, in temples, in the city, in <s>Gāndhāra</s> and <s>Yugandhara</s>,

children.text: vane keli-kadambānāṃ ketakīnāṃ manohare // Jss_1,10.48 //
children.translated_text: in forests of sporting <s>kadamba</s> trees and enchanting <s>ketakī</s> blossoms, // Jss_1,10.48 //

children.text: mādhavī-mālatīnāṃ ca yūthikānāṃ vane vane /
children.translated_text: in forest after forest of <s>mādhavī</s>, <s>mālatī</s>, and <s>yūthikā</s> (jasmine) vines,

children.text: campakānāṃ palāśānāṃ kundānāṃ vipine tathā // Jss_1,10.49 //
children.translated_text: in groves of <s>campaka</s>, <s>palāśa</s>, and <s>kunda</s> flowers, // Jss_1,10.49 //

children.text: nāgeśvara-lavaṅgānāṃ antare lalitālaye /
children.translated_text: among <s>nāgeśvara</s> and clove trees, in graceful abodes,

children.text: kumudānāṃ paṅkajānāṃ paṅkile komala-sthale // Jss_1,10.50 //
children.translated_text: amid night-lotuses and day-lotuses, on soft muddy ground, // Jss_1,10.50 //

children.text: sthala-padma-prakāro ca bhūmi-campaka-kānane /
children.translated_text: amid rows of land-lotuses, in forests of terrestrial <s>campaka</s>,

children.text: lāṅgalīnāṃ rasālānāṃ panasānāṃ sukha-prade // Jss_1,10.51 //
children.translated_text: amid <s>lāṅgalī</s>, mango, and jackfruit trees, in places of delight, // Jss_1,10.51 //

children.text: kadalī-badarīṇāṃ ca śrī-phalānāṃ ca śrī-yute /
children.translated_text: amid plantain and jujube trees and <s>śrī-phala</s> trees, adorned with <s>Śrī</s> (beauty),

children.text: jambīrāṇāṃ ca jambūnāṃ karañjānāṃ tathaiva ca // Jss_1,10.52 //
children.translated_text: amid citron, rose-apple, and <s>karañja</s> trees, // Jss_1,10.52 //

children.text: kṛtvā bihāraṃ tābhiś ca gandharvaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: having sported thus with those women, the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s>,

children.text: divyaṃ varṣa-sahasraṃ ca svāśramaṃ punar āyayau // Jss_1,10.53 //
children.translated_text: after a thousand celestial years, returned to his own hermitage. // Jss_1,10.53 //

children.text: śrutvā vidhātur āhvānaṃ puṣkaraṃ ca yayau punaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the summons of the Creator, he went again to <s>Puṣkara</s>.

children.text: dadarśa tatra brahmāṇam ratna-siṃhāsana-sthitam // Jss_1,10.54 //
children.translated_text: There he beheld <s>Brahmā</s>, seated upon a jeweled throne, // Jss_1,10.54 //

children.text: devendraiś cāpi siddhendrair munīndraiḥ sankādibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: surrounded by the lords of gods, lords of <s>Siddhas</s>, lords of sages, <s>Sanaka</s> and others,

children.text: samāvṛtaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca rakṣo-gandharva-kinnaraiḥ // Jss_1,10.55 //
children.translated_text: in the assembly, by <s>Rākṣasas</s>, <s>Gandharvas</s>, and <s>Kinnaras</s>, // Jss_1,10.55 //

children.text: suśobhitaṃ yathā candraṃ gagane bhagaṇaiḥ saha /
children.translated_text: resplendent like the moon in the sky with the constellation of stars.

children.text: praṇanāma sabhā-madhye tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ jagad-vidhim // Jss_1,10.56 //
children.translated_text: He bowed in the midst of the assembly, along with those [women], to the Creator of the worlds, // Jss_1,10.56 //

children.text: maheśaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ ca dhaneśaṃ śeṣam īśvaram /
children.translated_text: to <s>Maheśa</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, <s>Dhaneśa</s> (<s>Kubera</s>), <s>Śeṣa</s>, the Lord,

children.text: dharmaṃ dhanvantariṃ skandaṃ sūrya-soma-hutāśanam // Jss_1,10.57 //
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Dhanvantari</s>, <s>Skanda</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Soma</s>, and <s>Hutāśana</s> (Fire), // Jss_1,10.57 //

children.text: upendrendraṃ viśva-kāruṃ varuṇaṃ pavanaṃ smaram /
children.translated_text: <s>Upendra</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>), <s>Indra</s>, <s>Viśvakāru</s> (<s>Viśvakarman</s>), <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Pavana</s> (Wind), <s>Smara</s> (Love),

children.text: yamam aṣṭau vasūn rudrān jayantaṃ nalakūvaram // Jss_1,10.58 //
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s>, the eight <s>Vasus</s>, the <s>Rudras</s>, <s>Jayanta</s>, and <s>Nalakūvara</s>, // Jss_1,10.58 //

children.text: sarvān devān namas-kṛtya nanāma muni-puṅgavam /
children.translated_text: having saluted all the gods, he bowed to the foremost of sages —

children.text: agastyaṃ ca pulastyaṃ ca pulahaṃ ca pracetasam // Jss_1,10.59 //
children.translated_text: <s>Agastya</s>, <s>Pulastya</s>, <s>Pulaha</s>, and <s>Pracetas</s>, // Jss_1,10.59 //

children.text: sarva-śreṣṭhaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca dakṣaṃ ca kardamaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: the most excellent <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, <s>Dakṣa</s>, and <s>Kardama</s>,

children.text: sanakaṃ sanandaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca sanātanam // Jss_1,10.60 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sanaka</s>, <s>Sananda</s>, and the third, <s>Sanātana</s>, // Jss_1,10.60 //

children.text: sanat-kumāraṃ yogīśaṃ jñānināṃ ca guror gurum /
children.translated_text: <s>Sanatkumāra</s>, the lord of <s>yogins</s>, the <s>guru</s> of <s>gurus</s> of the knowers,

children.text: voḍhuṃ pañca-śikhaṃ saṅkhaṃ bhṛgum aṅgirasaṃ tathā // Jss_1,10.61 //
children.translated_text: <s>Voḍhu</s>, <s>Pañcaśikha</s>, <s>Saṅkha</s>, <s>Bhṛgu</s>, and <s>Aṅgiras</s>, // Jss_1,10.61 //

children.text: āsuriṃ kapilaṃ kautsaṃ kratuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ naram /
children.translated_text: <s>Āsuri</s>, <s>Kapila</s>, <s>Kautsa</s>, <s>Kratu</s>, <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, <s>Nara</s>,

children.text: marīciṃ kaśyapaṃ kaṇvaṃ vyāsaṃ durvāsasaṃ kavim // Jss_1,10.62 //
children.translated_text: <s>Marīci</s>, <s>Kaśyapa</s>, <s>Kaṇva</s>, <s>Vyāsa</s>, <s>Durvāsas</s>, the poet, // Jss_1,10.62 //

children.text: bṛhaspatiṃ ca cyavanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca lomaśam /
children.translated_text: <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, <s>Cyavana</s>, <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>, and <s>Lomaśa</s>,

children.text: vālmīkiṃ paraśu-rāmaṃ saṃvartaṃ ca vibhāṇḍakam // Jss_1,10.63 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vālmīki</s>, <s>Paraśurāma</s>, <s>Saṃvarta</s>, and <s>Vibhāṇḍaka</s>, // Jss_1,10.63 //

children.text: devalaṃ ca vāma-devam ṛśayaśṛṅgaṃ parāśāram /
children.translated_text: <s>Devala</s>, <s>Vāmadeva</s>, <s>Ṛṣyaśṛṅga</s>, and <s>Parāśara</s> —

children.text: etān sarvān namas-kṛtya tasthau sa purato vidheḥ // Jss_1,10.64 //
children.translated_text: having bowed to all these, he stood before the Creator. // Jss_1,10.64 //

children.text: tuṣṭāva sarvān devāṃś ca munīndrāṃś ca tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: He praised all the gods and the lords of sages likewise.

children.text: tam uvāca sabhā-madhye vidhātā jagatām api /
children.translated_text: In the midst of the assembly, the Creator of the worlds spoke to him,

children.text: sasmitaḥ suprasannaś ca gandharvam upavarhaṇam // Jss_1,10.65 //
children.translated_text: smiling, well-pleased — to the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s>: // Jss_1,10.65 //

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-rasa-saṅgītaṃ vīṇā-dhvani-samanvitam /
children.translated_text: 'Perform a musical recital of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>rasa</s> (divine amorous play), accompanied by the sound of the <s>vīṇā</s>.

children.text: kuru vatsādhunātraiva śṛṇvantu munayaḥ surāḥ // Jss_1,10.66 //
children.translated_text: Do it now, right here, O child — let the sages and gods listen! // Jss_1,10.66 //

children.text: gopīnāṃ vastra-haraṇaṃ haraṃ rāsa-mahotsavam /
children.translated_text: The stealing of the <s>Gopīs</s>' garments, the charming <s>Rāsa</s> festival,

children.text: tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ jala-krīḍāṃ harer utkīrtanaṃ kuru // Jss_1,10.67 //
children.translated_text: the water-sport with them — sing the praises of <s>Hari</s>! // Jss_1,10.67 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtanaṃ tūrṇaṃ punāti śruti-mātrataḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>saṅkīrtana</s> (congregational chanting) of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> purifies instantly, by mere hearing alone,

children.text: śrotāraṃ ca pravaktāraṃ puruṣaiḥ saptabhiḥ saha // Jss_1,10.68 //
children.translated_text: both the listener and the speaker, along with seven generations of their families. // Jss_1,10.68 //

children.text: yatraiva prabhaved vatsa tan-nāma-guṇānukīrtanam /
children.translated_text: Wherever, O child, the chanting of His name and qualities takes place,

children.text: tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni puṇyāni maṅgalāni ca // Jss_1,10.69 //
children.translated_text: there are all the holy sites, all meritorious and auspicious things. // Jss_1,10.69 //

children.text: tat-kīrtana-dhvaniṃ śrutvā sarvāṇi pātakāni ca /
children.translated_text: Hearing the sound of His <s>kīrtana</s> (chanting), all sins

children.text: dūrād eva palāyante vainateyam ivoragāḥ // Jss_1,10.70 //
children.translated_text: flee far away, like serpents from <s>Vainateya</s> (<s>Garuḍa</s>). // Jss_1,10.70 //

children.text: tad dinaṃ saphalaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ sarva-maṅgalam /
children.translated_text: That day is fruitful, blessed, glorious, and all-auspicious

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-kīrtanaṃ yatra tatraiva nāyuṣo vyayaḥ // Jss_1,10.71 //
children.translated_text: in which the <s>kīrtana</s> of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s> takes place — there is no waste of life. // Jss_1,10.71 //

children.text: saṃkīrtana-dhvaniṃ śrutvā ye ca nṛtyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> who dance upon hearing the sound of <s>saṅkīrtana</s> —

children.text: teṣāṃ pāda-rajaḥ-sparśāt sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā // Jss_1,10.72 //
children.translated_text: by the touch of the dust of their feet, the earth is instantly purified. // Jss_1,10.72 //

children.text: tat-kīrtanaṃ bhaved yatra kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Wherever the <s>kīrtana</s> of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the Supreme Self, takes place,

children.text: sthānaṃ tac ca bhavet tīrthaṃ mṛtānāṃ tatra muktidam // Jss_1,10.73 //
children.translated_text: that place becomes a holy site, granting liberation to those who die there. // Jss_1,10.73 //

children.text: nātra pāpāni tiṣṭhanti puṇyāni susthirāṇi ca /
children.translated_text: Sins do not remain there, and meritorious deeds become firmly established.

children.text: tapasvināṃ ca vratināṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ sthalam // Jss_1,10.74 //
children.translated_text: It is the ground for the austerities of ascetics and the vows of the devout. // Jss_1,10.74 //

children.text: vartate pāpināṃ dehe pāpāni tri-vidhāni ca /
children.translated_text: In the body of sinners dwell sins of three kinds;

children.text: mahā-pāpopapāpātipāpāny eva smṛtāni ca // Jss_1,10.75 //
children.translated_text: they are described as great sins, lesser sins, and intermediate sins. // Jss_1,10.75 //

children.text: hantā yo vipra-bhikṣūṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahma-cāriṇāṃ /
children.translated_text: He who slays <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, monks, ascetics, and <s>brahmacārins</s> (celibate students),

children.text: strīṇāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sa mahā-pātakī smṛtaḥ // Jss_1,10.76 //
children.translated_text: women, and <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> — he is called a great sinner. // Jss_1,10.76 //

children.text: bhrūṇā-ghnaś cāpi go-ghnaś ca śūdra-ghnaś ca kṛta-ghnakaḥ /
children.translated_text: A slayer of an embryo, a killer of cows, a killer of <s>Śūdras</s>, an ingrate,

children.text: viśvāsa-ghātī viḍ-bhojī sa eva hy upapātakī // Jss_1,10.77 //
children.translated_text: a betrayer of trust, an eater of filth — he is indeed a lesser sinner. // Jss_1,10.77 //

children.text: agamyāgamino ye ca sura-vipra-svahāriṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who approach the forbidden, who steal the property of gods and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> —

children.text: atipātakinaś caite veda-vidbhiḥ prakīrtitāḥ // Jss_1,10.78 //
children.translated_text: these are proclaimed as intermediate sinners by the knowers of the <s>Vedas</s>. // Jss_1,10.78 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-saṃkīrtna-dhyānāt tan-mantra-grahaṇād aho /
children.translated_text: Through the meditation of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>-<s>saṅkīrtana</s>, through receiving His <s>mantra</s> — oh! —

children.text: mucyante pātakais tais taiḥ pāpinas tri-vidhāḥ smṛtāḥ // Jss_1,10.79 //
children.translated_text: sinners of all three kinds are freed from their respective sins! // Jss_1,10.79 //

children.text: tapo-yajña-kṛtī pūtas tīrtha-snāta-vratī tathā /
children.translated_text: One who is purified by performing <s>tapas</s> (austerities) and <s>yajña</s> (sacrifices), who has bathed in <s>tīrthas</s> (holy places) and observed <s>vratas</s> (vows),

children.text: bhikṣur yatir brahma-cārī vāna-prasthaś ca tāpasaḥ // Jss_1,10.80 //
children.translated_text: a mendicant, a renunciant, a <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student), a <s>vānaprastha</s> (forest-dweller), and an ascetic —

children.text: pavitraḥ paramo vahniḥ supavitraṃ jalaṃ yathā /
children.translated_text: the most sacred fire, and water which is supremely pure —

children.text: ete sarve vaiṣṇavānāṃ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm // Jss_1,10.81 //
children.translated_text: all these are not worth a sixteenth part of the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>.

children.text: viṣṇu-pādodakocchiṣṭaṃ bhuñjate ye ca nityaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who constantly partake of the remnants of <s>Viṣṇu's</s> <s>pādodaka</s> (foot-water),

children.text: paśyanti ca śilā-cakraṃ pūjāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ // Jss_1,10.82 //
children.translated_text: who behold the <s>śilā</s> (sacred stone) and <s>cakra</s> (discus), and perform worship daily —

children.text: jīvan-muktās ca te dhanyā hari-dāsāś ca bhārate /
children.translated_text: they are the blessed ones, liberated while living, servants of <s>Hari</s> in <s>Bhārata</s>,

children.text: pade pade 'śvamedhasya prāpnuvanti phalaṃ dhruvam // Jss_1,10.83 //
children.translated_text: at every step they surely obtain the fruit of an <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice).

children.text: teṣāṃ ca pāda-rajasā tīrthaṃ pūtaṃ tathā dharā // Jss_1,10.84/ //
children.translated_text: by the dust of their feet, the <s>tīrthas</s> (holy places) and the earth itself are purified.

body.translated_text: There are none more meritorious than them in the three worlds;

children.text: teṣāṃ ca darśanaṃ sparśaṃ vāñchanti munayaḥ surāḥ /
children.translated_text: Even sages and gods desire to see and touch them;

children.text: puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūtaṃ taj-janma-mātrataḥ // Jss_1,10.85 //
children.translated_text: a thousand men are purified merely by their birth.

children.text: ity uktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tatra tūṣṇīṃ babhūva saḥ /
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the Creator of the worlds fell silent there,

children.text: āścaryaṃ menire śrutvā devāś ca munayas tathā // Jss_1,10.86 //
children.translated_text: and the gods and sages were filled with wonder upon hearing this.

children.text: etasminn antare tatra vidyā-dharyaḥ samāgatāḥ /
children.translated_text: Meanwhile, <s>Vidyādharī</s> women arrived there,

children.text: gandharvāś cāpi vividhā nanṛtuḥ kinnarā jaguḥ // Jss_1,10.87 //
children.translated_text: various <s>Gandharvas</s> danced, and <s>Kinnaras</s> sang.

children.text: rambhor vaśī ghṛtācī ca menakā ca tilottamā /
children.translated_text: <s>Rambhā</s>, <s>Vaśī</s>, <s>Ghṛtācī</s>, <s>Menakā</s>, and <s>Tilottamā</s>,

children.text: sudhāmukhī pūrṇa-cittī mohinī kalikā tathā // Jss_1,10.88 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sudhāmukhī</s>, <s>Pūrṇacittī</s>, <s>Mohinī</s>, and <s>Kalikā</s>,

children.text: campāvatī candra-mukhī padmā padma-mukhīti ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Campāvatī</s>, <s>Candramukhī</s>, <s>Padmā</s>, and <s>Padmamukhī</s> —

children.text: etāś cānyāś ca bahvyaś ca śvaśvat susthira-yauvanāḥ // Jss_1,10.89 //
children.translated_text: these and many others, eternally endowed with firm youth,

children.text: bṛhan-nitamba-śroṇīkāstanabhāraiḥ samānatāḥ /
children.translated_text: with broad hips and buttocks, bowed by the weight of their breasts,

children.text: īṣaddhāsyāḥ prasannāsyāḥ kāmārtāś ca samāyayuḥ // Jss_1,10.90 //
children.translated_text: with gentle smiles and serene faces, filled with desire, they arrived.

children.text: veda-jñā mūrtimantaś ca vedāś cātvāra eva ca /
children.translated_text: The four <s>Vedas</s> came in embodied form, knowers of the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: brāhmaṇā bhikṣavaḥ siddhā yatayo brahma-cāriṇaḥ // Jss_1,10.91 //
children.translated_text: <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, mendicants, <s>Siddhas</s>, renunciants, and <s>brahmacārins</s>,

children.text: samāyayus tathā mandā daiva-jñāḥ stuti-pāṭhakāḥ /
children.translated_text: as well as astrologers and reciters of hymns arrived.

children.text: lakṣmī sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rohiṇī ratiḥ // Jss_1,10.92 //
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Sāvitrī</s>, <s>Rohiṇī</s>, <s>Rati</s>,

children.text: tulasī pṛthivī gaṅgā svāhā ca yamunā tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Tulasī</s>, <s>Pṛthivī</s>, <s>Gaṅgā</s>, <s>Svāhā</s>, and <s>Yamunā</s>,

children.text: vāruṇī manasendrāṇī tāḥ sarvā deva-yoṣitaḥ // Jss_1,10.93 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vāruṇī</s>, <s>Manasā</s>, <s>Indrāṇī</s> — all these wives of the gods,

children.text: muni-patnyaś ca gandharvyo harṣa-yuktāḥ samāyayuḥ /
children.translated_text: wives of sages, and <s>Gandharva</s> women arrived filled with joy.

children.text: aho mahotsavaṃ paramānanda-mānasāḥ /
children.translated_text: Oh, what a grand festival! With minds full of supreme bliss,

children.text: vicitrāṃ ca brahma-sabhāṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrtham āyayuḥ // Jss_1,10.94 //
children.translated_text: they came to the wonderful assembly of <s>Brahmā</s>, to the <s>tīrtha</s> of <s>Puṣkara</s>.

body.text:
iti śrī-nārada-pañca-rātre jñānāmṛta-sāre prathamaika-rātre
mahotsavārambho nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the tenth chapter, named 'The Commencement of the Great Festival,' in the first night of the <s>Jñānāmṛtasāra</s> of the Śrī <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>.
The eleventh chapter in the first night.
Now, the Vision of the Great Festival.

children.text: śrī-vyāsa uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Vyāsa</s> said:

children.text: atha gandharva-rājas tu bhagavān ājñayā vidheḥ /
children.translated_text: Then the <s>Gandharva</s> king, by the command of the blessed <s>Vidhi</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>),

children.text: saṃgītaṃ ca jagau tatra kṛṣṇa-rāsa-mahotsavam // Jss_1,11.1 //
children.translated_text: sang a musical performance there — the great festival of <s>Kṛṣṇa's</s> <s>rāsa</s> (divine dance).

children.text: susamaṃ tālamānaṃ ca sutānaṃ madhuraṃ śrutam /
children.translated_text: With perfect rhythm and tempo, with a beautiful and sweet melody heard by all,

children.text: vīṇā-mṛdaṅga-muraja-yuktaṃ dhvani-samanvitam // Jss_1,11.2 //
children.translated_text: accompanied by <s>vīṇā</s>, <s>mṛdaṅga</s>, and <s>muraja</s> drums, resonant with sound,

children.text: rāgiṇī-yukta-rāgeṇa samayoktena sundaram /
children.translated_text: beautiful with <s>rāga</s> joined with <s>rāgiṇī</s>, sung at the proper time,

children.text: mādhuryaṃ mūrcchnāyuktaṃ manase harṣa-kāraṇam // Jss_1,11.3 //
children.translated_text: full of sweetness and <s>mūrchanā</s> (melodic modulations), causing delight to the mind,

children.text: vicitraṃ nṛtya-ruciraṃ rūpa-veśam uttamam /
children.translated_text: wondrous and charming in dance, with the finest costumes and appearance,

children.text: lokānurāga-bījaṃ ca nāṭyopayukta-hastakam // Jss_1,11.4 //
children.translated_text: sowing the seed of universal delight, with hand-gestures suited to <s>nāṭya</s> (dramatic art) —

children.text: dṛṣṭvā śrutvā surāḥ sarve munayaḥ sarva-yoṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: seeing and hearing this, all the gods, sages, and all the women

children.text: mūrcchāṃ prāyuś ca sahasā cetanāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ // Jss_1,11.5 //
children.translated_text: suddenly fell into swoons and regained consciousness again and again.

children.text: gopīnāṃ vastra-haraṇaṃ gopī-gaṇa-vilāpanaṃ /
children.translated_text: The stealing of the <s>gopīs'</s> garments, the lamentation of the <s>gopī</s> hosts,

children.text: tābhyo vastra-pradānaṃ ca saṃmānaṃ varadānakam // Jss_1,11.6 //
children.translated_text: the giving back of their garments, the honoring and granting of boons,

children.text: kātyāyanī-vrataṃ cāpi vipra-dārānna-bhojanam /
children.translated_text: the <s>Kātyāyanī</s> vow, the eating of food at the <s>brāhmaṇas'</s> wives' homes,

children.text: mahendra-darpa-pūjādi bhañjanaṃ śaila-pūjanam // Jss_1,11.7 //
children.translated_text: the shattering of great <s>Indra's</s> pride in worship and the worship of the mountain (<s>Govardhana</s>) —

children.text: punaś ca śuśruvuḥ sarve śrī-vṛndāvana-varṇanam /
children.translated_text: once again all heard the description of Śrī <s>Vṛndāvana</s>,

children.text: saṃprāpuś ca punar mūrcchāṃ punaḥ prāpuś ca cetanām // Jss_1,11.8 //
children.translated_text: and again they fell into a swoon, and again they regained consciousness.

children.text: tasmai dadau puro brahmā vahni-śuddhāṃśukaṃ param /
children.translated_text: To him, <s>Brahmā</s> first gave a fire-purified garment of the highest quality,

children.text: paraṃ śubhāśīr-vacanaṃ yat tan-mānasa-vāñchitam // Jss_1,11.9 //
children.translated_text: and supreme words of auspicious blessing, fulfilling his heart's desire.

children.text: amūlya-ratna-nirmāṇaṃ cāru-kuṇḍāla-yugmakam /
children.translated_text: A pair of beautiful earrings fashioned from priceless gems,

children.text: maṇīndra-sāra-mukuṭaṃ paraṃ ratnāṅgurīyakam // Jss_1,11.10 //
children.translated_text: a crown set with the finest jewels, and an excellent ring of precious stones,

children.text: sugandhi candanaṃ puṣpaṃ sva-pāda-reṇum īpsitam /
children.translated_text: fragrant sandalwood paste, flowers, the coveted dust of his own feet,

children.text: amūlya-ratna-tilakaṃ ratna-bhūṣaṇam ujjvalam // Jss_1,11.11 //
children.translated_text: a <s>tilaka</s> mark of priceless gems, and brilliant ornaments of jewels.

children.text: pratyekaṃ vastu ruciraṃ tad-yoṣidbhyaś ca saṃdadau /
children.translated_text: Each splendid item he also bestowed upon the wives (of the <s>Gandharva</s>).

children.text: viśvakarmā ca nirmāṇa-maṇiṃ bhūṣaṇam uttamam // Jss_1,11.12 //
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvakarmā</s> gave the supreme ornament, a wish-fulfilling jewel of divine craftsmanship,

children.text: pratyekaṃ śaṅkha-sindūraṃ kastūrī-yukta-candanam /
children.translated_text: and for each — conch-shell <s>sindūra</s> (vermilion), sandalwood mixed with <s>kastūrī</s> (musk),

children.text: sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ratnendra-sāra-darpaṇam // Jss_1,11.13 //
children.translated_text: <s>tāmbūla</s> (betel) with camphor, and a mirror made of the finest gems,

children.text: maṇi-nirmāṇā-mañjoraṃ śveta-cāmara-śobhanam /
children.translated_text: an anklet fashioned from jewels, beautiful white <s>cāmaras</s> (fly-whisks),

children.text: manoyāyi rathaṃ divyaṃ īsvarecchā-vinirmitam // Jss_1,11.14 //
children.translated_text: a divine chariot that travels at the speed of thought, created by the Lord's will,

children.text: muktā-māṇikya-hīrendrair maṇīndraiś ca pariṣkṛtam /
children.translated_text: adorned with pearls, rubies, the finest diamonds and jewels,

children.text: sad-ratna-mālā-jālaiś ca śveta-cāmara-darpaṇaiḥ // Jss_1,11.15 //
children.translated_text: with nets of garlands of precious stones, white fly-whisks, and mirrors,

children.text: suśobhitaṃ ca parito lakṣaiḥ sundara-mandiraiḥ /
children.translated_text: splendidly decorated all around with hundreds of thousands of beautiful pavilions,

children.text: maṇi-mānikya-hīrāḍhyaṃ sad-ratna-kalaśojjvalam // Jss_1,11.16 //
children.translated_text: rich with jewels, rubies, and diamonds, radiant with pinnacles of precious stones,

children.text: dhanur lakṣocchritaṃ caiva sahasrāśvena yojitam // Jss_1,11.17/
children.translated_text: a bow-length in height, and yoked with a thousand horses.

children.text: etad eva dadau brahmā prahṛṣṭas tuṣṭa eva ca /
children.translated_text: All this <s>Brahmā</s> gave with great joy and satisfaction.

children.text: śambhus tuṣṭo dadau hṛṣṭo hari-bhaktiṃ ca niścalām // Jss_1,11.18 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śambhu</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), pleased and delighted, gave unwavering devotion to <s>Hari</s>,

body.translated_text: fitted with a thousand wheels, measuring a <s>yojana</s> in length,

children.text: jñānam adhyātmikaṃ caiva yoga-jñānaṃ sudurlabham /
children.translated_text: spiritual knowledge of the Self, and the rare knowledge of <s>Yoga</s>,

children.text: nānā-janma-smṛti-jñānaṃ naipuṇyaṃ sarva-siddhiṣu // Jss_1,11.19 //
children.translated_text: knowledge of memories of many past births, and expertise in all <s>siddhis</s> (supernatural powers),

children.text: hareś carcāvidhānaṃ ca stavanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: the method of worshipping <s>Hari</s>, hymns of praise, and worship,

children.text: māṇikya-hīrāhāraṃ ca ratna-lakṣaṃ sudurlabham // Jss_1,11.20 //
children.translated_text: a necklace of rubies and diamonds, and a hundred thousand rare gems.

children.text: nāga-hāraṃ dadau śeṣo nāgendramauli-maṇḍanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śeṣa</s> gave a serpent-necklace, an ornament for the head of the king of serpents,

children.text: nāga-kanyā-śataṃ caiva vara-bhūṣaṇa-bhūṣitam // Jss_1,11.21 //
children.translated_text: and a hundred <s>Nāga</s> maidens adorned with the finest ornaments,

children.text: nāgebhyaś cābhyaṃ nityaṃ hisra-jantubhya eva ca /
children.translated_text: freedom from fear of serpents and harmful creatures forever,

children.text: nṛpālaya-gati-jñānaṃ sarva-loka-vilokanam // Jss_1,11.22 //
children.translated_text: knowledge of the paths of royal palaces, and the ability to survey all worlds.

children.text: nirvighnatvaṃ dadau tasmai vighn-rājaś ca saṃsadi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vighnarāja</s> (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>) gave him freedom from obstacles in the assembly,

children.text: sudurlabhaṃ pāda-padma-yugma-reṇum abhīpsitam // Jss_1,11.23 //
children.translated_text: and the coveted, rare dust from the pair of his lotus feet,

children.text: amūlyaṃ ca nirupamaṃ grīṣma-sūrya-prabhopamam /
children.translated_text: a priceless, incomparable king of jewels, blazing like the summer sun,

children.text: maṇi-rājaṃ sudīptaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu durlabham // Jss_1,11.24 //
children.translated_text: brilliantly shining, rare in the three worlds,

children.text: sarvatra vijayaṃ caiva vāñcchitaṃ nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: victory everywhere, the desired spotless fame,

children.text: saṃgīta-vidyā-vijñānaṃ tan-naipuṇyaṃ manoharam // Jss_1,11.25 //
children.translated_text: knowledge and mastery of the science of music, and enchanting expertise therein.

children.text: lakṣa-svarṇaṃ dhaneśaś ca dāsānāṃ ca śataṃ śatam /
children.translated_text: <s>Dhaneśa</s> (<s>Kubera</s>) gave a hundred thousand gold coins and hundreds upon hundreds of servants;

children.text: dharmaḥ kīrtimayīṃ mālāṃ skando dhairyaṃ dadau tathā // Jss_1,11.26 //
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> gave a garland of fame; <s>Skanda</s> gave fortitude.

children.text: viṣaya-jīrṇāpaharaṇaṃ dadau dhanvantarir manum /
children.translated_text: <s>Dhanvantari</s> gave a <s>mantra</s> for removing the decay caused by sensory indulgence;

children.text: sūryaḥ syamantaka-maṇiṃ svarṇā-bhārāṣṭakaprasum // Jss_1,11.27 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sūrya</s> gave the <s>Syamantaka</s> jewel, which yields eight loads of gold.

children.text: candraḥ śvetāśva-ratnaṃ ca hy amūlyam uttamaṃ dadau /
children.translated_text: <s>Candra</s> (the Moon) gave a priceless, supreme white horse as a jewel-gift;

children.text: vahni-śuddhāṃśuka-yugaṃ dadau vahniś ca saṃsadi // Jss_1,11.28 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vahni</s> (Fire) gave a pair of fire-purified garments in the assembly.

children.text: upendro ratna-koṭiṃ ca tad evendro dadau purā /
children.translated_text: <s>Upendra</s> gave ten million gems, and likewise <s>Indra</s> gave the same;

children.text: vīṇā-śilpaṃ viśvakarmā varuṇaś ca maṇi-srajam // Jss_1,11.29 //
children.translated_text: <s>Viśvakarmā</s> gave the art of the <s>vīṇā</s>, and <s>Varuṇa</s> gave a garland of jewels.

children.text: smaraḥ śṛṅgāra-naipuṇyaṃ vīrya-stambhanam eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Smara</s> (<s>Kāmadeva</s>) gave expertise in the art of love, the power to restrain virility,

children.text: kāma-sandīpanaṃ jñānaṃ kāminī-prema-mūrchanam // Jss_1,11.30 //
children.translated_text: the knowledge of kindling passion, and the art of making women swoon with love,

children.text: kāminī-vaśa-gaṃ śilpaṃ rati-tattvaṃ dadau tathā /
children.translated_text: the skill of enchanting women, and the essence of erotic science;

children.text: pāpa-dāhana-mantraṃ ca ratna-chatraṃ samīraṇaḥ // Jss_1,11.31 //
children.translated_text: <s>Samīraṇa</s> (<s>Vāyu</s>, the Wind god) gave a <s>mantra</s> for burning sins, and a jeweled parasol.

children.text: yamaś ca dharma-tattvaṃ ca naraka-trāṇa-kāraṇam /
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> gave the essence of <s>Dharma</s> and the means of deliverance from hell;

children.text: vasavaś ca vasūn divyān rudras tebhyo 'bhayaṃ dadau // Jss_1,11.32 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Vasus</s> gave divine treasures, and <s>Rudra</s> gave them freedom from fear.

children.text: madhu-pātraṃ sudhā-pātraṃ jayanto nalakūvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Jayanta</s> gave a pot of honey; <s>Nalakūvara</s> gave a pot of nectar;

children.text: śukla-puṣpaṃ śukla-dhānyaṃ pāda-reṇum abhīpsitam // Jss_1,11.33 //
children.translated_text: white flowers, white grain, and the desired dust of their feet.

children.text: manobhirāṃ manuyo dadau tasmai śubhāśiṣam /
children.translated_text: <s>Manu</s> gave him a mind-captivating auspicious blessing;

children.text: lakṣmīś ca paramaiśvaryaṃ bhāratī hāram uttamam // Jss_1,11.34 //
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmī</s> gave supreme sovereignty; <s>Bhāratī</s> (<s>Sarasvatī</s>) gave a supreme necklace.

children.text: ratna-mālāṃ dadau durgā sarvatrābhayam īpsitam /
children.translated_text: <s>Durgā</s> gave a garland of gems and the desired freedom from fear everywhere;

children.text: tat-patnībhyaś ca ratnāni sindūrābharaṇāni ca // Jss_1,11.35 //
children.translated_text: and to his wives, she gave jewels and vermilion ornaments.

children.text: krīḍā-padmaṃ rohinī ca ratiḥ sad-ratna-darpaṇam /
children.translated_text: <s>Rohiṇī</s> gave a playful lotus; <s>Rati</s> gave a mirror of fine gems;

children.text: tulasī cātulaṃ mālyaṃ divyaṃ vasu vasundharā // Jss_1,11.36 //
children.translated_text: <s>Tulasī</s> gave an incomparable divine garland; <s>Vasundharā</s> (Earth) gave wealth.

children.text: gaṅgā ca vipulaṃ puṇyaṃ svāhā sad-ratna-pāśakam /
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṅgā</s> gave abundant merit; <s>Svāhā</s> gave dice of precious stones;

children.text: yamunā jalajaṃ padmam amlānaṃ sārvakālikam // Jss_1,11.37 //
children.translated_text: <s>Yamunā</s> gave an unfading water-born lotus, lasting for all time.

children.text: vāruṇīṃ vāruṇī tuṣṭā ratna-pātraṃ śacī dadau /
children.translated_text: <s>Vāruṇī</s>, pleased, gave <s>vāruṇī</s> (celestial wine); <s>Śacī</s> gave a vessel of gems;

children.text: manasā pradadau tasmai nāgānāṃ mauli-maṇḍanam // Jss_1,11.38 //
children.translated_text: <s>Manasā</s> gave him the crest-ornament of the <s>Nāgas</s>.

children.text: gandharvāś cāpi tat-patnyaḥ sva-śilpaṃ pradadus tathā /
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharvas</s> and their wives also gave their own arts,

children.text: paramānanda-yuktāś ca muni-patnyaḥ śubhāśiṣam // Jss_1,11.39 //
children.translated_text: and the wives of sages, filled with supreme bliss, gave auspicious blessings.

body.text:
iti śrī-nārada-pañca-rātre jñānāmṛta-sāre prathamaika-rātre
mahotsava-darśanaṃ nāma ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the eleventh chapter, named 'The Vision of the Great Festival,' in the first night of the <s>Jñānāmṛtasāra</s> of the Śrī <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>.
The twelfth chapter in the first night.

children.text: śuka uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Śuka</s> said:

children.text: mahotsave suniṣpanne dānasyottara-kālataḥ /
children.translated_text: After the great festival was completed and the giving of gifts was concluded,

children.text: kiṃ babhūva rahasyaṃ ca tan māṃ vyākhyātum arhasi // Jss_1,12.1 //
children.translated_text: what secret thing happened? Please explain that to me.

children.text: śrī-vyāsa uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Vyāsa</s> said:

children.text: saṃprāpya dānaṃ devānāṃ gandharvaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having received the gifts of the gods, the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s>,

children.text: teṣāṃ ca purato bhaktyā vidayām āsa vai sadā // Jss_1,12.2 //
children.translated_text: with devotion in their presence, always displayed his gratitude.

children.text: śrutvā tad vacanaṃ brahmā tam uvāca ca saṃsadi /
children.translated_text: Hearing his words, <s>Brahmā</s> addressed him in the assembly,

children.text: śambhunā ca samālocya brahmovāca vidhātā jagatām api // Jss_1,12.3 //
children.translated_text: and having consulted with <s>Śambhu</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, the Creator of the worlds, spoke:

children.text: vilāpaṃ gopa-gopīnāṃ śrāvayāsmāṃś ca sāmpratam // Jss_1,12.4/ //
children.translated_text: and the lamentation of the cowherds and <s>gopīs</s> — make us hear that now.

body.translated_text: "The departure to <s>Mathurā</s> of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the Supreme Self,

children.text: mahotsavaṃ kuru punaḥ śṛṇvantu munayaḥ surāḥ /
children.translated_text: Perform the great festival again; let sages and gods listen,

children.text: gāyantu tāś ca saṃgītaṃ nṛtyantv apsarāṃ gaṇāḥ // Jss_1,12.5 //
children.translated_text: let them sing that music, and let the hosts of <s>Apsarās</s> dance."

children.text: brahmaṇaś ca vacaḥ śrutvā nanṛtyuś cāpsarogaṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: Hearing the words of <s>Brahmā</s>, the hosts of <s>Apsarās</s> danced,

children.text: cakrus tāḥ sarasaṃ gītaṃ vidyādharyaś ca saṃsadi // Jss_1,12.6 //
children.translated_text: and the <s>Vidyādharī</s> women performed melodious songs in the assembly.

children.text: māyināṃ caiva pravaro gandharvaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: The foremost among illusionists, the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s>,

children.text: jagau sandhāna-bhāvena mathurā-gamanaṃ hareḥ // Jss_1,12.7 //
children.translated_text: sang in a connected narrative the departure of <s>Hari</s> to <s>Mathurā</s>.

children.text: vilāpaṃ gokula-sthānāṃ śrutvā viprāḥ surādayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Hearing the lamentation of the inhabitants of <s>Gokula</s>, the learned ones, gods, and others

children.text: mūrcchāṃ prāpuś ca rurudur dadur dānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ // Jss_1,12.8 //
children.translated_text: fell into a swoon and wept, and gave gifts again and again.

children.text: gopīnāṃ virahālāpair mūrcchitaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Overcome by the cries of separation of the <s>gopīs</s>, <s>Upavarhaṇa</s> himself swooned,

children.text: visvareṇa vitanāt tu tāla-bhaṅgo babhūva ha // Jss_1,12.9 //
children.translated_text: and singing with a broken voice, his rhythm was lost.

children.text: tat tāla-bhaṅgaṃ vijñāya devāś ca munayas tathā /
children.translated_text: Perceiving that loss of rhythm, the gods and sages

children.text: cukupuḥ sahasā sarve nirgatās tan mukhāgnayaḥ // Jss_1,12.10 //
children.translated_text: all suddenly became enraged, and fires shot forth from their mouths.

children.text: tad dṛṣṭvā sahasā bhīto gandharvaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Seeing that, the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s> was suddenly terrified,

children.text: sasmāra kṛṣṇaṃ svabhīṣṭaṃ paramātmānam īśvaram // Jss_1,12.11 //
children.translated_text: and he remembered <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, his beloved, the Supreme Self, the Lord.

children.text: dadṛśuḥ smṛti-mātreṇa tat-tejo nabhasi sthitam /
children.translated_text: By the mere act of remembrance, they beheld His radiance standing in the sky,

children.text: stambhitā devatāḥ sarvāśi-cakra-puttalikā yathā // Jss_1,12.12 //
children.translated_text: and all the deities were paralyzed, like puppets on a string.

children.text: stambhitā vahnayaḥ sarve munayaś ca vijṛmbhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: All the fires were stilled, and the sages were filled with wonder;

children.text: hari-smṛtiś cābhayadā śubhadā vighna-nāśinī // Jss_1,12.13 //
children.translated_text: the remembrance of <s>Hari</s> grants fearlessness, bestows auspiciousness, and destroys all obstacles.

children.text: dadṛśur devatāḥ sarvāḥ munayaś cāpi yoṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: All the deities, sages, women,

children.text: gandharvāś ca tathaivānye tejo dṛśyaṃ sukha-pradam // Jss_1,12.14 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gandharvas</s>, and all others beheld that visible radiance, which bestowed bliss,

children.text: paraṃ kuñjñaṭikākāraṃ koṭīndu-kiraṇa-prabham /
children.translated_text: supreme, in the form of a golden pavilion, shining with the brilliance of ten million moonbeams.

children.text: yojanāyata-vistīrṇaṃ susnigdhaṃ sumanoharam // Jss_1,12.15 //
children.translated_text: a <s>yojana</s> in extent and breadth, smooth and most enchanting. // Jss 1.12.15 //

children.text: tat tejo 'bhyantare sarve dadṛśū ratham uttamam /
children.translated_text: Within that radiance, all of them beheld a supreme chariot,

children.text: gavyūtimānaṃ vistīrṇaṃ dhanuṣ-koṭi-samucchritam // Jss_1,12.16 //
children.translated_text: a <s>gavyūti</s> (two miles) in breadth, rising to the height of the tip of a bow. // Jss 1.12.16 //

children.text: śvetāśvānāṃ ca cakrāṇāṃ sahasreṇa samāvṛtam /
children.translated_text: Surrounded by a thousand wheels and white horses,

children.text: amūlya-ratna-racitam īśvarecchā-vinirmitam // Jss_1,12.17 //
children.translated_text: fashioned of priceless gems, created by the will of the Lord, // Jss 1.12.17 //

children.text: nānā-citra-vicitrāḍhyaṃ manoyāyi mamoharam /
children.translated_text: richly adorned with various colorful decorations, moving at the speed of thought, captivating the mind,

children.text: muktāmāṇikya-parama-hīrāhārair virājitam // Jss_1,12.18 //
children.translated_text: resplendent with necklaces of pearls, rubies, and the finest diamonds. // Jss 1.12.18 //

children.text: ratna-darpaṇa-lakṣaiś ca tri-lakṣaiḥ śveta-cāmaraiḥ /
children.translated_text: With hundreds of thousands of gem-mirrors and three hundred thousand white <s>cāmaras</s> (fly-whisks),

children.text: vahni-śuddhāṃśukānāṃ ca tri-lakṣaiḥ pariśobhitam // Jss_1,12.19 //
children.translated_text: graced with three hundred thousand fire-purified silken fabrics. // Jss 1.12.19 //

children.text: tri-koṭibhiś ca jvalitaṃ krīḍā-sundara-mandiraiḥ /
children.translated_text: Blazing with thirty million beautiful pleasure-pavilions,

children.text: pārijāta-prasūnānāṃ mandarāṇāṃ manoharaiḥ // Jss_1,12.20 //
children.translated_text: with enchanting garlands of <s>pārijāta</s> and <s>mandāra</s> flowers, // Jss 1.12.20 //

children.text: mālājālais tri-lakṣaiś ca mālatīnāṃ ca maṇḍitam /
children.translated_text: adorned with three hundred thousand nets of garlands of <s>mālatī</s> blossoms.

children.text: evaṃbhūtaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā dadṛśus te tad-anantare // Jss_1,12.21 //
children.translated_text: Having seen such a chariot, they then beheld within it — // Jss 1.12.21 //

children.text: madhya-koṣṭhābhyantare ca kiśoraṃ śyāma-sundaram /
children.translated_text: in the inner central chamber — a youth, dark and beautiful,

children.text: vahni-śuddhāṃśukenaiva pīta-varṇena śobhitam // Jss_1,12.22 //
children.translated_text: adorned with fire-purified silk of yellow color, // Jss 1.12.22 //

body.translated_text: embellished with gem armlets, bracelets, and gem anklets, his cheeks radiant with a pair of gem earrings, // Jss 1.12.23 //

children.text: īṣaddhāsya-prasannāsyaṃ nityopāsyaṃ surāsuraiḥ /
children.translated_text: his face gracious with a gentle smile, eternally worshipped by gods and demons,

children.text: candanokṣita-sarvāṅgaṃ mālatī-mālya-maṇḍitam // Jss_1,12.24 //
children.translated_text: all his limbs anointed with sandalwood, adorned with garlands of <s>mālatī</s> flowers, // Jss 1.12.24 //

children.text: maṇinā kaustubhendreṇa gaṇḍa-sthala-vibhūṣitam /
children.translated_text: his cheeks adorned with the <s>Kaustubha</s> jewel, foremost of gems —

children.text: paraṃ pradhānaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānam īśvaram // Jss_1,12.25 //
children.translated_text: the Supreme, the Primordial, the Highest, the Supreme Self, the Lord, // Jss 1.12.25 //

children.text: stutaṃ brahmeśa-śeṣaiś ca rādhā-vakṣaḥ sthala-sthitam /
children.translated_text: praised by <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Īśa</s> (Śiva), <s>Śeṣa</s> and others, dwelling upon <s>Rādhā's</s> breast,

children.text: vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca svecchāmayam anīśvaram // Jss_1,12.26 //
children.translated_text: inexpressible by the <s>Vedas</s>, self-willed, without a master, // Jss 1.12.26 //

children.text: nityaṃ nityaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca jyoti-rūpaṃ sanātanam /
children.translated_text: eternal, ever eternal, beyond the <s>guṇas</s>, of the form of light, everlasting,

children.text: prakṛteḥ param īśānaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram // Jss_1,12.27 //
children.translated_text: the ruler beyond <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature), eager to bestow grace upon devotees, // Jss 1.12.27 //

children.text: koṭi-kandarpa-lāvaṇya-līlā-dhāma-manoharam /
children.translated_text: enchanting as the abode of the playful beauty of ten million <s>Kandarpas</s> (gods of love),

children.text: mayūra-puccha-cūḍaṃ ca varaṃ vaṃśī-dharaṃ paraṃ // Jss_1,12.28 //
children.translated_text: wearing a peacock-feather crest, the supreme, the excellent one holding a flute — // Jss 1.12.28 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvā tam adbhutaṃ rūpaṃ tuṣṭāva kamalodbhavaḥ /
children.translated_text: seeing that wondrous form, the lotus-born (<s>Brahmā</s>) offered praise,

children.text: gaṇeśaḥ śeṣaḥ śambhuś ca tad-anye munayaḥ surāḥ // Jss_1,12.29 //
children.translated_text: as did <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, <s>Śeṣa</s>, <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva), and the other sages and gods. // Jss 1.12.29 //

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramātmānam īśvaram /
children.translated_text: I salute the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>, the Supreme Abode, the Supreme Self, the Lord,

children.text: vande vandyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam // Jss_1,12.30 //
children.translated_text: the one worthy of worship by all, the Cause of all causes. // Jss 1.12.30 //

children.text: sarveśvaraṃ sarva-rūpaṃ sarvādyaṃ sadbhir īḍitam /
children.translated_text: The Lord of all, of universal form, the origin of all, praised by the virtuous,

children.text: vedāvedyaṃ ca vidvadbhir na dṛṣṭaṃ svapna-gocare // Jss_1,12.31 //
children.translated_text: knowable through the <s>Vedas</s>, yet unseen by the learned even in the realm of dreams. // Jss 1.12.31 //

children.text: śrī-mahādeva uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Mahādeva</s> said:

children.text: siddha-svarūpaṃ siddhādyaṃ siddha-bījaṃ sanātanam /
children.translated_text: I salute Him whose nature is perfection (<s>siddha</s>), the origin of the perfected ones, the eternal seed of perfection,

children.text: prasiddhaṃ siddhidaṃ śāntaṃ siddhānāṃ ca guror gurum // Jss_1,12.32 //
children.translated_text: the well-known one, the bestower of <s>siddhis</s> (supernatural attainments), the peaceful one, the Guru of the Gurus of the <s>Siddhas</s>. // Jss 1.12.32 //

children.text: vande vandyaṃ ca mahatāṃ parāt parataraṃ vibhum /
children.translated_text: I salute Him who is worthy of worship by the great, the all-pervading Lord, higher than the highest,

children.text: svātmā-rāmaṃ pūrṇa-kāmaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram // Jss_1,12.33 //
children.translated_text: who delights in His own Self, whose desires are fulfilled, who is eager to bestow grace upon devotees. // Jss 1.12.33 //

children.text: bhakti-priyaṃ ca bhakteśaṃ sva-bhakti-dāsyadaṃ param /
children.translated_text: Who is fond of devotion, the Lord of devotees, who grants servitude through His own devotion, the Supreme,

children.text: sva-pada-pradam ekaṃ ca dātāraṃ sarva-sampadām // Jss_1,12.34 //
children.translated_text: the sole bestower of His own abode, the giver of all prosperity. // Jss 1.12.34 //

children.text: ananta uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Ananta</s> said:

children.text: vaktrāṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa kiṃ vā staumi śruti-śrutam /
children.translated_text: With a thousand mouths, how can I praise Him who is heard in the <s>Śrutis</s> (Vedas)?

children.text: koṭibhiḥ koṭibhir vaktraiḥ ko vā stotuṃ kṣamaḥ prabho // Jss_1,12.35 //
children.translated_text: With crores upon crores of mouths, who indeed is capable of praising [You], O Lord? // Jss 1.12.35 //

children.text: kim u stoṣyati śambhuś ca pañca-vaktreṇa vāñcchitam /
children.translated_text: How can <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva) praise [You] with his five mouths, O desired one?

children.text: kartā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ kiṃ stoṣyati catur-mukhaḥ // Jss_1,12.36 //
children.translated_text: How can the four-faced one (<s>Brahmā</s>), the creator of the four <s>Vedas</s>, praise [You]? // Jss 1.12.36 //

children.text: ṣaḍ-vaktro gaja-vaktraś ca devāś ca munayo 'pi vā /
children.translated_text: The six-faced one (<s>Skanda</s>), the elephant-faced one (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>), the gods, or even the sages,

children.text: vedā vā kiṃ veda-vidaḥ stuvanti prakṛteḥ param // Jss_1,12.37 //
children.translated_text: or the <s>Vedas</s>, or the knowers of the <s>Vedas</s> — can they praise Him who is beyond <s>Prakṛti</s>? // Jss 1.12.37 //

children.text: vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca vedā nirvaktum akṣamāḥ /
children.translated_text: He is inexpressible by the <s>Vedas</s>, and the <s>Vedas</s> are unable to describe Him;

children.text: veda-vijñāta-vākyena vidvāṃsaḥ kiṃ stuvanti tam // Jss_1,12.38 //
children.translated_text: with words understood through Vedic knowledge, how can the learned praise Him? // Jss 1.12.38 //

children.text: śrī-gaṇeśa uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Gaṇeśa</s> said:

children.text: mūrkho vadati viṣṇāya budho vadati viṣṇave /
children.translated_text: A fool says '<s>Viṣṇāya</s>' [incorrect dative], a wise one says '<s>Viṣṇave</s>' [correct dative];

children.text: nama ity evam artham ca dvayor eva samaṃ phalam // Jss_1,12.39 //
children.translated_text: '<s>namaḥ</s>' — in meaning, the fruit of both is the same. // Jss 1.12.39 //

children.text: yasmai dattaṃ ca yaj jñānaṃ jñāna-dātā hariḥ svayam /
children.translated_text: Whatever knowledge is given and to whomsoever, <s>Hari</s> Himself is the giver of knowledge;

children.text: jñānena tena sa stauti bhāva-grāhī janārdanaḥ // Jss_1,12.40 //
children.translated_text: with that knowledge one praises Him — <s>Janārdana</s> accepts the sentiment [behind the praise]. // Jss 1.12.40 //

children.text: eka-vaktro 'neka-vaktro mūrkho vidvān sva-karmaṇā /
children.translated_text: Whether one-faced or many-faced, foolish or wise, by one's own actions,

children.text: adhanī ca dhanī vāpi saputro vāpy aputrakaḥ // Jss_1,12.41 //
children.translated_text: whether poor or wealthy, with sons or without sons — // Jss 1.12.41 //

children.text: karmaṇā param īśaṃ ca stotuṃ ko vāpy anuttamam /
children.translated_text: who is capable of praising the Supreme Lord, the unsurpassed, through mere actions?

children.text: yathā-śakti stutiḥ pūjā vandanaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ // Jss_1,12.42 //
children.translated_text: Praise, worship, salutation, and remembrance of <s>Hari</s>, according to one's capacity, // Jss 1.12.42 //

children.text: saṃkīrtanaṃ ca bhajanaṃ japanaṃ buddhy-anukramam /
children.translated_text: singing His names (<s>saṃkīrtana</s>), devotional service (<s>bhajana</s>), and chanting (<s>japa</s>), in accordance with one's understanding —

children.text: kurvanti santo 'santaś ca santataṃ paramātmanaḥ // Jss_1,12.43 //
children.translated_text: the virtuous and even the non-virtuous perform these constantly for the Supreme Self. // Jss 1.12.43 //

children.text: kārtikeya uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Kārtikeya</s> said:

children.text: sarvāntarātmā bhagavān jñānaṃ ca sarva-jīvināṃ /
children.translated_text: The Lord is the inner Self of all, and knowledge belongs to all living beings;

children.text: jñānānurūpaṃ stavanaṃ santo naiva hasanti tam // Jss_1,12.44 //
children.translated_text: praise in accordance with one's knowledge — the virtuous never mock it. // Jss 1.12.44 //

children.text: bhaveṣu tri-vidho loko 'py uttamo madhyamo 'dhamaḥ /
children.translated_text: In the worlds of existence, people are of three kinds: superior, middling, and inferior;

children.text: sarve sva-karma-vaśa-gā niṣekaḥ kena vāryate // Jss_1,12.45 //
children.translated_text: all are subject to their own <s>karma</s> — by whom can the flow [of destiny] be stopped? // Jss 1.12.45 //

children.text: sarveśvaraṃ ca saṃvīkṣya sarvo vadati mat-prabhum /
children.translated_text: Seeing the Lord of all, everyone says 'my Lord';

children.text: mad-īśvarasya samatā sarveṣu kiṃkareṣu ca // Jss_1,12.46 //
children.translated_text: yet my Lord treats all His servants with equal regard. // Jss 1.12.46 //

children.text: bhajanti kecit śuddhāntaṃ paramātmānam īśvaram /
children.translated_text: Some worship the Supreme Self, the Lord, with pure hearts;

children.text: kecit tad-aṃśāṃśaṃ prāpnuvanti krameṇa tam // Jss_1,12.47 //
children.translated_text: some attain a portion of His portion, gradually reaching Him. // Jss 1.12.47 //

children.text: dharma uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> said:

children.text: ahaṃ sākṣī ca sarveṣāṃ vidhinā nirmitaḥ purā /
children.translated_text: I am the witness of all, created of old by the Creator (<s>Brahmā</s>);

children.text: vidhātuś ca vidhātā tvaṃ sarveśvaraṃ namo 'stu te // Jss_1,12.48 //
children.translated_text: You are the creator of the Creator — salutations to You, O Lord of all! // Jss 1.12.48 //

children.text: devā ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The gods said:

children.text: yaṃ stotum asamarthaś ca sahasrāyuḥ svayaṃ vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: He whom <s>Brahmā</s> himself, with a lifespan of a thousand [ages], is unable to praise,

children.text: jñānādhidevaḥ śambhuś ca taṃ stotuṃ kiṃ vayaṃ kṣamāḥ // Jss_1,12.49 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Śambhu</s>, the presiding deity of knowledge — are we capable of praising Him? // Jss 1.12.49 //

children.text: vedā ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Vedas</s> said:

children.text: kiṃ jānīmo vayaṃ ke vāpy ananteśasya yo guṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: What do we know, and who are we? What are the qualities of the Lord of <s>Ananta</s> (the infinite)?

children.text: vayaṃ vedāś tvam asmākaṃ kāraṇasyāpi kārakaḥ // Jss_1,12.50 //
children.translated_text: We are the <s>Vedas</s>, and You are our maker, the cause even of the cause. // Jss 1.12.50 //

children.text: munayaḥ ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The sages said:

children.text: yadi vedā na jānanti māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: If the <s>Vedas</s> do not know the greatness of the Supreme Self,

children.text: na jānīmas tava guṇaṃ vedānusāriṇo vayam // Jss_1,12.51 //
children.translated_text: we, who follow the <s>Vedas</s>, do not know Your qualities either. // Jss 1.12.51 //

children.text: sarasvaty uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s> said:

children.text: vidyādhidevatāhaṃ ca vedā vidyādhidevakāḥ /
children.translated_text: I am the presiding deity of learning, and the <s>Vedas</s> are the deities of knowledge;

children.text: vedādhidevo dhātā ca tad-īśaṃ staumi kiṃ prabho // Jss_1,12.52 //
children.translated_text: the presiding deity of the <s>Vedas</s> is the Creator (<s>Brahmā</s>) — what then can I praise of their Lord, O Master? // Jss 1.12.52 //

children.text: padmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Padmā</s> (Lakṣmī) said:

children.text: yat pāda-padmaṃ padmeśaḥ śeṣāś cānye surās tathā /
children.translated_text: Upon whose lotus feet <s>Padmeśa</s> (Lord of Padmā, i.e., Brahmā/Viṣṇu), <s>Śeṣa</s>, and all other gods

children.text: dhyāyante munayo devā dhyāye taṃ prakṛteḥ param // Jss_1,12.53 //
children.translated_text: meditate — the sages and gods [meditate] — I meditate upon Him who is beyond <s>Prakṛti</s>. // Jss 1.12.53 //

children.text: sāvitry uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Sāvitrī</s> said:

children.text: sāvitrī veda-mātāhaṃ vedānāṃ janako vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: I am <s>Sāvitrī</s>, the mother of the <s>Vedas</s>; the Creator (<s>Brahmā</s>) is the father of the <s>Vedas</s>;

children.text: tvām eva dhatte dhātaraṃ namāmi tri-guṇāt param // Jss_1,12.54 //
children.translated_text: You alone sustain the Creator — I bow to You, who are beyond the three <s>guṇas</s>. // Jss 1.12.54 //

children.text: śrī-pārvaty uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Pārvatī</s> said:

children.text: tava vakṣasi rādhāhaṃ rāse vṛndāvane vane /
children.translated_text: On Your chest I am <s>Rādhā</s>, in the <s>Rāsa</s> [dance], in the forest of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>;

children.text: mahā-lakṣmīś ca vaikuṇṭhe pāda-padmārcane ratā // Jss_1,12.55 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Mahālakṣmī</s> in <s>Vaikuṇṭha</s>, devoted to worshipping Your lotus feet. // Jss 1.12.55 //

children.text: śveta-dvīpe sindhu-kanyā viṣṇor urasi bhū-tale /
children.translated_text: In <s>Śvetadvīpa</s> I am the daughter of the ocean (<s>Sindhukanyā</s>), on <s>Viṣṇu's</s> chest on the earth;

children.text: brahma-loke ca brahmāṇī veda-mātā ca bhāratī // Jss_1,12.56 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Brahmaloka</s> I am <s>Brahmāṇī</s>, the mother of the <s>Vedas</s>, <s>Bhāratī</s>. // Jss 1.12.56 //

children.text: tavājñayā ca devānām avirbhūtā ca tejasi /
children.translated_text: By Your command I manifested in the radiance of the gods,

children.text: nihatya daityān devārīn datvā rājyaṃ surāya ca // Jss_1,12.57 //
children.translated_text: and having slain the demons, the enemies of the gods, I gave the kingdom to the gods. // Jss 1.12.57 //

children.text: tat-paścād dakṣa-kanyāham adhunā pārvatī hare /
children.translated_text: After that, I was the daughter of <s>Dakṣa</s>, and now I am <s>Pārvatī</s>, O <s>Hari</s>;

children.text: tavājñayā hara-kroḍe tvad-bhaktā prati-janmani // Jss_1,12.58 //
children.translated_text: by Your command I am in the lap of <s>Hara</s> (Śiva), Your devotee in every birth. // Jss 1.12.58 //

children.text: nārāyaṇa-priyā śaśvat tena nārāyaṇī śrutau /
children.translated_text: I am eternally dear to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, hence called <s>Nārāyaṇī</s> in the <s>Śruti</s> (Vedas);

children.text: viṣṇor ahaṃ parā-śaktir viṣṇu-māyā ca vaiṣṇavī // Jss_1,12.59 //
children.translated_text: I am the supreme <s>Śakti</s> (power) of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Viṣṇumāyā</s>, the <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>. // Jss 1.12.59 //

children.text: ananta-koṭi brahmāṇḍaṃ mayā sammohitaṃ sadā /
children.translated_text: Infinite crores of universes are perpetually deluded by me;

children.text: viduṣāṃ rasanāgre ca pratyakṣaṃ hi sarasvatī // Jss_1,12.60 //
children.translated_text: yet on the tongues of the wise, I am directly present as <s>Sarasvatī</s>. // Jss 1.12.60 //

children.text: mahā-viṣṇoś ca mātāhaṃ viśvāni yasya lomasu /
children.translated_text: I am the mother of <s>Mahāviṣṇu</s>, in whose body-hairs reside the universes;

children.text: rāmeśvarī ca sarvādyā sarva-śakti-svarūpiṇī // Jss_1,12.61 //
children.translated_text: I am <s>Rāmeśvarī</s>, the primordial one of all, embodying all powers. // Jss 1.12.61 //

children.text: tad-rāse dhāraṇād rādhā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitā /
children.translated_text: Because I am held in His <s>Rāsa</s> dance, the learned call me <s>Rādhā</s>;

children.text: paramānanda-pādābjaṃ vande sānanda-pūrvakam // Jss_1,12.62 //
children.translated_text: I salute the lotus feet of the Supreme Bliss with great joy. // Jss 1.12.62 //

children.text: yat-pāda-padmaṃ dhyāyante paramānanda-kāraṇam /
children.translated_text: The lotus feet that are the cause of supreme bliss, upon which

children.text: pāda-padmeśa-śeṣādyā munayo manavaḥ surāḥ // Jss_1,12.63 //
children.translated_text: <s>Padmeśa</s>, <s>Śeṣa</s> and others, sages, <s>Manus</s>, and gods meditate — // Jss 1.12.63 //

children.text: yoginaḥ santataṃ santaḥ siddhāś ca vaiṣṇavās tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>yogins</s> constantly, the virtuous, the <s>Siddhas</s>, and the <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s> likewise —

children.text: anugrahaṃ kuru vibho buddhi-śaktir ahaṃ tava // Jss_1,12.64 //
children.translated_text: bestow Your grace, O all-pervading one! I am Your power of intellect. // Jss 1.12.64 //

children.text: iti saṃvṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhet saṃyataḥ śuciḥ /
children.translated_text: He who recites this collected hymn with self-control and purity

children.text: ihaiva ca sukhaṃ bhuṅkte yāty ante śrī-hareḥ padam // Jss_1,12.65 //
children.translated_text: enjoys happiness in this very life and at the end attains the abode of Śrī <s>Hari</s>. // Jss 1.12.65 //

children.text: nivṛtteṣu ca vedeṣu devīṣu muni-puṅgave /
children.translated_text: When the <s>Vedas</s>, the Goddesses, and the foremost sages had finished [their hymns],

children.text: upavarhaṇa-gandharvaḥ stutiṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ // Jss_1,12.66 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s> rose to offer praise. // Jss 1.12.66 //

body.translated_text: Now the hymn composed by the <s>Gandharva</s>:

children.text: gandharva uvāca
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> said:

children.text: vande nava-ghana-śyāmaṃ pīta-kauśeya-vāsasam /
children.translated_text: I salute <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, dark as a fresh rain-cloud, wearing yellow silken garments,

children.text: sānandaṃ sundaraṃ śuddhaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param // Jss_1,12.67 //
children.translated_text: blissful, beautiful, pure, and beyond <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature). // Jss 1.12.67 //

children.text: rādheśaṃ rādhikā-prāṇa-vallabhaṃ vallavī-sutam /
children.translated_text: The Lord of <s>Rādhā</s>, the beloved of <s>Rādhikā's</s> life-breath, the son of a cowherd,

children.text: rādhā-sevita-pādābjaṃ rādhā-vakṣaḥ-sthala-sthitam // Jss_1,12.68 //
children.translated_text: whose lotus feet are served by <s>Rādhā</s>, who dwells upon <s>Rādhā's</s> breast, // Jss 1.12.68 //

children.text: rādhānurāgaṃ rādhikeṣṭaṃ rādhāpahṛta-mānasam /
children.translated_text: He who is passionately loved by <s>Rādhā</s>, who is <s>Rādhikā's</s> chosen lord, whose mind is captivated by <s>Rādhā</s>,

children.text: rādhādharaṃ bhavādhāraṃ sarvādhāraṃ namāmi tam // Jss_1,12.69 //
children.translated_text: the support of <s>Rādhā</s>, the support of existence, the support of all — I bow to Him. // Jss 1.12.69 //

children.text: rādhā-hṛt-padma-madhye ca vasantaṃ santataṃ śubham /
children.translated_text: He who dwells perpetually in the lotus of <s>Rādhā's</s> heart, the auspicious one,

children.text: rādhā-saha-caraṃ śaśvat rādhājñā-pari-pālakam // Jss_1,12.70 //
children.translated_text: who is always <s>Rādhā's</s> companion, who perpetually fulfills <s>Rādhā's</s> commands, // Jss 1.12.70 //

children.text: dhyāyante yogino yogāt siddhāḥ siddheśvarāś ca yam /
children.translated_text: upon whom the <s>yogins</s> meditate through <s>yoga</s>, and the <s>Siddhas</s> and lords of <s>Siddhas</s> —

children.text: taṃ dhyāye satataṃ śuddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,12.71 //
children.translated_text: upon Him I meditate constantly — the pure, the Blessed Lord, the Eternal. // Jss 1.12.71 //

children.text: sevante santataṃ santo brahmeśa-śeṣa-saṃjñakāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those called <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Īśa</s> (Śiva), and <s>Śeṣa</s> serve Him constantly, the virtuous ones;

children.text: sevante nirguṇaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,12.72 //
children.translated_text: they serve the qualityless <s>Brahman</s>, the Blessed Lord, the Eternal. // Jss 1.12.72 //

children.text: nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmānam īśvaram /
children.translated_text: Untainted, desireless, the Supreme Self, the Lord,

children.text: nityaṃ satyaṃ ca paraṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,12.73 //
children.translated_text: eternal, true, supreme — the Blessed Lord, the Eternal. // Jss 1.12.73 //

children.text: yaṃ sṛṣṭer ādi-bhūtaṃ ca sarva-bījaṃ parāt param /
children.translated_text: He who existed before creation, the seed of all, the highest beyond the high —

children.text: yoginas taṃ prapadyante bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,12.74 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yogins</s> take refuge in Him, the Blessed Lord, the Eternal. // Jss 1.12.74 //

children.text: bījaṃ nānāvatārāṇāṃ sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam /
children.translated_text: The seed of all the various <s>avatāras</s> (incarnations), the Cause of all causes,

children.text: vedāvedyaṃ veda-bījaṃ veda-kāraṇa-kāraṇam // Jss_1,12.75 //
children.translated_text: knowable through the <s>Vedas</s>, the seed of the <s>Vedas</s>, the Cause of the cause of the <s>Vedas</s> — // Jss 1.12.75 //

body.translated_text: the <s>yogins</s> take refuge in Him, the Blessed Lord, the Eternal.

body.text: ity evam uktvā gandharvaḥ papāta dharaṇī-tale // Jss_1,12.76 //
body.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the <s>Gandharva</s> fell upon the ground, // Jss 1.12.76 //

children.text: nanāma daṇḍavad bhūmau deva-devaṃ parāt param /
children.translated_text: and bowed prostrate on the earth before the God of gods, the highest beyond the high.

children.text: iti tena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ śuciḥ // Jss_1,12.77 //
children.translated_text: He who recites this hymn composed by him, with effort and purity, // Jss 1.12.77 //

children.text: ihaiva jīvan-muktaś ca pare yāti parāṃ gatim /
children.translated_text: becomes a <s>jīvanmukta</s> (liberated while living) in this very life and attains the supreme destination in the next;

children.text: hari-bhaktiṃ harer dāsyaṃ goloke ca nirāmayaḥ /
children.translated_text: he obtains devotion to <s>Hari</s>, servitude to <s>Hari</s>, and in <s>Goloka</s>, free from disease,

children.text: pārṣada-pravaratvaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ // Jss_1,12.78 //
children.translated_text: the status of a foremost attendant — there is no doubt in this. // Jss 1.12.78 //

body.text:
iti śrī-nārada-pañca-rātre jñānāmṛta-sāre prathamaika-rātre
gandharva-kṛta-stotraṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the twelfth chapter, called 'The Hymn Composed by the Gandharva,' in the first night of the <s>Jñānāmṛtasāra</s> within the <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>.
Thirteenth chapter of the first night.

children.text: śrī-śuka uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śuka</s> said:

children.text: stotrāntare ca kāle ca kiṃ rahasyaṃ babhūva ha /
children.translated_text: After the hymns were concluded, what secret event took place?

children.text: tan me kathaya bhadraṃ te bhagavan bhagavad-vacaḥ // Jss_1,13.1 //
children.translated_text: Tell me that, O blessed one — may it be auspicious for you — O revered one, the words of the Lord. // Jss 1.13.1 //

children.text: śrī-vyāsa uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Vyāsa</s> said:

children.text: stotrāntare ca kāle ca gandharvaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: After the hymns were concluded, the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s>

children.text: uvāca brahma-saṃsadi bhagavantaṃ sanātanam // Jss_1,13.2 //
children.translated_text: spoke in the assembly of <s>Brahmā</s> to the Blessed Lord, the Eternal: // Jss 1.13.2 //

children.text: sarvair devair ahaṃ śaptaś cādhunā deva-hetunā /
children.translated_text: I have been cursed by all the gods just now, on account of the gods;

children.text: devānām agni-puñjaś ca pradīptaś ca sumeruvat // Jss_1,13.3 //
children.translated_text: the blazing fire of the gods burns like <s>Sumeru</s>. // Jss 1.13.3 //

children.text: adhunā ca tvayi gate bhasmāsān māṃ kariṣyati /
children.translated_text: Now that You are departing, it will reduce me to ashes;

children.text: ato rakṣa jagannātha māṃ samuddhartum arhasi // Jss_1,13.4 //
children.translated_text: therefore protect me, O Lord of the Universe — You ought to deliver me! // Jss 1.13.4 //

children.text: tvad-aṃśa-śūkareṇaiva dharoddhāraḥ kṛtaḥ purā /
children.translated_text: By Your own partial incarnation as the Boar (<s>Varāha</s>), the earth was uplifted long ago —

children.text: hiraṇyākhyaṃ mahā-daityaṃ nihatya cāvalīlayā // Jss_1,13.5 //
children.translated_text: having effortlessly slain the great <s>Daitya</s> (demon) named <s>Hiraṇya</s>, // 1.13.5 //

children.text: pādma-padmārcita-pade padme te śaraṇāgatam /
children.translated_text: O one whose feet are worshipped with lotuses by <s>Padmā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>), I have taken refuge in you;

children.text: mām anāthaṃ bhayākrāntaṃ rakṣa rakṣa surānalāt // Jss_1,13.6 //
children.translated_text: protect me, protect me — shelterless and seized with fear — from the fire of the gods! // 1.13.6 //

children.text: gandharvasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya jagad-īśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of the <s>Gandharva</s>, the Lord of the universe laughed

children.text: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā brahmeśo brahma-saṃsadi // Jss_1,13.7 //
children.translated_text: and spoke in gentle words, the Lord of <s>Brahman</s>, in the assembly of <s>Brahmā</s>: // 1.13.7 //

body.translated_text: Now, the liberation of the <s>Gandharva</s>:

children.text: śrī-bhagavān uvāca
children.translated_text: The Blessed Lord said:

children.text: gandharva-rāja-pravara sthiro bhava bhayaṃ tyaja /
children.translated_text: 'O best of <s>Gandharva</s> kings, be steady, abandon your fear;

children.text: śubhāśrayasya bhaktasya bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite // Jss_1,13.8 //
children.translated_text: for a devotee who has taken an auspicious refuge, what fear can there be while I am present? // 1.13.8 //

children.text: sarvebhyo 'pi bhayaṃ nāsti mad-bhaktānām akarmaṇām /
children.translated_text: For all my devotees who are free from [selfish] action, there is no fear from anyone;

children.text: janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-bhayaṃ teṣāṃ na vidyate // Jss_1,13.9 //
children.translated_text: fear of birth, death, old age, and disease does not exist for them. // 1.13.9 //

children.text: man-mantropāsakaś caiva svatantro nitya-vigrahaḥ /
children.translated_text: One who worships my <s>mantra</s> is independent, with an eternal body;

children.text: punar na vidyate janma mantra-grahaṇa-mātrataḥ // Jss_1,13.10 //
children.translated_text: there is no further birth merely by the taking of the <s>mantra</s>. // 1.13.10 //

children.text: nāsti kālād bhayaṃ tasya na niṣekād vidher api /
children.translated_text: There is no fear from death for him, nor from destiny or fate;

children.text: mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa mucyate sarva-karmaṇaḥ // Jss_1,13.11 //
children.translated_text: merely by receiving the <s>mantra</s>, one is freed from all <s>karma</s>. // 1.13.11 //

children.text: man-mantro hi dehāt pāpaṃ koṭi-janma-kṛtaṃ ca yat /
children.translated_text: My <s>mantra</s> indeed [destroys] sin from the body, even that accumulated over ten million births,

children.text: sudīpto jvalad-agniś ca tṛṇa-puñjaṃ dehād yathā // Jss_1,13.12 //
children.translated_text: just as a blazing, flaming fire [destroys] a heap of straw from the body. // 1.13.12 //

children.text: man-mantra-grahaṇād yogān man-nāma-grahaṇasya vā /
children.translated_text: Through the practice of receiving my <s>mantra</s>, or of chanting my name,

children.text: teṣāṃ pāpāni vepante koṭi-janma-kṛtāni ca // Jss_1,13.13 //
children.translated_text: the sins accumulated over ten million births tremble before them. // 1.13.13 //

children.text: yamas tan-nāma-likhanaṃ dūrī-bhūtaṃ karoti ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Yama</s> (the god of death) removes their names from the register of the dead;

children.text: ante dāsyaṃ ca labhate gatvā golokam uttamam // Jss_1,13.14 //
children.translated_text: and at the end, having gone to the supreme <s>Goloka</s>, one obtains the status of a servant [of the Lord]. // 1.13.14 //

children.text: yāvad āyur bhramet tāvat svatantro matta-kuñjaraḥ /
children.translated_text: As long as life lasts, one roams freely like an intoxicated elephant;

children.text: tataḥ pāpāḥ phalāyante vainateyād ivoragāḥ // Jss_1,13.15 //
children.translated_text: then sins flee as serpents flee from <s>Vainateya</s> (<s>Garuḍa</s>). // 1.13.15 //

children.text: teṣāṃ ca pāda-rajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā /
children.translated_text: By the dust of their feet, the earth is instantly purified;

children.text: punāti sarva-tīrthāni dūrato darśanād api // Jss_1,13.16 //
children.translated_text: all <s>tīrthas</s> (sacred places) are purified even by seeing them from afar. // 1.13.16 //

children.text: pūtaś ca pavano vahnir jalaṃ ca tulasī-dalam /
