children.translated_text: Purified are the wind, fire, water, and the <s>tulasī</s> leaf;

children.text: pūtāny eva hi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni ca gāyana // Jss_1,13.17 //
children.translated_text: purified indeed are the <s>tīrthas</s> such as the <s>Gaṅgā</s> and others, O singer! // 1.13.17 //

children.text: pūtā suśīlā dharmiṣṭhā suvratā strī pati-vratā /
children.translated_text: Purified is a woman of good conduct, righteous, observing noble vows, devoted to her husband;

children.text: man-mantropāsakāś caiva tebhyaḥ pūtottamāḥ sadā // Jss_1,13.18 //
children.translated_text: but worshippers of my <s>mantra</s> are always the purest among the pure. // 1.13.18 //

children.text: mantropāsakānāṃ ca tīrtha-sthānaṃ vrataṃ suta /
children.translated_text: For worshippers of the <s>mantra</s>, pilgrimage, sacred places, vows, O son,

children.text: śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca yathā carvita-carvaṇam // Jss_1,13.19 //
children.translated_text: <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral rites), charity, worship — all these are like chewing what has already been chewed. // 1.13.19 //

children.text: bhaktyā tīrthāni pūtāni svataḥ pūto hi vaiṣṇavaḥ /
children.translated_text: Through devotion, <s>tīrthas</s> are purified; a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is inherently pure;

children.text: tat tantraṃ ca tathā dāna-malaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca niṣphalam // Jss_1,13.20 //
children.translated_text: that ritual procedure and likewise charity are impure, and <s>śrāddha</s> is fruitless. // 1.13.20 //

children.text: śrāddhasya sampradānaṃ ca kartuś ca puruṣa-trayam /
children.translated_text: The recipient of the <s>śrāddha</s> offering and the performer — three persons;

children.text: puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ muktaṃ ko bhuṅkte śrāddha-vastu ca // Jss_1,13.21 //
children.translated_text: a hundred persons are liberated — who then enjoys the <s>śrāddha</s> offerings? // 1.13.21 //

children.text: kecid evaṃ vadantīti pitṛ-lokārtham eva ca /
children.translated_text: Some say thus — that it is for the sake of the world of the ancestors;

children.text: tad-viruddhaṃ ca te tuṣṭā mantra-grahaṇa-mātrataḥ // Jss_1,13.22 //
children.translated_text: but contradicting that, they [the ancestors] are satisfied merely by the receiving of the <s>mantra</s>. // 1.13.22 //

children.text: teṣāṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ karma naiva bhogāya kalpate /
children.translated_text: For them, their auspicious and blessed <s>karma</s> does not ripen into enjoyment,

children.text: devān na prabhaved vatsa siddha-dhānye yathāṅkuraḥ // Jss_1,13.23 //
children.translated_text: just as a sprout does not emerge from cooked grain, O child. // 1.13.23 //

children.text: sākṣāt karoti teṣāṃ ca karma-mūla-nikṛntanam /
children.translated_text: It directly cuts the root of their <s>karma</s>;

children.text: mantropāsakād anye karma-bhogaṃ ca bhuñjate // Jss_1,13.24 //
children.translated_text: those other than the worshippers of the <s>mantra</s> experience the enjoyment of <s>karma</s>. // 1.13.24 //

children.text: mayā svayaṃ pradattaś ca sva-mantraḥ puruṣāya ca /
children.translated_text: My own <s>mantra</s>, given by me personally to a person,

children.text: para-dvārād grāhayitvā bhaktaṃ muktaṃ karomy aham // Jss_1,13.25 //
children.translated_text: having caused him to receive it through another's door [i.e., through a guru], I make that devotee liberated. // 1.13.25 //

children.text: mayā pradatta-mantraś ca purā mṛtyuñjayas tathā /
children.translated_text: The <s>mantra</s> given by me was previously [given] to <s>Mṛtyuñjaya</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) as well,

children.text: mṛtyuñjayāya goloke śuddha-sattva-guṇāya ca // Jss_1,13.26 //
children.translated_text: to <s>Mṛtyuñjaya</s> in <s>Goloka</s>, who is of pure <s>sattva</s> quality; // 1.13.26 //

children.text: punaḥ sanat-kumārāya dharmāya brahmaṇe tathā /
children.translated_text: then to <s>Sanatkumāra</s>, to <s>Dharma</s>, to <s>Brahmā</s>,

children.text: kapilāya ca śeṣāya gaṇeśāya ca mahā-mate // Jss_1,13.27 //
children.translated_text: to <s>Kapila</s>, to <s>Śeṣa</s>, and to <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, O great-minded one, // 1.13.27 //

children.text: nārāyaṇarṣaye caiva dharma-putrāya dhīmate /
children.translated_text: and to the sage <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, and to the wise son of <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: punar mahā-viṣṇave ca viśvāni yasya lomasu // Jss_1,13.28 //
children.translated_text: and then to <s>Mahā-Viṣṇu</s>, in whose body-hairs the universes reside, // 1.13.28 //

children.text: kālādhiṣṭhātṛ-devāya tasmai sarvāntakāya ca /
children.translated_text: to the presiding deity of time, to that one who ends all,

children.text: upendrāya ca kāmāya bhṛgave 'ṅgirase tathā // Jss_1,13.29 //
children.translated_text: to <s>Upendra</s>, to <s>Kāma</s>, to <s>Bhṛgu</s>, and to <s>Aṅgiras</s> likewise, // 1.13.29 //

children.text: sarasvatyai ca padmāyai rādhāyai virajā-taṭe /
children.translated_text: to <s>Sarasvatī</s>, to <s>Padmā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>), to <s>Rādhā</s> on the bank of the <s>Virajā</s>,

children.text: śavitryai viṣṇu-māyāyai pārṣadebhyaś ca putraka // Jss_1,13.30 //
children.translated_text: to <s>Sāvitrī</s>, to <s>Viṣṇu-māyā</s>, and to the attendants, O little son. // 1.13.30 //

children.text: tubhyaṃ na datto mantro 'tra śrūyatāṃ tan nimittakam /
children.translated_text: To you, however, the <s>mantra</s> was not given here — hear the reason for that:

children.text: janiṣyasi śūdra-yonau brahmaṇo vākya-pālanāt // Jss_1,13.31 //
children.translated_text: you shall be born in a <s>śūdra</s> womb, due to the observance of <s>Brahmā</s>'s command. // 1.13.31 //

children.text: ity evaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha vatsa yathā sukham /
children.translated_text: Thus everything has been told; go, O child, in peace.

children.text: dvādaśābdāntare śūdra-yonau devāj janiṣyasi // Jss_1,13.32 //
children.translated_text: Within twelve years, you shall be born from a <s>śūdra</s> womb by divine [ordination]. // 1.13.32 //

children.text: pañca-varṣābhyantare ca man-mantraṃ prāpya viprataḥ /
children.translated_text: Within five years, having received my <s>mantra</s> from a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>,

children.text: daśābdānte vapus tyaktvā brahma-putro bhaviṣyasi // Jss_1,13.33 //
children.translated_text: at the end of ten years, having shed that body, you shall become a son of <s>Brahmā</s>. // 1.13.33 //

body.translated_text: You shall receive my <s>mantra</s> again from the mouth of <s>Śambhu</s>.'

body.text: ity evam uktvā sarvātmā tatraivāntaradhīyata // Jss_1,13.34 //
body.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the All-Self disappeared right there. // 1.13.34 //

children.text: gandharvaḥ prayayau tasmād yoṣidbhiḥ saha putraka /
children.translated_text: The <s>Gandharva</s> departed from there together with his women, O little son.

children.text: ity evaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrva-vṛttāntam eva ca // Jss_1,13.35 //
children.translated_text: Thus everything has been told, including the account of what happened previously. // 1.13.35 //

body.text:
iti śrī-nārada-pañca-rātre jñānāmṛta-sāre prathamaika-rātre
gandharva-mokṣaṇaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, called 'The Liberation of the <s>Gandharva</s>,' in the first night of the <s>Jñānāmṛtasāra</s> within the <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>.
Fourteenth chapter of the first night.

children.text: śrī-śuka uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Śuka</s> said:

children.text: prayāte rādhikā-nāthe golokaṃ ca nirāmayam /
children.translated_text: 'When the Lord of <s>Rādhikā</s> departed to the faultless <s>Goloka</s>,

children.text: babhūva kiṃ rahasyaṃ ca gate gandharva-puṅgave // Jss_1,14.1 //
children.translated_text: what happened in secret after the foremost <s>Gandharva</s> had gone? // 1.14.1 //'

children.text: śrī-vyāsa uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Vyāsa</s> said:

children.text: sarve devāś ca munayaḥ prayāte paramātmani /
children.translated_text: 'When the Supreme Self had departed, all the gods and sages

children.text: sarve babhūvus te tūṣṇīṃ vayāṃsīva dinātyaye // Jss_1,14.2 //
children.translated_text: all fell silent, like birds at the end of day. // 1.14.2 //

children.text: uvāca śambhur brahmāṇaṃ nīti-sāra-viśāradam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śambhu</s> spoke to <s>Brahmā</s>, who was well-versed in the essence of statecraft,

children.text: jñānādhidevo bhagavān pariṇāma-sukhaṃ vacaḥ // Jss_1,14.3 //
children.translated_text: the Blessed Lord of knowledge, words that resulted in happiness: // 1.14.3 //

children.text: śrī-mahā-deva uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Mahādeva</s> said:

children.text: rakṣitā yasya bhagavān kalyāṇaṃ tasya santatam /
children.translated_text: 'He whose protector is the Lord — for him there is perpetual welfare;

children.text: sa yasya vighna-kartā ca rakṣituṃ taṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ // Jss_1,14.4 //
children.translated_text: and he for whom He is the creator of obstacles — who is able to protect him? // 1.14.4 //

children.text: smṛti-mātreṇa nirvighnā ye ca kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: By mere remembrance, those who are devoted to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> are freed from obstacles;

children.text: vighnaṃ kartuṃ ke samarthās teṣāṃ ca munayaḥ surāḥ // Jss_1,14.5 //
children.translated_text: who among sages and gods is capable of creating obstacles for them? // 1.14.5 //

children.text: kopāgnināṃ sthalaṃ kutra stambhitānāṃ ca sāmpratam /
children.translated_text: Where is there a place now for the fires of anger of the gods

children.text: devānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca kṣaṇenaiveśvarecchayā // Jss_1,14.6 //
children.translated_text: and sages who have been paralyzed in an instant by the will of the Lord? // 1.14.6 //

children.text: yadi tiṣṭhanti bhūmau ca dagdha-śasyā vasundharā /
children.translated_text: If they remain on the earth, the earth with its crops will be burned;

children.text: jale yadi tatas taptaṃ naṣṭhāste jala-jantavaḥ // Jss_1,14.7 //
children.translated_text: if in water, then the water will be heated and the aquatic creatures will perish. // 1.14.7 //

children.text: sthāle dahanti lokāṃś ca vṛkṣāṃś ca pralayāgnayaḥ /
children.translated_text: On dry land, the fires of dissolution would burn the worlds and the trees;

children.text: vidhānaṃ kartum ucitam eṣāṃ ca jagatāṃ vidhe // Jss_1,14.8 //
children.translated_text: a proper arrangement should be made for these [fires], O Creator of the worlds. // 1.14.8 //

children.text: tvam eva dhātā jagatāṃ pitā ca viṣṇur īśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: You yourself are the sustainer of the worlds and the father; <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the Lord;

children.text: kālāgni-rudraḥ saṃhartā nedānī pralaya-kṣamaḥ // Jss_1,14.9 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kālāgni-Rudra</s> is the destroyer — but now is not the time for dissolution. // 1.14.9 //

children.text: ete viṣayiṇaḥ sarve kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: All these, being within the domain of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the Supreme Self,

children.text: ājñāvahāś ca satataṃ dik-pālāś ca dig-īśvarāḥ // Jss_1,14.10 //
children.translated_text: are perpetual bearers of His command — the guardians and lords of the directions. // 1.14.10 //

children.text: tasyaivājñāvaho dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇāṃ nṛṇām /
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> too is the bearer of His command and the witness of men's actions;

children.text: bhramanti viṣaye śaśvan mohitā māyayā hareḥ // Jss_1,14.11 //
children.translated_text: they all wander perpetually in the realm of the senses, deluded by the <s>māyā</s> of <s>Hari</s>. // 1.14.11 //

children.text: ahaṃ na pātā na sraṣṭā na saṃhartā ca jīvanām /
children.translated_text: I am not the protector, not the creator, not the destroyer of beings;

children.text: nirlipto ' haṃ tapasvī ca harer ārādhanonmukhaḥ // Jss_1,14.12 //
children.translated_text: I am untainted, an ascetic, devoted to the worship of <s>Hari</s>. // 1.14.12 //

children.text: saṃhāra-viṣayaṃ mahyaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇaś ca purā dadau /
children.translated_text: The domain of destruction was given to me formerly by Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: datvā rudrāya tad ahaṃ tapasyāsu rato hareḥ // Jss_1,14.13 //
children.translated_text: having given it to <s>Rudra</s>, I am devoted to austerities for <s>Hari</s>. // 1.14.13 //

children.text: tad-arcanena dhyānena tapasā pūjanena ca /
children.translated_text: Through the worship of Him, through meditation, austerity, and adoration,

children.text: stavena kavacanenaiva nāma-mantra-japena ca // Jss_1,14.14 //
children.translated_text: through hymns and the <s>kavaca</s>, and through the chanting of His name and <s>mantra</s>, // 1.14.14 //

children.text: mṛtyuñjayo ' haṃ adhunā na ca kālād bhayaṃ mama /
children.translated_text: I am now the conqueror of death (<s>Mṛtyuñjaya</s>), and there is no fear of death for me;

children.text: kālaḥ saṃharate sarvaṃ māṃ vinā ca tatheśvaram // Jss_1,14.15 //
children.translated_text: death destroys everything except me and the Lord likewise. // 1.14.15 //

children.text: purā sarvādi-sarge ca kasyacit sraṣṭur eva ca /
children.translated_text: In the primordial creation of all, of a certain creator,

children.text: bhālodbhavāś ca te rudrās teṣv eko ' haṃ śaṅkaraḥ // Jss_1,14.16 //
children.translated_text: those <s>Rudras</s> born from his forehead — among them I am the one called <s>Śaṅkara</s>. // 1.14.16 //

children.text: kalpaś ca brahmaṇaḥ pāte laye prākṛtike tathā /
children.translated_text: At the <s>kalpa</s> (cosmic cycle), at the fall of <s>Brahmā</s>, at the dissolution into <s>Prakṛti</s>,

children.text: sarve naṣṭā viṣayiṇo na bhaktāś ca yatheśvaraḥ // Jss_1,14.17 //
children.translated_text: all those within the domain of the senses perish — but not the devotees, just as the Lord [does not perish]. // 1.14.17 //

children.text: asaṃkhya-brahmaṇaḥ pātaḥ kalpaś cāsaṃkhya eva ca /
children.translated_text: The falls of innumerable <s>Brahmās</s> and innumerable <s>kalpas</s>

children.text: samatītaḥ kati-vidho bhavitā yā punaḥ punaḥ // Jss_1,14.18 //
children.translated_text: have passed — of how many kinds — and shall occur again and again. // 1.14.18 //

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇasya nimeṣeṇa brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: By a mere blink of Śrī <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s eye, the fall of <s>Brahmā</s> occurs;

children.text: tatra prākṛtikāḥ sarve tiro-bhūtāḥ punaḥ punaḥ // Jss_1,14.19 //
children.translated_text: there, all material beings vanish again and again. // 1.14.19 //

children.text: na prākṛto na viṣayī nitya-dehī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ /
children.translated_text: A <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> is not material, not bound to the senses, and has an eternal body;

children.text: harer vareṇāmaro 'haṃ śivādhāras tatas tataḥ // Jss_1,14.20 //
children.translated_text: by the boon of <s>Hari</s>, I am immortal, established in <s>Śiva</s>, here and there. // 1.14.20 //

children.text: jala-plutaṃ ca viśvaughaṃ laye prākṛtike dhruvam /
children.translated_text: All the worlds are flooded with water at the dissolution into <s>Prakṛti</s>, certainly,

children.text: ābrahma-loka-paryantaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇālayaṃ vinā // Jss_1,14.21 //
children.translated_text: up to the world of <s>Brahmā</s>, except for the supreme abode of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // 1.14.21 //

children.text: sarvā devyo vilīnāś ca kṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ suniścitam /
children.translated_text: All goddesses dissolve — <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> alone is the truth, most certainly;

children.text: sarve pumāṃso līnāś ca satye nitye sanātane // Jss_1,14.22 //
children.translated_text: all male beings dissolve — into the true, eternal, and primordial one. // 1.14.22 //

children.text: ahaṃ kṛṣṇaś ca prakṛtiḥ pārṣada-pravaro hareḥ /
children.translated_text: I, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature), and the foremost attendants of <s>Hari</s>

children.text: nityaṃ nityā vidyamānā goloke ca nirāmaye // Jss_1,14.23 //
children.translated_text: are eternally present, always existing, in the faultless <s>Goloka</s>. // 1.14.23 //

children.text: eka īśo na dvitīya iti sarvādi-sargataḥ /
children.translated_text: There is one Lord and no second — this is so from the very first creation;

children.text: nahi naśyanti tad-bhaktāḥ prakṛti-prākṛte laye // Jss_1,14.24 //
children.translated_text: His devotees do not perish in the dissolution of <s>Prakṛti</s> and the material realm. // 1.14.24 //

children.text: tasya bhaktottamānāṃ ca satataṃ smaraṇena ca /
children.translated_text: For the best of His devotees, through constant remembrance of Him,

children.text: āyur-vyayo nahi bhavet kathaṃ mṛtyur bhaviṣyati // Jss_1,14.25 //
children.translated_text: there is no depletion of life — how then could death befall them? // 1.14.25 //

children.text: na vāsudeva-bhaktānām aśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit /
children.translated_text: For the devotees of <s>Vāsudeva</s>, nothing inauspicious exists anywhere;

children.text: teṣāṃ bhaktottamānāṃ ca satataṃ smaraṇena ca // Jss_1,14.26 //
children.translated_text: for those best of devotees, through constant remembrance, // 1.14.26 //

children.text: janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-bhayaṃ nāpy upajāyate /
children.translated_text: fear of birth, death, old age, and disease does not arise.

children.text: atra kalpe bhavān brahmā vyavasthātā ca karmasu // Jss_1,14.27 //
children.translated_text: In this <s>kalpa</s>, you are <s>Brahmā</s>, the ordainer in [all] actions. // 1.14.27 //

children.text: sthalaṃ kopānalānāṃ ca vidhānaṃ yad vidhe kuru /
children.translated_text: Make a proper arrangement and place for the fires of anger, O Creator.'

children.text: śambhoś ca vacanaṃ śrutvā kampitaḥ kamalāsanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of <s>Śambhu</s>, the lotus-seated one (<s>Brahmā</s>) trembled,

children.text: sthalaṃ cakāra vahnīnām ājñayā śaṅkarasya ca // Jss_1,14.28 //
children.translated_text: and by the command of <s>Śaṅkara</s>, he made a place for the fires. // 1.14.28 //

children.text: brahmovaca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: jvaras tri-pādas tri-śirāḥ ṣaḍ-bhujo nava-locanaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'The fever (<s>jvara</s>) — three-footed, three-headed, six-armed, nine-eyed,

children.text: bhasma-praharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ // Jss_1,14.29 //
children.translated_text: with ashes as his weapon, terrible, resembling <s>Kāla</s>, <s>Antaka</s>, and <s>Yama</s> — // 1.14.29 //

children.text: bhave bhavatu sarvatra bhava-kopānalo 'dhunā /
children.translated_text: let the fire of <s>Bhava</s>'s (<s>Śiva</s>'s) anger exist everywhere in the world henceforth;

children.text: prākṛteṣu ca deheṣu vyāpāro 'sya mayā kṛtaḥ // Jss_1,14.30 //
children.translated_text: I have assigned its operation to the material bodies. // 1.14.30 //

children.text: mama kopānalaḥ śambho saṃskṛtāgnir dvijasya ca /
children.translated_text: The fire of my anger, O <s>Śambhu</s>, and the consecrated fire of the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>,

children.text: bhave bhavatu sarvatra vyāpāro 'sya mayā kṛtaḥ // Jss_1,14.31 //
children.translated_text: let it exist everywhere in the world — I have assigned its operation. // 1.14.31 //

children.text: śeṣasya kopa-vahniś ca śeṣāsye 'stv adhunā śiva /
children.translated_text: The fire of <s>Śeṣa</s>'s anger — let it be in <s>Śeṣa</s>'s mouth now, O <s>Śiva</s>,

children.text: yato viśvaṃ ca pralaye dahed gomaya-piṇḍavat // Jss_1,14.32 //
children.translated_text: by which at the dissolution it would burn the universe like a ball of cow-dung. // 1.14.32 //

children.text: vahner mukhyānalo viśve vyavahārāgnir īśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: The chief fire of <s>Agni</s> (Fire) in the world — it is the practical fire, O Lord;

children.text: bhvatv eva hi sarvatra sarveṣām upakārakaḥ // Jss_1,14.33 //
children.translated_text: let it exist everywhere, of benefit to all. // 1.14.33 //

children.text: dharmāsya-kopa-vahniś ca kṛṣṇāgniś ca bhavatv ayam /
children.translated_text: The fire of <s>Dharma</s>'s mouth-anger — let this become the fire of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: adharmaṃ kurvatāṃ sarvaṃ dāhanaṃ ca kariṣyati // Jss_1,14.34 //
children.translated_text: it shall burn everything of those who commit <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness). // 1.14.34 //

children.text: sūrya-kopānalaś cāyaṃ dāvāgniś ca vaneṣu ca /
children.translated_text: The fire of the Sun's anger — this shall be the forest-fire in the forests;

children.text: sthitir asya taroḥ skandhe tad-bhakṣyāḥ paśu-pakṣiṇaḥ // Jss_1,14.35 //
children.translated_text: its abode is in the trunk of trees, and its fuel is the animals and birds. // 1.14.35 //

children.text: candra-kopānalo viśve kāmināṃ virahānalaḥ /
children.translated_text: The fire of the Moon's anger in the world shall be the fire of separation for lovers;

children.text: dampatyor virahe śaśvad bhakṣyati sma dvayos tanum // Jss_1,14.36 //
children.translated_text: it perpetually consumes the bodies of both when husband and wife are parted. // 1.14.36 //

children.text: indra-kopānalaḥ sadyo vajrāgniś ca babhūva ha /
children.translated_text: The fire of <s>Indra</s>'s anger instantly became the fire of the thunderbolt;

children.text: upendrasyānalaś caiva vidyud eva bhvatv ayam // Jss_1,14.37 //
children.translated_text: and the fire of <s>Upendra</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>) — let this become lightning itself. // 1.14.37 //

children.text: rudrāṇām āsya-vahniś ca maholkāgnir bhavatv ayam /
children.translated_text: The fire from the mouths of the <s>Rudras</s> — let this become the fire of meteors;

children.text: gaṇeśāgniḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu yathāsthāne tu tiṣṭhati // Jss_1,14.38 //
children.translated_text: the fire of <s>Gaṇeśa</s> remains on the earth in its proper place. // 1.14.38 //

children.text: yatra tiṣṭhet tad uṣaram evam evaṃ vidur budhāḥ /
children.translated_text: Wherever it remains, that land becomes barren — thus the wise know.

children.text: skanda-kopānalaś caiva raṇāstrāgnir babhūva ha // Jss_1,14.39 //
children.translated_text: and the fire of <s>Skanda</s>'s wrath became the fire of weapons in battle. // 1.14.39 //

children.text: kāmetarāṇāṃ devānāṃ munīnāṃ ca mukhānalaḥ /
children.translated_text: The fire [of desire] from the mouths of the gods other than <s>Kāma</s> and of the sages —

children.text: jagrāhaurva-munis tatra tejasi brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ // Jss_1,14.40 //
children.translated_text: the sage <s>Ūrva</s> (Aurva), son of <s>Brahmā</s>, seized that radiance there. // 1.14.40 //

children.text: sva-dakṣiṇorau sa muniḥ saṃsthāpya veda-mantrataḥ /
children.translated_text: That sage, having placed it on his own right thigh through <s>Vedic</s> <s>mantras</s>,

children.text: brahmaṇaṃ ca namas-kṛtya śaṅkaraṃ tapase yayau // Jss_1,14.41 //
children.translated_text: bowed to <s>Brahmā</s> and <s>Śaṅkara</s> and departed for <s>tapas</s> (austerities). // 1.14.41 //

children.text: kālena tasmān niḥsṛtya samudre vāḍavānalaḥ /
children.translated_text: In time, having emerged from that, the submarine fire (<s>vāḍavānala</s>) [entered] the ocean;

children.text: sa babhūva purā putra paramaurvānalaḥ svayam // Jss_1,14.42 //
children.translated_text: that itself, O son, was formerly the great fire of <s>Aurva</s>. // 1.14.42 //

children.text: kāmāgnim ulvaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vicintya manasā vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Seeing the terrible fire of desire, <s>Vidhi</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>) reflected in his mind,

children.text: samālocya suraiḥ sārdhaṃ munīndraiḥ saha saṃsadi // Jss_1,14.43 //
children.translated_text: and having deliberated together with the gods and the chief sages in the assembly, // 1.14.43 //

children.text: ajuhāva striyaḥ sarvāḥ suvratāś ca pati-vratāḥ /
children.translated_text: he summoned all women — the virtuous and the devoted wives;

children.text: āyuyur yoṣitaḥ sarvās tā ūcuḥ kamalodbhavam // Jss_1,14.44 //
children.translated_text: all the women came and spoke to the lotus-born one (<s>Brahmā</s>): // 1.14.44 //

children.text: striya ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The women said:

children.text: kim asmān brūhi bhagavan śādhi naḥ karavāma kim /
children.translated_text: 'What do you command us, O Blessed Lord? Direct us — what shall we do?

children.text: ālocya manasā sarvaṃ dehi bhāraṃ vayaṃ striyaḥ // Jss_1,14.45 //
children.translated_text: Having considered everything in your mind, assign the burden — we are [but] women.' // 1.14.45 //

children.text: brahmovāca
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: gṛhītvā madanāgniṃ ca maithune sukha-dāyakam /
children.translated_text: 'Take the fire of desire, which gives pleasure in sexual union;

children.text: viśve ca yoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ śaśvat-kāmā bhavantu ca // Jss_1,14.46 //
children.translated_text: let all women in the universe be perpetually desirous.' // 1.14.46 //

children.text: brahmaṇaś ca vacaḥ śrutvā kopa-raktāsya-locanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard <s>Brahmā</s>'s words, with eyes reddened by anger,

children.text: tam ūcuḥ yoṣitaḥ sarvā bhayaṃ tyaktvā ca saṃsadi // Jss_1,14.47 //
children.translated_text: all the women spoke to him, having cast aside fear, in the assembly: // 1.14.47 //

children.text: striya ūcuḥ
children.translated_text: The women said:

children.text: dhik tvāṃ jagad-vidhiṃ vyarthaṃ cakāra parameśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Shame on you, O creator of the world — the Supreme Lord made [you] in vain!

children.text: apūjyo mohinī-śāpāt putra-śāpena sāmpratam // Jss_1,14.48 //
children.translated_text: Unworthy of worship due to <s>Mohinī</s>'s curse, and now by the curse of [your] son! // 1.14.48 //

children.text: gṛhītvā madanāgniṃ ca puruṣāś ca tathā striyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having taken the fire of desire, men and likewise women

children.text: nityaṃ dahanti satataṃ vāstavaṃ duḥsahaṃ param // Jss_1,14.49 //
children.translated_text: are constantly and ceaselessly burning — it is truly unbearable and supreme [in torment]. // 1.14.49 //

children.text: tad-eka-bhāgaḥ puruṣe tri-bhāgaś cāpi yoṣiti /
children.translated_text: One portion [of that fire] is in men, but three portions are in women;

children.text: tena dugdhāḥ striyaḥ sarvāś cāsmākam apareṇa kim // Jss_1,14.50 //
children.translated_text: by that, all women are already scorched — what use is more to us? // 1.14.50 //

children.text: samarpaṇaṃ cet puruṣe yad yasmāsu smarānalaḥ /
children.translated_text: If [you would] transfer to men the fire of desire that is in us,

children.text: bhasmī-bhūtaṃ kariṣyāmo rakṣitā ko bhavet tava // Jss_1,14.51 //
children.translated_text: we shall reduce it to ashes — who would be your protector [then]?' // 1.14.51 //

children.text: pati-vratā-vacaḥ śrutvā tam uvāca śivaḥ svayam /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of the devoted wives, <s>Śiva</s> himself spoke —

children.text: hitaṃ satyaṃ niti-sāraṃ pariṇāma-sukhāvaham // Jss_1,14.52 //
children.translated_text: words that were beneficial, true, the essence of wisdom, and yielding happiness in their result: // 1.14.52 //

body.translated_text: Now, the origin of the unchaste woman (<s>kulaṭā</s>):

children.text: śrī-mahā-deva uvāca
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Mahādeva</s> said:

children.text: tyaja dvandvaṃ mahā-bhāga suvratābhiḥ sahādhunā /
children.translated_text: 'Abandon the dispute now, O greatly fortunate ones, together with the virtuous women;

children.text: pati-vratānāṃ tejaś ca sarvebhyaś ca paraṃ bhavet // Jss_1,14.53 //
children.translated_text: the radiance of devoted wives shall be supreme over all. // 1.14.53 //

children.text: nirmāṇaṃ kuru devendra kṛtyāṃ strī-jātim īśvara /
children.translated_text: Create, O lord of gods, an artificial woman-being, O Lord;

children.text: tasyai dehi duḥkha-bījaṃ kāma-kopānalaṃ param // Jss_1,14.54 //
children.translated_text: give to her the seed of misery — the supreme fire of desire and anger.' // 1.14.54 //

children.text: śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā satvaraṃ jagatāṃ vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of <s>Śaṅkara</s>, the creator of the worlds swiftly

children.text: sasṛje tat-kṣaṇaṃ mūrtiṃ strī-rūpāṃ sumanoharāṃ // Jss_1,14.55 //
children.translated_text: at that very moment created a form — a female figure, exceedingly charming. // 1.14.55 //

children.text: aho rūpam aho veśam aho asyā navaṃ vayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Ah, what beauty! Ah, what attire! Ah, her youthful freshness!

children.text: aho cakṣuḥ kaṭākṣaṃ ca munīnāṃ mohayan manaḥ // Jss_1,14.56 //
children.translated_text: Ah, her eyes, her sidelong glances — bewildering the minds of sages! // 1.14.56 //

children.text: aho kaṭhinaṃ cāru stana-yugmaṃ suvartulam /
children.translated_text: Ah, her firm, beautiful pair of breasts, perfectly rounded,

children.text: vicitraṃ kaṭhinaṃ sthūlaṃ śroṇi-yugmaṃ ca sundaram // Jss_1,14.57 //
children.translated_text: and her variegated, firm, ample, and beautiful pair of hips! // 1.14.57 //

children.text: nitamba-yugmaṃ valitaṃ cakrākāraṃ sukomalam /
children.translated_text: Her pair of buttocks, curved, wheel-shaped, exceedingly soft,

children.text: śveta-campaka-varṇābhaṃ sarvāvayam īpsitam // Jss_1,14.58 //
children.translated_text: of the hue of a white champaka flower — every limb of hers desirable. // 1.14.58 //

children.text: śarat-pārvaṇa-koṭīndu-vinindāsyaṃ suśobhanam /
children.translated_text: Her face, surpassing ten million autumnal full moons in beauty, resplendent,

children.text: īṣaddhāsya-prasannāsyaṃ vastreṇācchāditaṃ mudā // Jss_1,14.59 //
children.translated_text: with a faint smile, serene-faced, joyfully covered with a garment. // 1.14.59 //

children.text: vapuḥ sukomalam cālaṃ nāti-dīrghaṃ na vakharam /
children.translated_text: Her body, very soft and delicate, neither too tall nor too short,

children.text: vahni-śuddhāṃśukaṃ ratna-bhūṣaṇair bhūṣitaṃ sadā // Jss_1,14.60 //
children.translated_text: wearing a fire-purified garment, always adorned with jeweled ornaments. // 1.14.60 //

children.text: dāḍimba-kumudākāraṃ sāndraṃ sindūra-sundaram /
children.translated_text: Her [lips] like pomegranate and night-lotus in form, rich, beautiful with vermillion,

children.text: kastūrī-vindunā sārdhaṃ snigdha-candana-vindubhiḥ // Jss_1,14.61 //
children.translated_text: together with a dot of musk and drops of fragrant sandalwood paste, // 1.14.61 //

children.text: pakva-bimba-phalākāram adha-rauṣṭha-puṭaṃ param /
children.translated_text: her lower lip like a ripe <s>bimba</s> fruit, supreme,

children.text: danta-paṃkti-yugaṃ caiva dāḍimba-bīja-sannibham // Jss_1,14.62 //
children.translated_text: and her pair of rows of teeth resembling pomegranate seeds. // 1.14.62 //

children.text: sucāru kavarī-bhāraṃ mālatī-mālya-maṇḍitam /
children.translated_text: Beautiful, with a heavy mass of braided hair, adorned with garlands of jasmine —

children.text: tasyai dadau ca kāmāgniṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamalodbhavaḥ // Jss_1,14.63 //
children.translated_text: to her, the lotus-born (<s>Brahmā</s>) gave the fire of desire, upon seeing her. // 1.14.63 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvā sā candra-rūpaṃ ca kāmonmattā vicetanā /
children.translated_text: Seeing the moon-like form [of <s>Candra</s>], she became maddened by desire, senseless;

children.text: kṛtvā kaṭākṣaṃ smerāśyā māṃ bhajasvety uvāca sā // Jss_1,14.64 //
children.translated_text: casting a sidelong glance, with a smiling face, she said, 'Embrace me!' // 1.14.64 //

children.text: saspitaḥ prayayau candro lajjayā ca sabhā-talāt /
children.translated_text: Smiling, <s>Candra</s> (the Moon) departed from the assembly hall out of embarrassment;

children.text: kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca cakame kāmārtā sā gata-trapā // Jss_1,14.65 //
children.translated_text: seeing <s>Kāma</s> (the god of desire), she desired him — she, consumed by passion, shameless. // 1.14.65 //

children.text: dudrāva kāmas tasmāc ca tat-paścāt sā dadhāva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāma</s> ran from her, and she ran after him;

children.text: jahasur devatāḥ sarvā munayaś cāpi saṃsadi // Jss_1,14.66 //
children.translated_text: all the deities and sages in the assembly laughed. // 1.14.66 //

children.text: lajjitā yoṣitah sarvās tāṃ vārayitum akṣamāḥ /
children.translated_text: All the women were embarrassed — unable to restrain her;

children.text: sarve cakruḥ parīhāsaṃ strī-vargaṃ śaṅkarādayaḥ // Jss_1,14.67 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> and all the others made sport of the female assembly. // 1.14.67 //

children.text: kāmaṃ na labdhvā sā ca strī nivṛtyāgatya saṃsadi /
children.translated_text: Not having obtained <s>Kāma</s>, that woman returned to the assembly,

children.text: tam aśvinī-kumāraṃ cāpy uvāca sura-sannidhau // Jss_1,14.68 //
children.translated_text: and she spoke to the son of the <s>Aśvins</s> (<s>Aśvinīkumāra</s>) in the presence of the gods: // 1.14.68 //

children.text: kṛtyā-kāminy uvāca
children.translated_text: The artificial desire-woman (<s>kṛtyā-kāminī</s>) said:

children.text: māṃ bhajasva raveḥ putra priyāṃ rasavatīṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: 'Embrace me, O son of <s>Ravi</s> (the Sun) — your beloved, full of passion, joyfully!

children.text: śṛṅgāre sukhadāṃ śāntāṃ parāṃ kāmāturāṃ varāṃ // Jss_1,14.69 //
children.translated_text: I am pleasing in lovemaking, gentle, supreme, consumed with desire, the best! // 1.14.69 //

children.text: tvayā śārdhaṃ bhramiṣyāmi sundare gahane vane /
children.translated_text: With you I shall wander in beautiful, dense forests;

children.text: rahasi rahasi krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi divāniśam // Jss_1,14.70 //
children.translated_text: in secret, in secret, I shall sport day and night. // 1.14.70 //

children.text: madhu-pānaṃ ca dāsyāmi vāsitaṃ cāmalaṃ jalam /
children.translated_text: I shall give you honey-wine, and pure perfumed water,

children.text: sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhoga-vastu manoharam // Jss_1,14.71 //
children.translated_text: betel leaf with camphor, and charming objects of enjoyment. // 1.14.71 //

children.text: śayyāṃ manoramāṃ kṛtvā sapuṣpa-candanārcitām /
children.translated_text: Having prepared a delightful bed, adorned with flowers and sandalwood,

children.text: bhagavantaṃ kariṣyāmi puṣpa-candana-carcitam // Jss_1,14.72 //
children.translated_text: I shall make the lord [of my heart] anointed with flowers and sandalwood.' // 1.14.72 //

children.text: kumāra uvāca
children.translated_text: The son [of the <s>Aśvins</s>] said:

children.text: vacanaṃ vada vāme mām ātmano hṛdayaṅgama /
children.translated_text: 'Speak to me words that touch the heart, O beautiful one,

children.text: vihāya kapaṭaṃ kānte kapaṭaṃ dharma-nāśanam // Jss_1,14.73 //
children.translated_text: abandoning deceit, O beloved — for deceit destroys <s>dharma</s>. // 1.14.73 //

children.text: strī-dharmaṃ strī-manas-kāmaṃ strī-svabhāvaṃ ca kīdṛśam /
children.translated_text: What is the <s>dharma</s> of women, the desire of a woman's mind, and what is a woman's nature?

children.text: tad-ācāraṃ kati-vidhaṃ tan māṃ vyākhyātum arhasi // Jss_1,14.74 //
children.translated_text: And of how many kinds is her conduct? Please explain that to me.' // 1.14.74 //

children.text: aśvinīja-vacaḥ śrutvā kāmārtā tam uvāca sā /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of the son of <s>Aśvinī</s>, she, consumed by desire, spoke to him —

children.text: kāmārtānāṃ kva lajjā ca kva bhayaṃ mānam eva ca // Jss_1,14.75 //
children.translated_text: 'For those consumed by desire, where is shame? Where is fear? Where is pride?' // 1.14.75 //

body.translated_text: Now, the narration of the nature of the unchaste woman (<s>kulaṭā</s>):

children.text: kāminy uvāca
children.translated_text: The desire-woman said:

children.text: sthānaṃ nāsti kṣaṇaṃ nāsti nāsti dūtī tad uttamā /
children.translated_text: 'There is no [proper] place, there is no [right] moment, there is no suitable go-between —

children.text: tenaiva yuvatīnāṃ ca satītvam upajāyate // Jss_1,14.76 //
children.translated_text: only by that [lack] does chastity arise in young women. // 1.14.76 //

children.text: suveśaṃ kāmukaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāminī madanāturā /
children.translated_text: Seeing a well-dressed lover, a passionate woman, tormented by desire —

children.text: tad rātraṃ ca pulakitaṃ yonau kaṇḍūyanaṃ paraṃ // Jss_1,14.77 //
children.translated_text: that night she is thrilled with horripilation and intense itching in the loins. // 1.14.77 //

children.text: sarvaṃ tyajati tad-dhetoḥ putraṃ kāntaṃ gṛhaṃ dhanam // Jss_1,14.78/ //
children.translated_text: she abandons everything for his sake — son, husband, home, and wealth. // 1.14.78 //

body.translated_text: She becomes senseless, oppressed by the fever of desire;

children.text: labdhvā yuvānaṃ puruṣaṃ deśa-tyāgaṃ karoti sā /
children.translated_text: Having obtained a young man, she abandons her country;

children.text: tad-uttamaṃ punar labdhvā taṃ tyajet sā kṣaṇena ca // Jss_1,14.79 //
children.translated_text: and having obtained a better one, she abandons the former in an instant. // 1.14.79 //

children.text: viṣaṃ dātuṃ samarthā sā svāminaṃ guṇināṃ varam /
children.translated_text: She is capable of giving poison to her own husband, the best among the virtuous;

children.text: mlecchaṃ yuvānaṃ samprāpya sarvasvaṃ dātum utsukā // Jss_1,14.80 //
children.translated_text: having obtained a young barbarian (<s>mleccha</s>), she is eager to give [him] everything. // 1.14.80 //

children.text: tyajet kula-bhayaṃ lajjāṃ dharmaṃ bandhuṃ yaśaḥ śriyam /
children.translated_text: She would abandon fear of family, modesty, <s>dharma</s>, kinsmen, fame, and fortune

children.text: samprāpya rati-śūraṃ ca yuvānaṃ suratonmukham // Jss_1,14.81 //
children.translated_text: upon obtaining a young man, heroic in love, eager for amorous sport. // 1.14.81 //

children.text: sudṛśyaṃ sundara-mukhaṃ śaśvan-madhuritaṃ vacaḥ /
children.translated_text: Beautiful to behold, with a lovely face, her speech ever honeyed,

children.text: hṛdayaṃ kṣura-dhārābhaṃ ko vā jānāti tan-manaḥ // Jss_1,14.82 //
children.translated_text: but her heart like a razor's edge — who indeed knows her mind? // 1.14.82 //

children.text: vidyucchaṭā jale rekhā cāsthirā ca yathāmbare /
children.translated_text: Like a flash of lightning, a line [drawn] on water, unsteady as [clouds] in the sky,

children.text: tathāsthirā ca kulaṭā-prītiḥ svapnaṃ ca tad-vacaḥ // Jss_1,14.83 //
children.translated_text: just so is the unstable affection of an unchaste woman, and her words are [like] a dream. // 1.14.83 //

children.text: kulaṭānāṃ na satyaṃ ca na ca dharmo bhayaṃ dayā /
children.translated_text: For unchaste women there is no truth, no <s>dharma</s>, no fear, no compassion,

children.text: na laukikaṃ na lajjā syāj jāra-jintā nirantaram // Jss_1,14.84 //
children.translated_text: no social propriety, no shame — only ceaseless thought of a paramour. // 1.14.84 //

children.text: svapne jāgaraṇe caiva bhojane śayane sadā /
children.translated_text: In sleep, in waking, in eating, in lying down — always,

children.text: nirantaraṃ kāma-cintā jāre sneho na cānyataḥ // Jss_1,14.85 //
children.translated_text: unceasing thoughts of desire, affection only for the paramour, not for another. // 1.14.85 //

children.text: kulaṭā nara-ghātibhyo nirdayā duṣṭa-mānasāḥ /
children.translated_text: Unchaste women are more merciless than murderers, of wicked minds;

children.text: jārārthe ca sutaṃ hanti bāndhavasya ca kā kathā // Jss_1,14.86 //
children.translated_text: for the sake of a paramour she would kill her own son — what then to speak of kinsmen? // 1.14.86 //

children.text: na hi vedā vidanty evaṃ kulatā-hṛdayaṅgamam /
children.translated_text: Not even the <s>Vedas</s> know what touches the heart of an unchaste woman;

children.text: kathaṃ devās ca munayaḥ santo jānanti niścayam // Jss_1,14.87 //
children.translated_text: how can the gods, the sages, and the saints know for certain? // 1.14.87 //

children.text: rati-śūraṃ priyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣīraṃ ghṛtam ivācaret /
children.translated_text: Seeing her beloved, heroic in love, she treats him like milk and ghee;

children.text: gate vayasi jīrṇaṃ taṃ viṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyajet kṣaṇāt // Jss_1,14.88 //
children.translated_text: [but] when his youth has passed and he is aged, she abandons him in an instant, seeing him as poison. // 1.14.88 //

children.text: na viśvaseyus tāṃ duṣṭo tasmāt santo hi santataṃ /
children.translated_text: Therefore, the virtuous should never trust such a wicked one;

children.text: na ripuḥ puruṣāṇāṃ ca duṣṭa-strībhyaḥ paro bhuvi // Jss_1,14.89 //
children.translated_text: there is no greater enemy to men on earth than a wicked woman. // 1.14.89 //

children.text: viṣaṃ mantrād upaśamaṃ jalād vahniś ca niścitaṃ /
children.translated_text: Poison can be allayed by <s>mantra</s>; fire can certainly [be quenched] by water;

children.text: agneś ca kaṇṭhakocchannaṃ durjanaḥ stavanād vaśaḥ // Jss_1,14.90 //
children.translated_text: fire is extinguished by thorns [of grass]; a wicked person is subdued by praise. // 1.14.90 //

children.text: lubdho dhanena rājā ca sevayā satataṃ vaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: The greedy is controlled by wealth; a king by constant service;

children.text: miśraṃ svaccha-svabhāvena bhayena ca ripur vaśaḥ // Jss_1,14.91 //
children.translated_text: a mixed [person] by pure-natured [conduct]; an enemy is controlled by fear. // 1.14.91 //

children.text: ādareṇa vaśo vipro yauvatī prema-bhārataḥ /
children.translated_text: A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> is won by respect; a young woman by the weight of love;

children.text: bandhur vaśaḥ samatayā guruḥ praṇatibhiḥ sadā // Jss_1,14.92 //
children.translated_text: a kinsman by equality; a <s>guru</s> always by prostrations. // 1.14.92 //

children.text: mūrkho vaśaḥ kathāyāṃ ca vidvān vidyā-vicārataḥ /
children.translated_text: A fool is won by stories; a learned one by the discussion of knowledge;

children.text: na hi duṣṭā ca kulaṭā puṃsaś ca vaśagā bhavet // Jss_1,14.93 //
children.translated_text: but a wicked, unchaste woman can never be brought under a man's control. // 1.14.93 //

children.text: sva-kārye tat-parā śaśvat prītiḥ kāryānurodhataḥ /
children.translated_text: She is ever intent on her own purpose; her affection follows only her interest;

children.text: na sarvasya vaśī-bhūtā vinā śṛṅgāram ulvaṇam // Jss_1,14.94 //
children.translated_text: she is not subject to anyone, without intense amorous passion. // 1.14.94 //

children.text: na prītyā na dhanenaiva na stavān na sevayā /
children.translated_text: Not by affection, not by wealth, not by praise, not by service,

children.text: na prāṇa-dānato veśyā vaśī-bhūtā bhavet kṣaṇam // Jss_1,14.95 //
children.translated_text: not by the offering of one's life — a courtesan can never be controlled even for a moment. // 1.14.95 //

children.text: āhāro dvi-guṇas tāsāṃ buddhis tāsāṃ catur-guṇā /
children.translated_text: Their appetite is double, their intelligence fourfold,

children.text: ṣaḍ-guṇā mantraṇā tāsāṃ kāmaś cāṣṭa-gunaḥ smṛtaḥ // Jss_1,14.96 //
children.translated_text: their scheming sixfold, and their desire is said to be eightfold. // 1.14.96 //

children.text: śaśvat-kāmā ca kulaṭā na ca tṛptiś ca krīḍayā /
children.translated_text: An unchaste woman is perpetually desirous, and never satisfied by amorous play;

children.text: haviṣā kṛṣṇa-vartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate // Jss_1,14.97 //
children.translated_text: like a fire [fed] with oblations on the dark path, she only increases further and further. // 1.14.97 //

children.text: divāniśaṃ ca śṛṅgāraṃ kurute tat-pumān yadi /
children.translated_text: Even if a man makes love day and night,

children.text: na tṛptiḥ kulaṭānāṃ ca pumāṃsaṃ grastum icchati // Jss_1,14.98 //
children.translated_text: unchaste women are never satisfied — they wish to devour the man. // 1.14.98 //

children.text: nāgnis tṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Fire is never satiated with wood, nor the great ocean with rivers,

children.text: nāntakaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṃ nāsāṃ tṛpyati sampadām // Jss_1,14.99 //
children.translated_text: nor Death with all beings, nor are [unchaste women] ever satisfied with riches. // 1.14.99 //

children.text: na śreyasāṃ manas tṛptaṃ vāḍavāgnir na pāthasām /
children.translated_text: The mind is never satisfied with blessings, nor the submarine fire with waters,

children.text: vasundharā na rajasāṃ na puṃsāṃ kulaṭā tathā // Jss_1,14.100 //
children.translated_text: nor the earth with dust, and likewise an unchaste woman never with men. // 1.14.100 //

children.text: ity evaṃ kathitaṃ kiṃcit sarvaṃ vaktuṃ ca nocitam /
children.translated_text: Thus I have spoken in brief — it is not proper to tell everything;

children.text: lajjā bījaṃ yoṣitāṃ ca nibodha bhāskarātmaja // Jss_1,14.101 //
children.translated_text: modesty is the seed [of virtue] in women — understand this, O son of the Sun.' // 1.14.101 //

children.text: śrutvā ca kṛtyā-strī-vākyaṃ jahasur munayaḥ surāḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of the artificial woman, the sages and gods laughed;

children.text: cukupur yoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ padmādyā lajjitāḥ suta // Jss_1,14.102 //
children.translated_text: all the women — <s>Padmā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>) and the rest — were angered and embarrassed, O son. // 1.14.102 //

children.text: lajjā-natānanā lakṣmīr niryayau deva-maṇḍalāt /
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmī</s>, with face bowed in shame, departed from the assembly of the gods;

children.text: tat paścāt pārvatī sārdhaṃ sarasvatyā natānanā // Jss_1,14.103 //
children.translated_text: after her, <s>Pārvatī</s> together with <s>Sarasvatī</s>, with downcast faces. // 1.14.103 //

children.text: sāvitrī rohinī svāhā vāruṇī ca ratiḥ śacī /
children.translated_text: <s>Sāvitrī</s>, <s>Rohinī</s>, <s>Svāhā</s>, <s>Vāruṇī</s>, <s>Rati</s>, and <s>Śacī</s> —

children.text: sarvā babhūvur ekatra pracakrur mantraṇāṃ ca tāḥ // Jss_1,14.104 //
children.translated_text: all gathered in one place and held a deliberation among themselves. // 1.14.104 //

children.text: kṛtyā-striyaḥ samāhūya tā ūcuś ca krameṇa ca /
children.translated_text: Having summoned the artificial woman, they spoke to her in order,

children.text: rodhayām āsur iṣṭāṃ tāṃ sugopyāṃ api yoṣitaḥ // Jss_1,14.105 //
children.translated_text: and restrained that desirable but [whose nature should be] well-concealed woman. // 1.14.105 //

children.text: tasyā mukhe dadau hastaṃ suśīlā kamalālayā /
children.translated_text: The auspicious <s>Kamalālayā</s> (<s>Lakṣmī</s>) placed her hand upon her mouth [saying],

children.text: salajjitā bhava sute śāntā ceti śubhāśiṣam // Jss_1,14.106 //
children.translated_text: 'Be modest, O daughter, be calm' — [granting] auspicious benedictions. // 1.14.106 //

children.text: sarasvatī dadau tasyai cābhimānaṃ ca dhairyatām /
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s> gave her self-esteem and steadfastness,

children.text: maukharyaṃ vāvadūkatvaṃ mantraṇām ātma-rakṣaṇam // Jss_1,14.107 //
children.translated_text: talkativeness, eloquence, deliberation, and self-protection. // 1.14.107 //

children.text: sāvitrī ca dadau tasyai sauśīlyaṃ cātidurlabham /
children.translated_text: <s>Sāvitrī</s> gave her virtuous conduct, most rare,

children.text: ātma-saṃgopanaṃ caiva gāmbhīryaṃ kulato bhayam // Jss_1,14.108 //
children.translated_text: self-concealment, dignity, and fear of [disgracing one's] family. // 1.14.108 //

children.text: pārvaty uvāca
children.translated_text: <s>Pārvatī</s> said:

children.text: dhik tvāṃ sva-bhāva-kulaṭāṃ lajjitā bhava sundari /
children.translated_text: 'Shame on you, O one unchaste by nature — be modest, O beautiful one!

children.text: sva-mānaṃ gauravaṃ rakṣa hy asmākaṃ ca smarātura // Jss_1,14.109 //
children.translated_text: protect your own honor and our dignity, O one afflicted by desire! // Jss_1,14.109 //

children.text: jani labha pṛthivyāṃ ca kāya-vyūhaṃ vidhāya ca /
children.translated_text: Be born on earth, and having assumed a multiform body,

children.text: puṃsām aṣṭa-guṇaṃ kāmaṃ labhasva ca pṛthak prṛthak // Jss_1,14.110 //
children.translated_text: obtain desire eightfold that of men, each separately. // Jss_1,14.110 //

children.text: lajjāṃ catur-guṇāṃ cāpi dviguṇāṃ dhairyatāṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: And fourfold modesty, and twofold steadfastness likewise.

children.text: abhogecchadhame gaccha dūraṃ gaccha mamāntikāt // Jss_1,14.111 //
children.translated_text: Go, O lowest of those desiring enjoyment! Go far away from me! // Jss_1,14.111 //

children.text: puṃsāṃ ca dvi-guṇaḥ kāmo vāstavīṇāṃ ca yoṣitām /
children.translated_text: Men have twofold desire, while women who dwell [in the world]

children.text: lajjā cāṣṭa-guṇā cāpi dhairyatā ca catur-guṇā // Jss_1,14.112 //
children.translated_text: have eightfold modesty and fourfold steadfastness. // Jss_1,14.112 //

children.text: kula-dharmaḥ kula-bhayaṃ sauśīlyaṃ mānam ūrjitam /
children.translated_text: Family duty, family honor, virtue, and vigorous pride —

children.text: śaśvat tiṣṭhatu puṃsy eva strīṣu ca mamājñayā // Jss_1,14.113 //
children.translated_text: may these perpetually abide in men and in women, by my command! // Jss_1,14.113 //

children.text: yasmāt sadasi sarvebhyo lajjā-hīnaḥ surādhamaḥ /
children.translated_text: Because in the assembly, before all, devoid of shame, the lowest of the gods

children.text: strī-sva-bhāvaṃ ca papraccha yajña-bhāk na bhavet tataḥ // Jss_1,14.114 //
children.translated_text: asked about the nature of women — therefore he shall not receive a share of the sacrifice. // Jss_1,14.114 //

children.text: adya-prabhṛti viśveṣu nāgrāhyaṃ pāpa-saṃyutam /
children.translated_text: From this day forth, among all people, [fire] is not to be received when tainted by sin;

children.text: cikitsakānāṃ viduṣāṃ na bhakṣya mamājñayā // Jss_1,14.115 //
children.translated_text: it is not to be consumed by physicians and the learned — by my command. // Jss_1,14.115 //

children.text: ity evam uktvā prayayur devyaś ca sarva-yoṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, the goddesses and all the women departed,

children.text: devāś ca munayaś cāpi ye cānye ca samāgataḥ // Jss_1,14.116 //
children.translated_text: and the gods and sages and all others who had assembled. // Jss_1,14.116 //

children.text: devāś ca munayaś cāpi ye cānye sarvataḥ suta /
children.translated_text: The gods and sages and all others everywhere, O son —

children.text: pati-vratāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca lajjā bīja-svarūpiṇī // Jss_1,14.117 //
children.translated_text: for chaste women, modesty is the seed-nature [of their being]. // Jss_1,14.117 //

body.text:
iti śrī-nārada-pañca-rātre jñāṇāmṛta-sāre prathamaika-rātre
kulaṭottpatir nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, entitled 'The Origin of the Unchaste Woman,' of the First Night in the <s>Śrī Nārada Pañcarātra</s>, the Essence of the Nectar of Knowledge.
Fifteenth chapter of the First Night.

children.text: gate niyamite kāle gandharvaś copavarhaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: When the appointed time had elapsed, the <s>Gandharva</s> <s>Upavarhaṇa</s>

children.text: sva-yogena jahau dehaṃ bhārate prāktanād aho // Jss_1,15.1 //
children.translated_text: by his own <s>yoga</s> abandoned his body in <s>Bhārata</s>, due to his former [<s>karma</s>] — alas! // Jss_1,15.1 //

children.text: sa jajñe śudra-yonau ca pituḥ śāpena ca daivataḥ /
children.translated_text: He was born in a <s>Śūdra</s> womb, by his father's curse, by divine decree.

children.text: viṣṇu-prasādaṃ bhuktvā ca babhūva brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ // Jss_1,15.2 //
children.translated_text: Having partaken of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s grace, he became the son of <s>Brahmā</s> [again]. // Jss_1,15.2 //

children.text: vimuktas tāta-śāpena samprāpya jñānam uttamam /
children.translated_text: Freed from his father's curse, having attained supreme knowledge,

children.text: prati-janma-smṛtis tasya kṛṣṇa-mantra-prasādataḥ // Jss_1,15.3 //
children.translated_text: he possessed memory of all his former births, by the grace of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s <s>mantra</s>. // Jss_1,15.3 //

children.text: pituḥ sakāśād āgatya samprāpa candra-śekharāt /
children.translated_text: Having come from his father's presence, he received from the Moon-crested One (<s>Śiva</s>)

children.text: śrī-kṛṣṇa-mantram atulaṃ svarga-mandākinī-taṭe // Jss_1,15.4 //
children.translated_text: the incomparable <s>mantra</s> of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, on the bank of the celestial <s>Mandākinī</s>. // Jss_1,15.4 //

children.text: svarga-mandākinī-tīrād guruṇā śaṅkareṇa ca /
children.translated_text: From the bank of the celestial <s>Mandākinī</s>, together with his <s>guru</s> <s>Śaṅkara</s>,

children.text: sahitaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ pārvatī-sannidhānataḥ // Jss_1,15.5 //
children.translated_text: he quickly departed, into the presence of <s>Pārvatī</s>. // Jss_1,15.5 //

children.text: uvāsa tatra śambhuś ca nāradaś ca mahā-muniḥ /
children.translated_text: There dwelt <s>Śambhu</s> and <s>Nārada</s>, the great sage,

children.text: pārvatī bhadra-kālī skando gaṇa-patiḥ svayam // Jss_1,15.6 //
children.translated_text: <s>Pārvatī</s>, <s>Bhadrakālī</s>, <s>Skanda</s>, and <s>Gaṇapati</s> himself, // Jss_1,15.6 //

children.text: mahā-kālaś ca nandī ca vīra-bhadraḥ pratāpavān /
children.translated_text: <s>Mahākāla</s>, <s>Nandī</s>, and the valiant <s>Vīrabhadra</s>,

children.text: siddhā maharṣayaś ca munayaḥ sankādayaḥ // Jss_1,15.7 //
children.translated_text: <s>Siddhas</s>, great <s>ṛṣis</s>, and sages such as <s>Sanaka</s> and others. // Jss_1,15.7 //

children.text: yogīndrā jñāninaḥ sarve samūcuḥ śambhu-saṃsadi /
children.translated_text: The lords of <s>yogins</s> and all the knowers spoke in the assembly of <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: yat stotraṃ kavacaṃ dhyānaṃ subhadrāya ca kānane // Jss_1,15.8 //
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>stotra</s> (hymn), <s>kavaca</s> (protective armor), and <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation) had been given to <s>Subhadrā</s> in the forest // Jss_1,15.8 //

children.text: nārāyaṇarṣi-bhagavān brāhmaṇāya dadau purā /
children.translated_text: by the blessed sage <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, to that <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, in former times,

children.text: pūjā-vidhānaṃ yad yac ca puraś-caraṇa-pūrvakam // Jss_1,15.9 //
children.translated_text: and whatever method of worship, preceded by preliminary rites — // Jss_1,15.9 //

children.text: tad eva bhagavān śambhuḥ pradadau nāradāya ca /
children.translated_text: all that the Blessed <s>Śambhu</s> bestowed upon <s>Nārada</s>.

children.text: uvāca śambhuṃ devarṣir yogināṃ ca guror gurum /
children.translated_text: The divine sage spoke to <s>Śambhu</s>, the <s>guru</s> of <s>gurus</s> of <s>yogins</s>,

children.text: pārvatī-sannidhau tatra nāradaś ca mahā-muniḥ // Jss_1,15.10 //
children.translated_text: in the presence of <s>Pārvatī</s>, there — <s>Nārada</s>, the great sage: // Jss_1,15.10 //

children.text: bhagavan sarva-dharma-jña sarva-jña sarva-kāraṇa /
children.translated_text: 'O Blessed One, knower of all <s>dharmas</s>, omniscient one, cause of all!

children.text: sad yat pṛṣṭaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ tan māṃ vyākhyātum arhasi // Jss_1,15.11 //
children.translated_text: What was asked by me before — please explain it to me. // Jss_1,15.11 //

children.text: yad yat pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā brahman pratyekaṃ ca krameṇa ca /
children.translated_text: 'Whatever was asked by you, O <s>Brahman</s>, each question in order —

children.text: punaḥ praśnaṃ kuru mune śṛṇvantu mat-sabhāsadaḥ // Jss_1,15.12 //
children.translated_text: ask your questions again, O sage; let those in my assembly hear.' // Jss_1,15.12 //

children.text: ādhyātmikaṃ ca yaj jñānaṃ vedānāṃ sāram uttamam /
children.translated_text: 'That spiritual knowledge (<s>ādhyātmika jñāna</s>) which is the supreme essence of the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: jñānaṃ jñāniṣu sāraṃ yat kṛṣṇa-bhakti-pradaṃ śubhaṃ // Jss_1,15.13 //
children.translated_text: that knowledge which is the essence among knowers, auspicious, bestowing devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, // Jss_1,15.13 //

children.text: nirvāṇa-muktidaṃ jñānaṃ karma-mūla-nikṛntanam /
children.translated_text: the knowledge granting <s>nirvāṇa</s>-liberation, uprooting the root of <s>karma</s>,

children.text: tat-siddhi-yogān muktiś ca yoginām api vāñcchitam // Jss_1,15.14 //
children.translated_text: and liberation through <s>siddhi</s>-<s>yoga</s> — that which even <s>yogins</s> desire, // Jss_1,15.14 //

children.text: saṃsāra-viṣayaṃ jñānaṃ śaśvat sammoha-veṣṭitam /
children.translated_text: knowledge concerning <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence), perpetually enveloped in delusion,

children.text: āśramāṇāṃ samācāraṃ teṣāṃ dharma-pariṣkṛtam // Jss_1,15.15 //
children.translated_text: the proper conduct of the <s>āśramas</s> (stages of life), refined by their respective <s>dharmas</s>, // Jss_1,15.15 //

children.text: caturṇāṃ varṇanāṃ vidhānāṃ maheśvara /
children.translated_text: the duties of the four <s>varṇas</s> (social orders), O <s>Maheśvara</s>,

children.text: bhikṣūṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahma-cāriṇām // Jss_1,15.16 //
children.translated_text: of mendicants, <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>, ascetics, and <s>brahmacārins</s> (celibate students), // Jss_1,15.16 //

children.text: vāna-prasthāśramāṇāṃ ca paṇḍitānāṃ tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: of the forest-dweller <s>āśramas</s> (<s>vānaprasthas</s>), and of the learned,

children.text: pati-vratānāṃ yad yac ca śrī-kṛṣṇa-pūjanaṃ ca yat // Jss_1,15.17 //
children.translated_text: and whatever pertains to chaste wives and their worship of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, // Jss_1,15.17 //

children.text: yat stotraṃ kavacaṃ mantraṃ puraś-caraṇam īpsitam /
children.translated_text: the hymn, the protective armor, the <s>mantra</s>, the desired preliminary rites,

children.text: sārvāhnikam abhīṣṭaṃ ca vipākaṃ karma-jīvinām // Jss_1,15.18 //
children.translated_text: the daily observances, and the ripening [of <s>karma</s>] for those who live by [their] actions, // Jss_1,15.18 //

children.text: saṃsāra-vāsanā-baddhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtīśayoḥ /
children.translated_text: the characteristics of <s>Prakṛti</s> (primordial nature) and <s>Īśa</s> (the Lord), bound by the impressions of <s>saṃsāra</s>,

children.text: tayoḥ paraṃ vā yad brahma tasyāvatāra-varṇanam // Jss_1,15.19 //
children.translated_text: and that <s>Brahman</s> which is beyond both of them — the description of His <s>avatāras</s> (incarnations), // Jss_1,15.19 //

children.text: kas tat kalāvatīrṇaś ca kas tad-aṃśaś tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: who descended as a <s>kalā</s> (partial manifestation), who as His <s>aṃśa</s> (portion),

children.text: paripūrṇatamaḥ kaś ca kaḥ pūrṇaḥ kaḥ kalāṃśakaḥ // Jss_1,15.20 //
children.translated_text: who is the most complete, who is full, who is a portion of a <s>kalā</s>, // Jss_1,15.20 //

children.text: kasya vārādhane śambho kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ yaśas tathā /
children.translated_text: what fruit and what fame [come] from worshipping each, O <s>Śambhu</s>,

children.text: aṅgāṅginor bheda-phalaṃ vistīrṇaṃ nirapekṣakam // Jss_1,15.21 //
children.translated_text: the distinct fruit of the subsidiary and the principal — [please explain] extensively and impartially, // Jss_1,15.21 //

children.text: nārāyaṇarṣi-kavacaṃ subhadra-brāhmaṇāya ca /
children.translated_text: the protective armor given by the sage <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>

children.text: yad dattaṃ kiṃ tad deveśa tad-ārādhyaś ca kaḥ suraḥ // Jss_1,15.22 //
children.translated_text: to the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> <s>Subhadrā</s> — what is it, O Lord of Gods, and who is the deity worshipped therein? // Jss_1,15.22 //

children.text: ati-saṃgopanīyaṃ ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam /
children.translated_text: That most closely guarded protective armor, most wondrous,

children.text: sudurlabhaṃ ca viśveṣu noktaṃ māṃ brahmaṇā purā // Jss_1,15.23 //
children.translated_text: most rare in the universe — it was not told to me by <s>Brahmā</s> before. // Jss_1,15.23 //

children.text: sanat-kumāro jānāti noktaṃ tena purā ca mām /
children.translated_text: <s>Sanatkumāra</s> knows it, [but] he did not tell me before either.

children.text: mayā jñānam anāpṛṣṭaṃ yad yaj jānāsi maṅgalam // Jss_1,15.24 //
children.translated_text: Whatever knowledge I have not asked about — whatever you know that is auspicious, // Jss_1,15.24 //

children.text: veda-sāram anupamaṃ karma-mūla-nikṛntanam /
children.translated_text: the incomparable essence of the <s>Vedas</s>, the uprooter of the root of <s>karma</s> —

children.text: tan me kathaya bhadreśa mām evānugrahaṃ kuru // Jss_1,15.25 //
children.translated_text: tell that to me, O <s>Bhadreśa</s>! Show grace to me! // Jss_1,15.25 //

children.text: apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ vedeṣu ca sudurlabham /
children.translated_text: The unprecedented narrative of <s>Rādhikā</s>, most rare in the <s>Vedas</s>,

children.text: purāṇeṣv itihāse ca vedāṅgeṣu sudurlabham // Jss_1,15.26 //
children.translated_text: most rare in the <s>Purāṇas</s>, <s>Itihāsas</s>, and <s>Vedāṅgas</s> — // Jss_1,15.26 //

children.text: guroś ca jñānodigaraṇāt jñānaṃ syān mantra-tantrayoḥ /
children.translated_text: from the <s>guru</s>'s imparting of knowledge, knowledge arises in <s>mantra</s> and <s>tantra</s>;

children.text: tat tantaṃ sa ca mantraḥ syāt kṛṣṇa-bhaktir yato bhavet // Jss_1,15.27 //
children.translated_text: that <s>tantra</s> and that <s>mantra</s> are those from which devotion to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> arises. // Jss_1,15.27 //

children.text: jñānaṃ syād viduṣāṃ kiṃcid veda-vyākhyānataḥ prabho /
children.translated_text: Some knowledge of the learned comes from the exposition of the <s>Vedas</s>, O Lord.

children.text: veda-kāraṇa-pūjyaś tvaṃ jñānādhiṣṭhātṛ-devatā // Jss_1,15.28 //
children.translated_text: You are worshipped as the cause of the <s>Vedas</s>, the presiding deity of knowledge. // Jss_1,15.28 //

children.text: tasmād bhavān paraṃ jñānaṃ vada veda-vidāṃ vara /
children.translated_text: Therefore, O best of the knowers of the <s>Vedas</s>, speak that supreme knowledge

children.text: māṃ bhaktam anuraktaṃ ca śaraṇāgatam īśvara // Jss_1,15.29 //
children.translated_text: to me, your devoted, attached disciple who has taken refuge, O Lord.' // Jss_1,15.29 //

children.text: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā yogināṃ ca guror guruḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the words of <s>Nārada</s>, the <s>guru</s> of <s>gurus</s> of <s>yogins</s>,

children.text: bhagavatyā sahālocya jñānaṃ vaktuṃ samudyataḥ // Jss_1,15.30 //
children.translated_text: having deliberated with the Goddess (<s>Pārvatī</s>), prepared to speak the knowledge. // Jss_1,15.30 //

children.text: ity evaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvākhyānaṃ manoharam /
children.translated_text: Thus has been narrated all the former story, enchanting,

children.text: hari-bhakti-pradaṃ sarvaṃ karma-mūla-nikṛntanam // Jss_1,15.31 //
children.translated_text: all of it bestowing devotion to <s>Hari</s>, uprooting the root of <s>karma</s>. // Jss_1,15.31 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the fifteenth chapter of the First Night in the <s>Śrī Nārada Pañcarātra</s>, the Essence of the Nectar of Knowledge.
Thus concludes the First Night of the <s>Nārada Pañcarātra</s>.
